title: Simple Portfolios that Deliver Consistent Decent Returns
abstract: Portfolio construction has been studied extensively in both academia and industry. Its applications range from pension funds and hedge funds to private savings. The academic literature centers on methodology, commonly evaluated in settings that allow short selling, leverage, and frequent trading. Industry, on the other hand, operates under real constraints, but its data and methods are proprietary and largely unpublished. Neither is directly available to the private investor. This paper is an empirical study of established portfolio construction methods in the setting of the private investor. We consider a small investable universe of liquid US ETFs, where trading is monthly and carries a cost, and neither shorting nor leverage is permitted. Portfolio construction is posed as a convex optimization problem, its inputs are estimated from public data, and every parameter is interpretable. We denote such portfolios simple. We show that simple portfolios of as few as three ETFs deliver consistent and decent returns, without tuning to the backtest period. To find them, we have developed a framework, which we share publicly, able to backtest hundreds of portfolios on a standard laptop over a twenty year period or longer. When no return forecast is made, portfolios are constructed from risk alone, using methods such as risk parity and minimum volatility, built on a statistical factor model fitted with expectation maximization. When a forecast is made, we combine the Markowitz formulation with momentum signals and ridge regression. We report what works and what each component adds, weighing its gain against its complexity and the effort it demands of the investor. The findings are supported by numerical experiments over the past two decades, and the proposed portfolios outperform the standard 60/40 allocation.
summary: 本文面向个人投资者，实证研究在真实约束下的经典组合构建方法：仅用少量高流动性美国ETF构成的投资域，按月调仓且计交易成本，禁止做空与加杠杆；将组合构建表述为凸优化问题，参数由公开数据估计且均可解释，称为“简单组合”。研究表明，少至三只ETF的简单组合即可在不针对回测期调参的情况下，获得稳定且不错的收益；作者公开了一个可在普通笔记本上对数百个组合进行回测的框架。

title: Event definition and the branching ratio: Hawkes estimates of price-change clustering in the consolidated quote feed
abstract: Hawkes models of price changes in the consolidated US quote feed find a sub-millisecond kernel component and a branching ratio near criticality. We show that in large-tick stocks the first is the feed's construction: half of NBBO changes are locks or depleted quotes, resolved within a millisecond, which the model reads as excitation. Defining the event as a mid-price level persisting for one millisecond removes the component. Raw fits put three times the clean kernel mass within one second, which a simulation reproduces. Since the total branching ratio trades off against the baseline, we report kernel mass on a fixed window.
summary: 该论文研究美国合并报价流中价格变化的Hawkes模型标定，发现：大tick股票中存在亚毫秒核成分，分支比接近临界值；这种成分实为数据构造假象——约半数NBBO变化是锁定或耗尽报价，在1毫秒内被解决，模型误将其读作激发。将事件重新定义为持续1毫秒的中价水平可消除该成分。原始拟合在1秒内包含三倍于干净核的核质量，模拟可复现；由于总分支比与基线存在权衡，作者在固定窗口上报告核质量。对实战交易的启示在于数据清洗与事件定义对微观结构建模的直接影响，但未提供可直接交易的信号或策略。

summary: 该论文提出ETIA框架，将多种交易指标集成，并结合深度学习（增强型）与不对称密码学进行市场预测。核心在于用集成指标分析提升预测精度，偏量化模型与统计方法，涉及深度学习但非强化学习或直接Alpha挖掘。对实战交易有一定参考价值（指标集成思路、DL预测流程），但密码学部分对交易实战意义有限，整体介于应用研究与理论之间，给6分。

abstract: … algorithmic trading system to improve the Sharpe ratio performance index for selecting stocks and maximizing returns during market ups and downs. The proposed strategy … strategy in …
summary: 该论文提出一种将深度学习模型与自然语言处理（NLP）相结合的算法交易系统，目标是通过整合多模态信息（如价格序列与文本情绪/新闻信号）来提升夏普比率（Sharpe ratio），从而优化选股并把握市场涨跌中的收益。摘要强调该策略在回测/实验中的夏普表现改进，但未明确披露具体模型架构、数据频率、交易成本与滑点处理、样本外验证等实战关键细节。对实战交易有一定参考价值（深度学习+NLP属于Alpha生成方向），但信息不足以判断可直接落地性，故给出中等偏上评分。

title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
abstract: Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline.
summary: FinLLM-KG 是一个模型无关框架，将因果 LLM 与金融知识图谱结合，在推理阶段从 SEC 10-K 文件中注入基于时间、公司层面的知识，无需更新模型权重。上下文以自然语言公司简介或少量相关性排序的事实三元组形式提供，使情绪预测能考虑更广泛的公司层面信息而非仅单篇文章，几乎零计算成本且适用于任何因果 LLM。此外，将文章级情绪分数归因到个别句子和检索到的知识图谱事实，使预测证据可检查，增强可解释性并支持人在回路。

title: Strategyproof Deep Reinforcement Learning for Online Resource Allocation
abstract: Online resource allocation faces two coupled challenges: (1) allocating scarce resources efficiently under uncertain future demand, and (2) ensuring that agents report task valuations and requirements truthfully (strategyproofness). Reinforcement Learning (RL) adapts allocation decisions through experience but does not necessarily ensure strategyproofness. Existing strategyproof RL uses a linear allocation rule, which limits the resource interactions it can represent. Neural mechanism design methods offer greater expressiveness, but provide only approximate incentive guarantees. Against this background, we introduce the first strategyproof deep RL mechanism for online resource allocation. It integrates three novel components: (i) a monotonic neural network that learns nonlinear interactions by construction (higher reported value cannot reduce acceptance, while a longer reported duration or larger resource requirement cannot increase it); (ii) a generalised critical payment: the lowest accepted value, with all other inputs fixed; and (iii) training by either RL or imitation of an existing rule. Together, monotonicity and the critical payment ensure strategyproofness and individual rationality, while the neural rule provides flexibility and imitation improves training efficiency. Empirically, on a four-resource stream with two partner pairs that a linear difference cannot represent, the neural rule achieves 97.8% of an offline welfare upper bound, compared with 93.8% for a linear learner and 89.0% for first-come, first-served, closing 65% and 80% of the remaining optimality gap, respectively. Moreover, imitation reaches 97.5% in only 261 seconds, about 89 times faster than RL.
summary: 该论文研究在线资源分配中兼具策略防伪性（strategyproofness）的深度强化学习机制：提出单调神经网络以保证非线性配置下的激励兼容，采用广义临界支付规则，并通过RL或模仿学习训练。虽属RL与机制设计交叉的较新方向，但应用场景为在线资源分配/拍卖，而非量化交易中的Alpha建模或实盘RL交易，对实战交易直接价值有限，偏理论与方法层面。

title: Contemporaneous Transmission Networks and Systemic Risk in European Banking
abstract: We study how contemporaneous equity-return transmission shapes systemic exposure among 51 listed European banks. Using a recursive non-Gaussian network model on volatility-standardized returns, we construct two market-capitalization-weighted measures based on direct and indirect transmission effects: the Systemic Impact Score (SIS), capturing a bank's potential influence on other institutions, and the Systemic Vulnerability Score (SVS), capturing its exposure to disturbances originating elsewhere. The fitted network reveals distinct transmitting and receiving roles, highlighting differences between institutions with substantial outward influence and those with high incoming sensitivity. Receiving roles are generally more reproducible than transmitting roles across repeated network discovery, and selected connections remain informative about lower-tail dependence in subsequent observations. Volatility standardization substantially reduces detected dependence among recovered shocks, although the full-sample model does not satisfy the designated criterion for supporting shock independence. Alternative recursive orderings also yield comparable directional tail asymmetries, limiting the extent to which these patterns validate a particular ordering. The results provide complementary measures of model-implied systemic transmission and vulnerability, with explicit attention to uncertainty and identification limits
summary: 该论文研究51家欧洲上市银行的同期股票收益传导网络，采用递归非高斯网络模型（基于波动率标准化收益），构建市值加权的系统性影响分数（SIS，衡量银行对他机构的影响力）和系统性脆弱性分数（SVS，衡量其受外部冲击的暴露）。拟合网络揭示传导与接收角色的分化，接收角色在重复网络发现中更可复现，部分连接对后续下尾依赖有信息量；波动率标准化显著降低恢复冲击间的检测依赖，但全样本模型不满足冲击独立性标准，替代递归排序也产生可比的方向性尾部不对称。整体属系统性风险与网络计量研究，对实战交易的直接alpha/RL/深度学习价值有限，评分4。

title: Optimal Order Placement under a State-Dependent Hawkes Process Limit Order Book model
abstract: We study optimal quote placement for a market maker facing order flow modeled by a state-dependent Hawkes process. A block-based linear demand specification links market-order counts to execution volumes, providing the demand moments required by a continuous time discrete state dynamic programming formulation. Under a quadratic terminal inventory penalty, we characterize inventory-dependent quotes and derive backward recursions for the coefficients of a quadratic value function. Numerical experiments using LOBSTER data examine quote distributions, inventory exposure, and terminal wealth. The implemented strategy yields higher aggregate terminal wealth than fixed-spread benchmarks at one and three ticks, but lower wealth than the two-tick benchmark. These results illustrate the framework's numerical implementation and distinguish terminal-wealth comparisons from evaluation under the inventory-penalized objective.
summary: 本文研究做市商在状态依赖Hawkes过程订单流下的最优报价。采用分块线性需求规格将市价单数量与执行量关联，为连续时间离散状态动态规划提供需求矩。在二次终端库存惩罚下，刻画库存依赖报价并推导二次值函数系数的后向递推。基于LOBSTER数据的数值实验考察报价分布、库存暴露与终端财富；策略在一档和三档固定价差基准上获得更高总终端财富，但低于两档基准。结果说明该框架的数值实现，并区分终端财富比较与库存惩罚目标下的评估。

title: A Deep Learning-Driven Operator Splitting Scheme for Free Boundary Problems: An Application to American Option Pricing in Incomplete Markets
abstract: This paper proposes a deep learning-driven operator splitting scheme for high-dimensional free-boundary problems, with American option pricing as a representative application. In a market with proportional transaction costs, a stochastic liquidity risk with an empirically validated nonlinear drift based on S&P 500 data, and two-factor stochastic volatility, the pricing problem takes the form of a five-dimensional highly nonlinear variational inequality. The proposed scheme decomposes this variational inequality at each time layer into an elliptic continuation equation approximated by a physics-informed neural network and a closed-form projection step enforcing the early-exercise constraint. A conditional $\ell^\infty$ stability bound is derived under stated resolvent and Lipschitz assumptions. The scheme is validated against finite-difference and least-squares Monte Carlo benchmarks, and both the option prices and the learned exercise boundary show close agreement with the reference solutions. Sensitivity analyses with respect to the key model parameters are also reported.
summary: 本文提出一种深度学习驱动的算子分裂格式，用于求解高维自由边界问题，以比例交易成本、基于标普500数据实证的非线性漂移随机流动性风险及双因子随机波动率下的美式期权定价为应用场景，定价问题表现为五维高度非线性变分不等式。该格式在每个时间层将变分不等式分解为椭圆延拓方程（用物理信息神经网络近似）与强制执行提前行权约束的闭式投影步，并在给定预解与Lipschitz假设下推导了条件ℓ∞稳定性界。该格式以有限差分和最小二乘蒙特卡洛为基准进行验证，期权价格与学习到的行权边界均与参考解高度吻合，并报告了关键模型参数的敏感性分析。

title: Depositing More Should Not Earn Less: Supplier Income Monotonicity and Rate Curve Design in Pooled Lending Markets
abstract: In utilization dependent interest rate models, adding liquidity can reduce a supplier's total interest income even as the supplier's balance increases. A supplier holding a fraction $α$ of final pool supply keeps income nondecreasing with a marginal deposit exactly when $α(1+η)\leq1$, where $η$ is the elasticity of the borrow rate with respect to utilization. When the condition fails, the supplier can instead raise its income by withdrawing, which pushes utilization further up. On two public Drift markets, a lender held more of the pool than the curve protected in at least one hour in nine on SOL and one in thirteen on USDC. A protocol turns this into a design constraint by choosing, at each utilization, the largest supplier share it intends to protect. That choice caps the elasticity, and integrating the cap describes every admissible curve. Protecting the same share at every utilization gives a power law boundary, and protecting every fresh depositor gives a hyperbolic one. On a multiple kink USDT market, compliant repairs can lower or raise supplier income, because the constraint governs how income responds to a deposit and not the price level.
summary: 本文研究池化借贷市场中利用率依赖利率模型下存款对供应商利息收入非单调的问题：当供应商占最终池供给比例α满足α(1+η)≤1（η为借款利率对利用率的弹性）时，边际存款不降低收入；否则可通过撤资提高收入。作者在Drift两个公开市场实证发现SOL约每9小时有1小时、USDC约每13小时有1小时贷方持仓超过曲线保护上限；进而将问题转为协议设计约束——在每利用率下选定拟保护的最大供应商份额，该选择给出弹性上限，积分该上限可刻画所有可行曲线；恒定保护份额导出幂律边界，保护每个新存款人导出双曲边界；多拐点USDT市场上合规修复可能提高或降低供应商收入，因为约束管理的是收入对存款的响应而非价格水平。该文属于DeFi借贷利率曲线设计的理论与实证分析，提供协议参数与风险约束视角，但对高频/RL/深度学习类实战交易直接Alpha有限，评分4分。

title: The Term Structure of Implied Fee Rates in Liquidity Pools
abstract: We develop a no-arbitrage framework to recover implied fee rates from option-implied information and quantify fee compensation for liquidity providers in automated market maker (AMM) pools. Expected accumulated fees equal the current pool value minus the risk-neutral value of its terminal payoff, reducing forward-looking LP compensation to pricing the LP payoff. We apply the framework to Uniswap v2 and Uniswap v3 ETH--USDC pools using a stochastic-volatility jump-diffusion model calibrated to Deribit options. Implied fee rates are positive, time varying, downward sloping in maturity, and highly sensitive to range design, with tighter near-the-money ranges earning larger implied returns.
summary: 该论文提出一个无套利框架，从期权隐含信息中反推AMM流动性池的隐含费率，并量化LP的费用补偿：预期累计费用等于当前池价值减去其终端收益的风险中性价值，从而将前瞻性LP补偿转化为对LP收益的定价问题。作者将框架应用于Uniswap v2和v3的ETH-USDC池，使用校准至Deribit期权的随机波动率跳扩散模型，发现隐含费率为正、随时间变化、随到期日下降，且对区间设计高度敏感，越窄的平值附近区间隐含收益越高。该研究偏理论与定价，对实战交易的直接Alpha价值有限，但对LP做市与期权对冲结合有一定参考意义。

title: Does Ecosystem Activity Validate TVL?
abstract: Total value locked (TVL) is widely used to assess decentralized finance ecosystems. Prior evidence finds that portfolios formed on TVL alone are spanned by the crypto market portfolio (Brigida 2025). This paper asks whether TVL becomes more informative when combined with measures of adoption, usage, development, protocol revenue, or social attention. I construct weekly value-weighted 2x3 portfolios that independently sort tokens on TVL-to-market-cap and one of seven ecosystem-activity ratios. Portfolio returns are computed from token prices using lagged-market-capitalization weights and evaluated against crypto market and size factors. Across the available 2022-2025 samples, none of the six on-chain double sorts rejects the benchmark after controlling for multiple testing. The same conclusion holds over 83 common weeks for which social-attention data are available. Several specifications reject at unadjusted levels, but none survives Holm adjustment. The social-attention rejection is only marginal under asymptotic inference and is insignificant under a moving-block bootstrap. Equal-weighted portfolios and formal parameter-stability tests lead to the same broad conclusion. The evidence therefore does not show that ecosystem activity reliably transforms TVL into an incremental return signal.
summary: 该论文检验TVL与生态活跃度指标（采用度、使用量、开发、协议收入、社交关注）结合后是否能提供超越加密市场组合的增量信息。构建周度价值加权2x3独立双重排序组合（TVL/市值×七类生态活跃度比率），以滞后市值加权计算收益，并对加密市场与规模因子做基准检验。2022-2025样本中六个链上双重排序均无法在多重检验校正后拒绝基准；社交关注数据可得的83个共同周亦同；部分设定在未校正水平显著，但Holm校正后均不显著，社交关注仅在渐近推断下边际显著、移动区块bootstrap下不显著；等权组合与参数稳定性检验结论一致。结论偏向TVL叠加生态活跃度对实战选币/择时缺乏稳健alpha，属于负面/证伪类实证，对实战直接信号价值有限，但可作为因子构建与多重检验纪律的参考。

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Financial Foundation Models: A Survey
abstract: Financial foundation models increasingly support workflows spanning financial question answering, disclosure analysis, forecasting, and decision-making. In these settings, uncertainty may concern whether evidence is valid and available at the relevant time, whether an interpretation is justified, which outcomes remain plausible, or which action is preferred under costs and risk constraints. Because these objects arise at different points in a workflow, uncertainty cannot be reduced to confidence in a final output. We introduce a source-aware framework that distinguishes six sources of uncertainty across evidence and context, model and inference, and outcome and action, while treating agentic workflows as the execution layer through which uncertainty can propagate, change form, or be reduced. We develop a mechanism-based taxonomy grounded in how methods construct or verify uncertainty and reliability representations, and use it to assess their applicability across financial task domains. We further map finance-specific empirical studies across the taxonomy and task domains to characterize the current research landscape. Our analysis shows that most reviewed studies address uncertainty in individual parts of financial workflows, with limited work connecting evidence and reasoning reliability to downstream prediction and constrained action. By connecting where uncertainty arises, how it is represented, and how it bears on downstream decisions, this survey provides a unified foundation for studying and evaluating uncertainty in financial foundation models.
summary: 该论文是金融基础模型不确定性量化的综述，提出按来源感知的框架，区分证据与上下文、模型与推理、结果与行动三类共六种不确定性来源，并将智能体工作流视为不确定性传播、变形或消减的执行层；建立基于机制的分类体系，评估各方法在金融任务领域的适用性，并映射金融实证研究以刻画研究现状。论文偏理论综述，未提出可直接用于实战的RL/深度学习/Alpha策略或交易信号，对量化实战价值有限。

title: Evaluating the Predictive Validity of ICT's Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) Model on CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100 Futures
abstract: To our knowledge, this paper provides the first systematic quantitative evaluation of the ICT Accumulation-Manipulation-Distribution (AMD) model on CME E-Mini NASDAQ-100 futures (NQ). The AMD model proposes that institutional participants structure intraday price delivery in three phases: overnight accumulation in the Asian session, a deliberate false breakout during London, and directional delivery to the opposing liquidity pool during the New York morning session. Using four years of real 15-minute OHLCV data from Databento (January 2022 to July 2026), we operationalize the AMD rules into a strict mechanical strategy and analyze the statistical properties of the resulting signal across N = 484 manipulation signal days using chi-square testing, Benjamini-Hochberg multiple comparisons correction, and regime-conditional analysis. Three principal findings emerge. First, the AMD manipulation signal fires on 44% of trading days. Second, 57% of valid signals see full target delivery before the 9:40 AM New York entry window opens, revealing a structural mismatch between the model's timing assumptions and actual price delivery. Third, within this operationalization of the AMD model, no directional information beyond the daily trend regime was observed: when the signal aligns with the trend it is correct 62-71% of the time (Cohen's h = 0.23-0.43); when it opposes the trend it is correct only 25-30% of the time (Cohen's h = 0.42-0.53). All four trending-regime cells survive Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Key findings are robust to variation in the manipulation breach threshold (5-20 NQ points), Asia range filter percentile, and stop buffer. The regime-dependent signal pattern constitutes a specific, testable hypothesis for follow-on research.
summary: 该论文首次对ICT的AMD（吸筹-操纵-派发）模型在CME E-Mini纳斯达克100期货（NQ）上进行系统性量化检验：使用Databento四年（2022年1月至2026年7月）15分钟OHLCV数据，将AMD规则机械化为严格策略，对484个操纵信号日使用卡方检验、Benjamini-Hochberg多重比较校正及制度条件分析。核心发现：AMD操纵信号在44%的交易日触发；57%的有效信号在纽约9:40 AM入场窗口开启前即完成全部目标派发，揭示模型时间假设与实际价格派发之间的结构性错配；在该操作化下，AMD模型未显示出统计显著的预测有效性。对实战价值有限：属于对流行散户交易理论的证伪性检验，结论偏负面，未提供可盈利的alpha或可部署策略，但可作为风险提示与避免误用ICT框架的参考。

title: SLAB: Time-Lag-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling in PPVC Module Factories
abstract: Prefabricated prefinished volumetric construction (PPVC) builds room-sized modules in factories that operate as flexible job shops. A module waits 12 to 48 h after casting, waterproofing, and painting, while its station is free for other modules. Existing learned dispatchers release the next operation before this wait ends, so their plans need repair. This paper presents SLAB (Scheduling under time-Lags with an Admissible Bound), a decision process for dispatchers trained by deep reinforcement learning. Its transition releases a module only after its wait, and its reward is the decrease of a proven lower bound that includes the waits. Training on 10-module orders with halved waits also teaches the policy the station contention of larger orders. On three existing networks, repaired plans are 42% to 133% longer than the same network's schedules inside SLAB. On orders generated from Singapore's PPVC guidebook, one trained policy gives schedules 2.2% to 8.1% shorter than the shortest-processing-time rule at 10 to 80 modules. At 50 and 80 modules, it outperforms a time-lag memetic algorithm by 6.7% and 7.4% and constraint-programming search started from that rule's schedule and given 600 s by 6.6% and 7.6%. The memetic algorithm gives shorter schedules on orders of 10 modules, and the same search given 300 s on orders of 10 and 20 modules. A module factory can therefore train one dispatcher on small orders and run it without a solver on production batches of 50 to 80 modules.
summary: 论文提出SLAB——一种面向PPVC模块工厂柔性作业车间调度的、考虑时间滞后的深度强化学习调度框架。其核心是：在铸造、防水、喷漆后模块需等待12-48小时，期间工位空出，现有学习型调度器过早释放下一道工序导致计划需修复；SLAB将状态转移设计为仅在等待结束后释放模块，并以包含等待时间的可证下界下降量作为奖励，用10模块订单及减半等待时间训练以学习大订单的工位争用。实验显示：在三个现有网络上，修复后的计划比SLAB内网络调度长42%-133%；在按新加坡PPVC指南生成的10-80模块订单上，训练策略比最短加工时间规则短2.2%-8.1%，在50与80模块上比时间滞后模因算法分别优6.7%与7.4%，并优于以该规则调度为初始解、给定60（摘要截断）的约束规划搜索。该文属调度优化领域的RL应用，与金融实战交易（Alpha/高频/组合）无关，但对'带时间滞后与资源释放约束'的建模、下界塑形奖励、以及在仿真到实际分布外迁移的训练技巧，对交易执行调度与订单释放时机建模有一定方法论借鉴价值，故给4分。

title: Det-MASO: Diversity-Regularized Multi-Agent Sequential Optimization for Factor Generation
abstract: Quantitative investment requires alpha factors that are both predictive and diverse. However, existing factor generation methods, including formulaic mining and neural end-to-end models, are mostly based on a single-agent design, which limits exploration of the factor space and reduces adaptability to changing markets. Multi-agent approaches can broaden exploration, but agents trained under a shared objective often collapse to similar outputs, while existing diversity techniques either scale poorly with asset-universe size or address redundancy only after training. We propose a multi-agent sequential optimization (Det-MASO) framework for generating diversified, context-adaptive alpha factors. It introduces a differentiable log-determinant penalty on the inter-agent correlation matrix directly into the joint objective, discouraging correlated agent behavior during training with computational cost that scales linearly with the number of assets. We further show that this penalty prevents homogeneous equilibria and preserves factor diversity throughout optimization, while a context-conditioned scheduler dynamically adjusts agent emphasis across market regimes and Shapley interaction index analysis is used to characterize the cooperation structure that emerges among them. Experiments show that Det-MASO outperforms baselines, improving the information coefficient by 1.1\%, the annualized return by 6.4\%, and the Sharpe ratio by 0.33.
summary: 该论文提出Det-MASO框架，用于生成兼具预测性与多样性的alpha因子。核心创新在于将可微的对数行列式惩罚项直接加入多智能体联合目标，对智能体间相关性矩阵施加约束，从而在训练过程中抑制智能体行为趋同，且计算成本随资产数量线性增长；理论上证明该惩罚可避免同质化均衡并在优化全程保持因子多样性。此外，引入上下文条件调度器，根据市场状态动态调整各智能体权重，并结合Shapley交互进行配置。整体属于深度学习/多智能体因子挖掘方向，对实战alpha研究有较高参考价值，但摘要未给出实证回测数据，故评分7分。

title: Deep reinforcement learning for dynamic strategy interchange in financial markets: X. Zhong et al.
abstract: … in financial trading. Our experiments highlight its potential to transform quantitative trading by … FSRL offers a deep reinforcement learning-based trading model with dynamic strategy-…
summary: 该论文提出FSRL——一种基于深度强化学习的交易模型，支持动态策略切换（dynamic strategy interchange），旨在适应金融市场变化。实验显示其在量化交易中具有改造潜力，但摘要未披露具体收益、回撤、交易成本等实战关键指标。属于RL+交易的实战研究方向，有一定参考价值，但缺乏可验证的实盘/回测细节，故评为7分。

title: Compiling and forecasting implied volatility surfaces via survey sampling, tempered inverse-probability sequence learning, and causal activity clocks
abstract: Compiling implied volatility (IV) surfaces and forecasting derivative risk from high-frequency equity and options feeds requires addressing contract heterogeneity, schema shifts, volatility clustering, and non-stationary trading activity. Using a split-adjusted NVIDIA (NVDA) equity and options panel (2018-2025), this study integrates finite-population survey sampling, tempered inverse-probability sequence learning, and causal activity clocks. Four findings emerge. First, cross-sectional surface accuracy depends on matching the sampling design to the target functional: plug-in stratified allocations using lagged cell dispersion improve equal-weighted surface reconstruction with full grid coverage, whereas liquidity-weighted probability proportional to size (PPS) sampling excels on liquidity-weighted targets by construction yet inflates error when misapplied. Second, in longitudinal LSTM sequence training, PPS and Neyman designs retain more tail-volatility windows than simple random sampling (SRS); all three designs are equivalent to full-census training within chosen margins while cutting training time, though incremental forecasting gains of informative selection over SRS are not established. Third, out-of-sample evaluation shows a predictability contrast: short-horizon prices are not forecastable beyond a random walk with drift among tested models, whereas forward IV shows descriptive mean-reversion skill concentrated in a few post-shock reversal sessions (insignificant under session-clustered tests), with sequence models not beating a linear HAR-IV benchmark and feature pruning driving stability. Fourth, across a 6.3x start-to-end (nearly twentyfold trough-to-peak) price expansion, rolling volume and dollar clocks stabilize bar rates and compress intraday return kurtosis beyond diurnal scaling.
summary: 论文基于NVDA 2018-2025股票与期权面板，整合有限总体调查抽样、温度化逆概率序列学习与因果活动时钟，构建IV曲面并预测衍生品风险。核心发现：横截面曲面精度取决于抽样设计与目标泛函的匹配——滞后单元离散度的分层分配提升等权曲面重建与全覆盖，流动性加权PPS在流动性加权目标上占优但误用会放大误差；纵向LSTM训练中PPS与Neyman设计保留更多尾部波动窗口，三种设计与全普查训练在给定边际内等价且缩短训练时间，但信息性选择相对SRS的增量预测收益有限。属深度学习+抽样工程结合的实证策略研究，对IV曲面构建与训练效率有实战参考价值，但方法偏统计抽样与序列学习工程，缺乏可直接部署的alpha/RL交易信号，故评分6。

title: Tracking High-Frequency Trading Activity in China and Its Effects on Market Quality
abstract: We develop a new order-level proxy for high-frequency trading (HFT) activity based on precise order placement and study its effects on market quality. With quotes updating multiple times per second, millisecond-level order-book access makes high-frequency traders more likely to submit active exact-match orders, defined as limit orders priced exactly at the prevailing best opposite-side quote. Using Shenzhen Stock Exchange data, we validate the proxy: active exact-match orders respond faster to quote updates, cancel more rapidly, concentrate when depth imbalance is favorable and spreads are narrow, and predict mid-quote returns from 100 milliseconds through ten minutes. A difference-in-differences design exploiting cross-channel variation in order dissemination latency at the market open shows that lower latency increases active exact-match shares. This variation yields plausibly causal evidence that latency-induced HFT raises short-horizon price variation, wide-spread incidence, and adverse-selection exposure, while realized spreads decline and pricing error falls modestly. Unlike developed markets, China's T+1 constraint, absence of maker-taker rebates, and limits on rapid quote revision tilt speed advantages toward directional liquidity taking, highlighting how market design shapes the channel through which speed affects market quality.
summary: 论文提出基于订单级数据的中国高频交易(HFT)新代理指标：主动精确匹配订单（限价单价格恰好等于当前最优对手价），并用深交所数据验证其响应报价更新更快、撤单更快、在深度失衡有利且价差窄时集中出现，并能预测100毫秒至10分钟的中价收益。利用开盘时跨通道订单传播延迟差异做双重差分，发现更低延迟提高该订单占比，进而提供疑似因果证据：延迟驱动的HFT提高短周期价格波动、宽价差发生率和逆向选择暴露，同时实现价差下降、定价误差小幅降低；并指出中国T+1、无maker-taker返佣、快速报价限制等制度差异。对实战交易价值中等：其HFT活动代理与短周期收益预测可用于微观结构信号构建和延迟/执行策略评估，但缺少可直接落地的策略回测与成本收益分析，偏市场质量实证。

title: Weekend Crypto Volatility and Monday Market Risk
abstract: Cryptocurrencies trade continuously while major traditional markets close over the weekend. We examine whether weekend cryptocurrency volatility predicts Monday variance in equity, commodity and fixed-income markets. Using daily range-based variance measures for Bitcoin, Ether, XRP, the S&P 500, gold and a US Treasury ETF over 2017-2026, we augment heterogeneous autoregressive models with a common weekend cryptocurrency factor. Predictive content is weak before 2024 but significant thereafter. In the post-2024 sample, a one-standard-deviation increase in the factor is associated with 27-54% higher fitted Monday variance. Adding the factor reduces out-of-sample QLIKE losses by 11-22%, although statistical evidence varies across markets. Friday cryptocurrency volatility does not reproduce the result, and coin-specific variation adds no significant predictive information beyond the common factor. An endogenous procedure estimates a break in late 2023, during growing anticipation of US spot-Bitcoin ETF approval. However, ETF-flow interactions provide no evidence of amplification through greater measured Monday flow activity, leaving the mechanism unresolved. The findings suggest that calendar-specific volatility measures reveal predictive information that aggregate connectedness measures may obscure.
summary: 论文研究周末加密货币波动率能否预测周一股票、商品和固定收益市场的方差。使用2017-2026年比特币、以太坊、XRP、标普500、黄金和美债ETF的日度区间方差，在HAR模型中引入共同周末加密因子。结果显示：2024年前预测力弱，2024年后显著——因子每增加一个标准差，周一拟合方差提高27-54%，样本外QLIKE损失降低11-22%（但统计显著性因市场而异）；周五加密波动率无此效果，币种特定差异无增量信息；内生断点检测显示2023年末出现结构断裂（对应美国现货比特币ETF审批预期），但ETF资金流交互项未发现放大机制，机制仍未厘清。对实战交易而言，提供了跨市场周末风险传导的可操作预测信号，但机制不明、样本期短且统计证据不稳，属中等偏上参考价值，尚不足以直接支撑独立策略。

title: Certifying Reward Alignment in Portfolio Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Financial reinforcement learning often translates an investment objective into an additive risk-adjusted reward. An agent can optimise that reward accurately yet implement a different financial preference. We develop a decision audit for terminal mean-variance equilibrium that separates reward misspecification from learning error. In a finite exogenous-state market, we bound the gain from changing one action using actor, reward and continuation-critic residuals. The certificate ignores state-constant critic offsets, accommodates convex action constraints, and has an independent-sample extension that does not require the equilibrium policy. A continuation-aware actor-critic method estimates the future-policy correction from samples. Across nine controlled markets and twenty seeds, it reduces policy distance by and one-step deviation gain by relative to a matched myopic-reward network. A separate PPO comparison tests the same reward intervention within a standard optimiser. Historical tests cross seven covariance estimators and 10, 30 and 49 US industry portfolios over 432 months: joint reward calibration preserves each fitted mean-variance target, but does not improve realised investment performance. Together, these results provide a way to quantify whether a learned decision implements its stated financial objective, separately from how well that objective performs in a backtest.
summary: 该论文提出一种决策审计方法，用于在终端均值-方差均衡下将奖励设定错误与学习误差分离，通过actor、奖励和延续critic残差界定改变单一动作的收益上界；证书忽略状态常数critic偏移、支持凸动作约束，并有无需均衡策略的独立样本扩展；提出延续感知actor-critic方法从样本估计未来策略修正。实验在九个受控市场、二十个随机种子上相对匹配的短视奖励网络降低策略距离与一步偏离收益，并用PPO对比同一奖励干预；历史测试覆盖七种协方差估计量与10/30/49个美国行业组合共432个月，联合奖励校准保持拟合均值-方差目标但不提升实际投资收益。属组合RL reward对齐的理论/审计框架，有实证但未展示alpha或实战盈利提升，偏理论偏方法，实战价值中等，评5分。

title: Deep reinforcement learning applied to a sparse-reward trading environment with intraday data
abstract: … reinforcement learning (DRL) has made remarkable strides in empowering computational models to tackle intricate decision-making tasks. In quantitative trading, DRL trading … trading …
summary: 该论文将深度强化学习（DRL）应用于稀疏奖励（sparse-reward）的日内交易（intraday data）环境，探索DRL在量化交易决策中的表现。核心价值在于处理日内高频、奖励稀疏场景下的智能体训练问题，属于RL在交易中的方法性研究，但摘要信息有限、未见明确实盘验证或稳定Alpha证据，故对实战交易的直接参考价值中等。

title: Financial technical indicator and algorithmic trading strategy based on machine learning and alternative data
abstract: … it is necessary to use it in a trading strategy and then evaluate the corresponding results. Therefore, we created two algorithmic trading strategies based on the Signal Screener: this is a …
summary: 该论文提出了一种基于机器学习与另类数据的金融技术指标，并构建了名为Signal Screener的信号筛选器。作者强调指标必须嵌入交易策略并进行结果评估，因此基于Signal Screener创建了两个算法交易策略，并对其表现进行了回测/评估。核心贡献在于将机器学习衍生的技术指标落地为可执行的算法交易策略，但摘要未披露具体模型架构、数据源细节与样本外绩效，实战价值中等。

title: Fuji: The Shape, Composition, and Spread of Demand Bursts on Robinhood Chain
abstract: Demand on blockchain-based marketplaces arrives in bursts and at a high rate. On these platforms the data are completely visible, which makes it feasible to compare the bursty demand against the usual load. The congestion manifests as an increased demand for gas, the primary resource a blockchain sells. Existing studies consider how to price the gas. The demand itself, and what it is made of during bursts, has not been measured. We measure it on Robinhood Chain, a layer-2 blockchain that quickly became a venue for trading tokenized equities and memecoins. We collected the data from every block of its first three active months and more than 50 million Uniswap swaps that occurred during bursty periods. We find that a burst trades about as many pools as a quiet period, mostly different ones, and trades them harder, on top of elevated demand that accumulated for hours. With the bursts aligned on their peaks, the median peak is 2.5 times the usual load. Both the rise and the fall of the demand are described by the sum of two exponential functions with different timescales, a slow one of hours and a fast one of minutes. Against a matched quiet period, a burst has 1.05 times the pools, 1.40 times the trades, and 1.21 times the senders. We use two models to explain the arrival of bursts: externally triggered cascades and self-excitation. The former fits the data relatively better. Inside a burst, the entry of each trader into a pool is followed for about 24 seconds by more entries than the existing traders predict. Whether this is because of imitation or because of a shared signal is left open.
summary: 论文测量了Robinhood Chain（面向代币化股票和memecoin的L2）上线前三个月每个区块及超5000万笔Uniswap swap，刻画需求爆发的形态、构成与扩散：爆发期交易的池数量与平静期相近但多为不同池、单池强度更高，并叠加数小时累积的额外需求；对齐峰值后中位峰值为常规负载2.5倍；涨落均可用两个不同时间尺度的指数函数之和描述（慢尺度数小时、快尺度数分钟）。属于链上市场微观结构/需求刻画类实证研究，为gas定价与拥堵建模提供依据，但未提出可直接落地的交易信号或策略，对实战交易的直接alpha价值有限。

title: Scenario Matching for Credit Dependence Stress Tests: Temporal correlation constraints and empirical risk bounds
abstract: We couple two sets of simulated market and credit paths by minimizing absolute temporal-correlation error relative to a prescribed target. Each market path receives exactly one credit path, preserving both empirical distributions of complete scenarios. A perfect-matching test identifies whether a uniform correlation-error tolerance is feasible and determines its smallest attainable value. Further assignments give exact empirical mean-loss and exceedance-probability bounds; quantile bounds follow by binary search over eligible loss thresholds. A synthetic bond-forward credit stress test illustrates the method. The experiments report matching precision, empirical score tails and exposure-grid error, and measure matching and mean-loss computation. The method is independent of the scenario generator and provides a reproducible way to examine dependence assumptions in existing risk engines. Tail measures concern default-probability-weighted credit scores. Accompanying reproducibility package (Python code, synthetic scenario libraries, permutations, and benchmarks) is attached in the ZIP archive.
summary: 该论文提出一种情景匹配方法，通过最小化时变相关性误差，将模拟的市场与信用路径耦合，用于信用依赖压力测试。方法包含完美匹配检验以判断统一相关性误差容忍度的可行性，并给出经验平均损失与超限概率的精确边界，分位数边界通过二分搜索获得。实验以合成债券-远期信用压力测试为例，报告匹配精度、经验分数尾部与敞口网格误差，并测量匹配与损失计算耗时；方法独立于情景生成器，可复现地检验现有风险引擎中的依赖假设。尾部度量针对违约概率加权的信用评分。整体偏风险管理/压力测试方法论，与RL/深度学习/Alpha等实战策略关联弱，故给4分。

title: Do Round Numbers Hold Prices? Occupation Densities and Depth-Conditioned Hazards in the Limit Order Book
abstract: Prices cluster at round numbers, a pattern often interpreted as evidence that these levels act as price barriers. This pattern also admits a mechanical explanation: more liquidity rests there, and prices take longer to leave deeper queues. Limit order book data allow us to distinguish these mechanisms through a tick-grid framework in which local time counts departures and level-wise volatility reflects the departure hazard. Using data for five Nasdaq stocks throughout 2025, we find that round levels attract more liquidity but do not exhibit longer depth-adjusted durations. Intel and SoFi show directional effects, with departures biased away from round levels.
summary: 论文研究限价订单簿中价格在整数关口聚集的现象，区分两种机制：一是整数位作为价格屏障的行为解释，二是流动性更深导致停留更久的机械解释。作者用tick网格框架，以局部时间计数离开次数、逐档波动率反映离开风险，使用2025年五只纳斯达克股票数据，发现整数位吸引更多流动性，但经深度调整后的停留时长并不更长；Intel和SoFi显示方向性效应，离开偏向远离整数位。对实战的启示有限：整数位流动性更厚这一事实可用于挂单/排队与滑点估计，但“整数位屏障”不宜作为独立alpha或反转信号；属于实证微观结构研究，非可直接交易的策略框架。

title: Jensen gaps and the decomposition principle
abstract: We provide axiomatic characterizations of Jensen-gap functionals, which have the form $ρ(X)=\mathbb{E}[f(X)]-f(\mathbb{E}[X])$ for some real-valued function $f$ called the generator. This class includes important examples such as the excess growth rate, the utility premium, the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence, and the variance, and is also closely related to measures of variability. We analyze various forms of convexity for Jensen gaps. To characterize Jensen gaps, we formulate conditional versions of law-invariant functionals, which are needed to state the decomposition principle. On an atomless probability space, we show that law invariance together with a binary decomposition principle is sufficient to characterize Jensen gaps on simple random variables. Under suitable continuity conditions, the characterization extends to broader classes, including compactly supported random variables and integrable random variables. We then identify the generator $f$ by imposing either of two natural invariance conditions: scaling invariance or translation invariance. The former identifies logarithmic, $x\log x$, and power generators, whereas the latter identifies exponential and quadratic generators.
summary: 本文为Jensen gap泛函（形式为ρ(X)=E[f(X)]-f(E[X])）提供公理化刻画，涵盖超额增长率、效用溢价、KL散度与方差等例子。论文分析Jensen gap的各类凸性，提出条件化版本的法不变泛函以表述分解原理，证明在无原子概率空间上，法不变性加二元分解原理足以在简单随机变量上刻画Jensen gap，并在适当连续性条件下推广至紧支撑与可积随机变量；随后通过缩放不变性或平移不变性识别生成函数f（对数、xlogx、幂、指数、二次型）。该工作属纯理论数学金融，未涉及交易信号、回测或实证，对实战交易直接价值有限，但为风险度量和绩效归因提供理论工具。

title: Cross-Bond Panel Learning for Next-Day Price Forecasting of Chinese Convertible Bonds: A Reality Check
abstract: Recent advances in financial machine learning have prompted growing interest in applying deep neural networks to convertible bond valuation and forecasting. However, existing studies often focus on in-sample valuation fit or cross-sectional return rankings, leaving out-of-sample next-day price forecasting insufficiently benchmarked against persistence. This paper provides a comprehensive empirical reality check on cross-bond panel learning for Chinese convertible bonds. Using a daily panel of 73,806 observations across 100 A-share convertible bonds from 2022 to 2025, we evaluate whether cross-bond neural architectures reliably outperform the random walk under strict temporal splitting, boundary purging, fold-specific preprocessing, and dependence-aware inference. On the 29,514-observation holdout, the random walk achieves an RMSE of 2.3577 CNY. Five-seed ensembles of small and large price-change MLPs yield RMSEs of 2.3619 and 2.3645 CNY, with negative out-of-sample R^2 values (-0.0035 and -0.0057) and target-date clustered HAC p-values of 0.453 and 0.248. Ten-day circular block-bootstrap intervals span zero, while direct price-level training degrades performance substantially. Although cross-bond pooling provides a variance-stabilizing shrinkage effect over single-bond estimation (lowering test RMSE for 79 of 90 individual bonds), it fails to produce an aggregate forecast advantage over persistence. Error decomposition reveals that failure is not uniform: five highly volatile, clause-sensitive bonds account for 74.4% of the model's total excess squared error. Without contemporaneous equity market information or explicit contractual event conditioning, deep panel architectures do not deliver incremental next-day predictability over persistence.
summary: 本文对中国可转债的跨债面板学习进行严格的样本外“现实检验”：使用2022–2025年100只A股可转债共73,806条日度面板数据，在严格时间切分、边界清洗、按折预处理和依赖感知推断下，评估跨债神经网络能否稳定跑赢随机游走。在29,514条留出样本上，随机游走RMSE为2.3577元；小/大价格变动MLP的五种子集成RMSE分别为2.3619和2.3645元，样本外R^2为负（-0.0035、-0.0057），目标日聚类HAC p值为0.453和0.248；十天循环块自举区间跨零，直接训练价格水平显著变差。结论是深度学习并未显著优于持久性基准。对实战价值有限：无alpha、无RL，主要贡献是负面基准与警示，提醒勿轻信复杂模型的样本内拟合或横截面排序。

title: A Stationary Mean-Field Model for Carbon Market Stability Reserve
abstract: We formulate the design of a market stability reserve as a stationary mean-field singular control problem. The allowance balance follows a regime-switching diffusion, while the regulator injects or withdraws allowances through bounded-variation controls. The objective trades off the average allowance balance, its stationary dispersion, deviations from a long-run target, and intervention costs. The optimal policy is a regime-dependent band rule characterized by four reflecting thresholds. Its computation reduces to a scalar fixed-point problem combining a coupled variational inequality with the invariant distribution of the reflected process. A calibration to the EU ETS yields thresholds of the same order of magnitude as the existing Market Stability Reserve rule. Comparative statics show that volatility is the main determinant of the intervention band, whereas the frequency and duration of crisis regimes have limited effects. A simpler two-threshold policy based on average regime dynamics closely reproduces the optimal regime-dependent policy in terms of liquidity and intervention volumes.
summary: 本文将碳市场稳定储备（MSR）的设计建模为平稳均值场奇异控制问题：配额余额服从区制转换扩散过程，监管者通过有界变差控制注入或撤回配额，目标权衡平均配额余额、其平稳离散度、对长期目标的偏离及干预成本。最优策略为具有四个反射阈值的区制依赖带状规则，计算归结为耦合变分不等式与反射过程不变分布的标量不动点问题。基于EU ETS的校准得到的阈值与现有MSR规则量级相当；比较静态显示波动率是干预带宽的主要决定因素，而危机区制的频率与持续时间影响有限；基于平均区制动态的简化双阈值策略在流动性与干预量上可较好复现最优区制依赖策略。

title: A unified benchmark of statistical, machine learning, and deep learning approaches for S&P 500 index forecasting
abstract: … the most challenging problems in quantitative finance due to the … Deep learning architectures such as LSTM and CNN–LSTM … significantly to predictive performance than trading volume. …
summary: 该论文针对标普500指数预测，统一基准比较了统计模型、机器学习与深度学习（含LSTM、CNN-LSTM等架构），核心发现是深度学习架构对预测性能有显著贡献，且价格类特征的重要性高于交易量特征。研究属于预测方法论的基准评测，偏学术与实证，未涉及强化学习、组合构建或实盘执行细节，对实战交易的直接可落地价值有限。

title: Financial Context-Rich Strategy for Actor-Critic based Agents: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for Stock Trading
abstract: In modern financial markets, more than 3/4th of the large volume trade is executed by algorithmic trading based on advanced trading strategies to attain higher precision and speed than traditional human traders. The conventional strategies focused on price-based indicators are inadequate in capturing the market dynamism arising from real-world events such as social sentiments, political instability, or sudden economic shifts. With the rise of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) and data availability, there is a requirement for more efficient algorithms that can incorporate these external factors in trading strategies. DRL has shown potential in simulating real-world scenarios and in simplifying complex decision-making since DRL agents can automate the trading process i.e. executing trades in a manner comparable to human traders. They have shown reliable performance since they can update their policies based on risk and quantitative factors. In this paper, we propose a DRL approach based on partial and deep-infusion of sentimental analysis. It features distinct policy designs of actor-critic-based agents: only policy optimization (A2C & PPO) and policy optimization along with Q-learning principles (DDPG, TD3 & SAC). Our findings reveal, that the agents based on policy optimization combined with Q-learning, significantly and consistently demonstrate improved performance upon sentiment deep-infusion in profit maximization as well as risk-averse trading.
summary: 该论文提出一种基于情感分析部分与深度注入的DRL方法，设计actor-critic类智能体（A2C、PPO及结合Q-learning的策略优化）用于股票交易，将社会情绪、政治不稳定、经济突变等外生因素纳入交易策略以弥补纯价格指标的不足。属于RL+另类数据的实证方向，具备一定实战参考价值，但摘要未给出回测、成本、滑点及实盘验证细节，且仅摘要信息有限，故评为6分。

title: Optimal Size in Market Making under State-Dependent Hawkes Process
abstract: We study market making with a parametric model of executed volume that accounts for quote placement and state-dependent order flow. Executed volume is expressed as the product of an average order size, an exponential demand function, and a Prony-series multiplier depending on quote depth, market-order count constructed from a state-dependent Hawkes model. An approximation result for finite Prony sums on a compact state domain provides a mathematical basis for the representation. An empirical study of limit-order-book data examines the calibrated demand and intensity models, sensitivity to inventory restrictions, and the resulting placement policies. In retrospective evaluations conditional on realised order-flow paths, the selected calibration achieves higher terminal utility than a baseline while respecting the prescribed inventory bound. The comparisons also distinguish the contribution of trading revenues from that of inventory control. The resulting closed-form volume specification takes placement levels as inputs and can therefore be used with alternative quoting rules.
summary: 本文研究做市中的最优报价规模，提出一个参数化的成交量模型：成交量由平均订单规模、指数需求函数与Prony级数乘子相乘构成，其中乘子依赖报价深度及基于状态依赖Hawkes模型构建的市价单数量。作者证明了紧致状态域上有限Prony和的一个近似结果，为模型表示提供数学依据。基于限价订单簿数据的实证研究检验了校准后的需求与强度模型、对库存约束的敏感性以及由此得到的报价策略；在条件于已实现订单流路径的回溯评估中，所选校准在遵守库存上限的前提下实现了高于基准的终端效用，并区分了交易收益与库存控制的贡献。该闭式成交量设定以报价水平为输入，可与其它报价规则配合使用。整体属偏理论/实证的做市微观结构工作，对实盘做市报价与库存管理有一定参考价值，但非RL/深度学习/alpha类，实战迁移性中等。

title: On the continuity of conditional distributions and stratification for derivative pricing
abstract: Stratification can reduce the estimator variance in Monte Carlo simulations by partitioning the sample space according to a low-dimensional factor and sampling separately within the resulting strata, making it well suited to the valuation of path-dependent claims in high-dimensional financial models. Its performance, however, depends critically on the choice of the stratification factor, and effective low-dimensional factors are generally difficult to identify in complex continuous-time models. Neural networks provide a flexible approximation class for this purpose and have proved useful in related variance-reduction problems in quantitative finance. In this paper, we study the construction of neural stratification factors for derivative pricing under proportional allocation in continuous-time models. Since the numerical construction of a stratification factor typically involves approximation, we establish continuity results for the associated conditional expectations and, more generally, conditional distributions, and provide several counterexamples showing the limits of this continuity theory. Combined with density results for neural networks, our findings yield a universal approximation theorem for admissible stratification factors. We conclude with numerical experiments involving a constant-maturity-swap range accrual in a two-factor Gaussian short-rate model and a worst-of autocallable in a Wishart stochastic covariance model, where the learned factors outperform all considered benchmarks.
summary: 该论文研究在连续时间模型下为衍生品定价构建神经网络分层因子，以减少蒙特卡洛估计方差；作者建立了相关条件期望与条件分布的连续性结果，并给出若干反例说明该连续性理论的局限，结合神经网络密度结果得到通用逼近结论。属于蒙特卡洛方差缩减与数值方法的理论研究，对实战交易（RL/深度学习/Alpha）直接价值有限。

title: Optimal collective investment under regulatory uncertainty
abstract: We study optimal collective investment subject to a Value-at-Risk (VaR)-type constraint that accounts for uncertainty about future regulatory requirements. The constraint incorporates several possible wealth thresholds and imposes a minimum weighted average probability of meeting them. We characterize the optimal terminal wealth, which combines regions of constant wealth at regulatory thresholds with Merton-type investment regions. Unlike a classical VaR constraint with only one threshold, our formulation generates protection against several thresholds. For two possible thresholds, we identify when both are protected and when protection concentrates on the larger one. Numerical results show that the regulatory constraint can substantially reshape the optimal payoff and generate large welfare losses relative to unconstrained investment when the required compliance probability is high, even the smaller wealth threshold is high, or initial capital is limited. In heterogeneous investor pools, welfare losses depend strongly on the composition of the risk aversions and the Pareto weights governing risk sharing. Losses are particularly pronounced when highly risk-averse investors dominate the pool. Moreover, investors with smaller capital contributions can bear disproportionately large shares of the total welfare loss, while larger contributors may bear less than their capital-proportional share. Thus, regulatory uncertainty not only reduces aggregate welfare but can also create substantial disparities in how its costs are distributed among investors.
summary: 研究在VaR型约束下（考虑未来监管要求不确定性）的最优集体投资问题。约束包含多个可能的 wealth 阈值，并要求满足这些阈值的最低加权平均概率。刻画了最优终端财富，其结构为在监管阈值处的常数财富区域与 Merton 型投资区域的组合。与仅含单一阈值的经典 VaR 约束不同，该设定可对多个阈值提供保护；对两个阈值情形，给出何时两者均被保护、何时保护集中于较大阈值。数值结果表明：当合规概率要求较高、较小财富阈值也较高或初始资本有限时，监管约束会显著重塑最优收益结构，并相对无约束投资产生较大福利损失。在异质投资者池中，福利损失强烈依赖于风险厌恶构成与支配风险分担的 Pareto 权重，尤其在高风险厌恶投资者占主导时损失更明显。

title: Duality of Shortfall Aversion
abstract: Shortfall aversion describes a form of consumption habit formation in which an individual's utility depends on consumption relative to the historical consumption peak. This study develops a duality framework for a broad class of utility functions, with and without discounting, avoiding the need for determining the local optimality required by the HJB approaches commonly adopted in the literature. We show that shortfall aversion can instead be incorporated directly into the dual problem through a singular-control mechanism characterized by a variational inequality. Furthermore, we establish that the resulting value function strictly dominates those obtained in the existing literature while remaining attainable under an admissible optimal control. We demonstrate that the suboptimality of existing solutions stems from their myopic treatment of updates to the consumption peak, whereas our duality approach enlarges the admissible class to treat the consumption peak as a separate nondecreasing control and determines its optimal evolution through duality, accounting for future consumption opportunities. These results reveal a previously unrecognized advantage of the dual formulation and provide a more general and flexible framework for consumption optimization under shortfall aversion.
summary: 本文为短fall厌恶（消费习惯形成）效用建立对偶框架，采用奇异控制与变分不等式刻画，避免HJB局部最优性求解，证明所得值函数严格优于现有文献且可由可行最优控制达到，并指出既有解的次优性源于对消费峰值更新的短视处理。属随机控制/效用理论层面的纯理论工作，未涉及RL、深度学习或Alpha生成等实战信号，对实战交易价值有限，评4分。

title: Mimicking Volatilities under Marginal Constraints via $q_x$-Bass Martingales: A Parallel Computing Approach
abstract: We study the calibration of continuous-time martingale models to observed derivative prices via a dynamic martingale optimal transport problem that penalizes deviations from the volatility of a prescribed reference model. Using $q_x$-Bass martingales, we approximate this problem through a sequence of discrete-time problems and prove that the continuous-time interpolations of their optimizers are asymptotically optimal. Building on the theory of $q_x$-Bass martingales, we develop numerical methods for the discrete-time problems that do not require full marginal distributions at calibration maturities.
summary: 本文研究连续时间鞅模型对已观测衍生品价格的校准问题，将其建模为动态鞅最优传输问题，并对偏离参考模型波动率的程度施加惩罚。作者利用 q_x-Bass 鞅，将问题近似为一系列离散时间问题，并证明其优化器的连续时间插值具有渐近最优性。基于 q_x-Bass 鞅理论，作者还发展了离散时间问题的数值方法，这些方法不需要在全校准期限上拥有完整的边际分布。

title: Stock Price Prediction Using Transformers
abstract: … study focuses on the capabilities of Transformer architecture to handle intricate, non-linear trends effectively. Traditional approaches to stock prediction, including autoregressive and …
summary: 该论文研究Transformer架构在股票价格预测中的应用，核心主张是利用Transformer捕捉复杂非线性趋势的能力，并与自回归等传统方法对比。摘要信息有限，未明确具体交易策略、回测框架、风控或Alpha构造，更偏向模型能力验证与预测方法研究，而非可直接落地的实战交易系统，因此实战价值中等。

title: When News Gets Old: Portfolio Allocation with Reinforcement Learning and Large Language Models
abstract: Financial news can influence investment decisions long after publication. Timely news may reach an investor before prices fully adjust, whereas older news may already be reflected in prices. We examine two ways to handle aging signals: retain them and give a portfolio policy timing information, or filter them out before portfolio selection. A fixed large language model (LLM) extracts signals from public SEC disclosures. We compare these treatments in reinforcement learning (RL) policies and LLMs that choose portfolios directly. We evaluate returns after trading costs in historical tests over 2023-2025. RL choices respond to timing information in a controlled test, but historical returns show no consistent benefit from adding it. For the LLM, filtering old news produced the highest average net return, reaching 18.43% per year when news delivery was delayed by four weeks. This exceeded the returns of all RL strategies that used news.
summary: 该研究探讨如何处理金融新闻的时效性信号用于投资组合配置：是保留新闻的时序信息让策略感知新闻新旧，还是在组合选择前过滤掉旧新闻。使用固定LLM从公开SEC披露中提取信号，在强化学习策略和直接选组合的LLM中对比这两种处理方式，并以2023-2025年历史数据评估扣费后收益。结果显示：RL在受控测试中能响应时序信息，但历史收益未见加时序信息带来稳定收益；对LLM而言，过滤旧新闻带来最高平均净收益，在新闻延迟四周交付时达年化18.43%，超过所有使用新闻的RL策略收益。

title: Short-to-Long: Detached Features for Long-Horizon Value Learning
abstract: Learning useful representations from continually changing value targets remains a challenge in deep reinforcement learning. We study the temporal horizon of this supervision: smaller discounts make these targets less sensitive to distant bootstrap changes, but using them for behavior changes the control objective. We introduce Short-to-Long (S2L), which supplies a long-horizon behavior learner with features trained by smaller-discount source networks. Detached connections prevent the behavior value loss from updating the sources, allowing each source to follow its own value objective while the behavior discount remains unchanged. Across Atari, online continuous control, and offline continuous control, the approach yields aggregate performance gains, improving the paired terminal median on 40 of 57 Atari games. Matched Atari ablations support the roles of feature transfer, smaller source discounts, and gradient isolation. Fixed-trajectory measurements further show reduced drift in source value targets with mixed discounts.
summary: S2L提出一种长视界价值学习框架：用较小折扣的源网络训练特征，再通过detached连接将这些特征供给长视界行为学习器，防止行为价值损失回传更新源网络，使各源网络遵循自身价值目标且行为折扣保持不变。在Atari、在线连续控制和离线连续控制上取得总体性能提升，57个Atari游戏中40个的配对终端中位数改善；消融实验支持特征迁移、较小源折扣和梯度隔离的作用，并显示混合折扣下源价值目标漂移减少。对实战RL有价值，但需考虑实现与调参成本。

title: Adaptive quantitative trading: An imitative deep reinforcement learning approach
abstract: … mathematical symbols then formally introduce the quantitative trading problem in detail. … always the goal of quantitative traders. This further proves that our trading agent can benefit from …
summary: 该论文提出一种模仿式深度强化学习（imitative deep reinforcement learning）方法用于自适应量化交易（adaptive quantitative trading）。论文先给出数学符号形式化定义量化交易问题，核心是构建交易智能体（trading agent），并通过实验表明该智能体能够从模仿学习中获益，从而更接近量化交易者追求的目标。属于RL+量化交易的实战方向，但摘要信息有限，未见明确的Alpha构造细节或实盘回测证据，故给7分。

title: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
abstract: This study uses a high-frequency dataset from a stock exchange to examine how forecasting ability and liquidity provision relate to institutional traders' proprietary intraday profitability. We discover persistent forecasting abilities among traders. Specifically, we demonstrate that hypothetical flow-following strategies based on the execution flows of these skillful traders yield annualized Sharpe ratios ranging from 16 to 63 across various trading frequencies. We match buy and sell executions into positions, linking realized profit and loss (P&L) to horizon-matched forecasting proxies and the liquidity roles of both executions. Our findings indicate a direct correlation between improved forecasting ability and profitability, where a one-standard-deviation increase in the forecasting ability proxy is associated with 1.02 -- 1.19 currency units higher P&L per matched position. Additionally, we measure liquidity-provision intensity within a matched position by its number of passive executions: zero, one, or two. In these regressions, P&L is 1.28 -- 1.31 currency units higher for one passive execution than for none, and a further 3.79 -- 3.82 higher for two than for one, underscoring the significant financial benefits of liquidity provision.
summary: 本文利用交易所高频数据研究机构交易者日内自营交易的预测能力与流动性提供如何影响其盈利能力。发现交易者具有持续的预测能力；基于这些高技能交易者执行流的假设性跟单策略，在不同交易频率下年化夏普比率为16至63。研究将买卖执行撮合为持仓，将已实现盈亏与期限匹配的预测代理变量及两笔执行的流动性角色相联系。结果显示预测能力与盈利正相关：预测能力代理变量每增加一个标准差，每个匹配持仓的盈亏提高1.02–1.19货币单位。此外，以匹配持仓内被动执行次数（0、1、2次）衡量流动性提供强度，回归显示1次被动执行的盈亏比0次高1.28–1.31货币单位，2次比1次再高3.79–3.82货币单位。

title: Directionally Correct Views in Portfolio Optimization
abstract: Portfolio optimization techniques often use historical data to estimate parameters for Markowitz-type or ML models. Effective allocation requires a way to align the available data with conditions expected over the investment horizon. Inspired by the Black-Litterman framework, we ask whether incorporating expert views leads to better portfolio allocations. In a simple Markowitz setting, we show that even a small amount of directionally correct information can materially improve investment decisions. We also discuss how expert views can be incorporated in end-to-end portfolio models using entropy-based ideas. Somewhat surprisingly, our empirical results indicate that simpler Markowitz-type model perform as well as an end-to-end model, once directionally correct experts are incorporated.
summary: 该论文研究在投资组合优化中引入专家方向性观点（类似Black-Litterman）的价值。作者在简单Markowitz框架下证明，即便少量方向性正确的信息也能显著改善投资决策；并讨论如何用熵方法将专家观点融入端到端组合模型。实证结果出人意料地显示，在纳入方向性正确的专家观点后，简单Markowitz类模型与端到端模型表现相当。对实战交易有一定参考价值（观点融合、组合权重优化），但偏方法论、缺乏直接可交易的Alpha或强RL/DL创新，故给中等偏上分。

title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
abstract: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades into memory, and each quarter a reflector proposes prompt learnings that a deterministic gate applies reversibly and replay of recorded inputs verifies. All three operate around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline-agent prompts that no self-edit can reach. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; in replay of its recorded inputs, a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss, and no injected instruction was followed; and a 2015-2026 backtest shows the core alone lowering the maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies. The reflector traced the dominant failure to its root cause, and the gate applied a learning that the agent adopted on trigger evenings and on no control evening. Code: https://github.com/yebof/quant-agent
summary: 该论文提出Steward——一个面向自主投资的多智能体LLM系统，核心思路是将“自我进化的边界”编码进类型系统。系统包含三类机制：(1) 九类角色化智能体协同决策：四名分析师分别读取新闻流、SEC文件、宏观经济序列与市场数据并输出带类型的报告，由组合经理(Portfolio Manager)设定目标仓位，再由受保护的风险经理(Risk Manager)审计；(2) 七层共享记忆，由代码从系统自身记录中组装，为每个决策提供仓位上下文、市场叙事、校准信息及智能体过往决策；(3) 通过复盘实现自我改进：代码每晚对每笔交易与预测打分并写入记忆，每季度由reflector提出prompt层面的学习，经确定性门控(deterministic gate)可逆地应用，并通过重放已记录的输入进行验证。三类机制均围绕一个不变量核心(invariant core)运作，包括订单算术、风险规则与纪律型智能体提示。整体属于系统/工程架构类工作，与RL/深度学习/Alpha挖掘等实战信号类研究关联较弱，但多智能体协同、记忆分层与可逆自进化门控对实盘系统搭建有一定参考价值。

title: Deep reinforcement learning for quantitative trading: Challenges and opportunities
abstract: … rise of quantitative trading (QT), which refers to automatically generating trading signals with … for more than 70% and 40% of the trading volume in developed markets (eg, USA) and …
summary: 该论文是一篇关于深度强化学习用于量化交易的综述/立场文章，讨论其挑战与机遇。文中指出量化交易（QT）指自动生成交易信号，并在发达市场（如美国）分别占交易量的70%以上和40%以上。论文侧重宏观层面的问题梳理与方向展望，而非提出可直接落地的RL策略、Alpha因子或回测实证，因此对实战交易的直接价值有限，属于理论/综述性参考，评分5分。

title: Quantagent: Price-driven multi-agent llms for high-frequency trading
abstract: … To bridge the gap between traditional high-frequency quantitative trading and recent advances in multi-agent LLM systems, we introduce QuantAgent, a collaborative framework for low-…
summary: 该论文提出QuantAgent——一个面向高频交易（HFT）的多智能体LLM协作框架，旨在弥合传统高频量化交易与多智能体大模型系统之间的差距。核心思路是用多个LLM智能体组成协作框架，以价格驱动的方式处理低频（摘要中写作low-...，疑为low-frequency或low-latency）交易决策。从实战角度看，属于LLM智能体+量化的交叉探索：框架层面有工程参考价值，但摘要未展示明确的RL/深度学习alpha挖掘、回测收益、夏普或延迟指标，缺乏可验证的交易优势证据，且LLM在高频场景的延迟与成本约束明显，故实战价值中性，给5分。

title: Equilibria and Learning in Competitive Market Making
abstract: We propose a market-making game played among $N \ge 2$ strategic market makers and a single non-strategic representative trader. In a continuous quote space, standard finite-game arguments do not apply, while non-convex and discontinuous payoffs rule out classical continuous existence results and complicate learning. Nonetheless, we characterize pure-strategy Nash equilibria (PSNEs) and show that at least one PSNE always exists under minimal assumptions on the underlying asset value distribution, and that the equilibrium bid-ask spread widens strictly with asset value volatility. To obtain a tractable learning framework, we discretize prices and, under an additional regularity condition, show that the time-averaged play of no-internal-regret learners approaches the continuous Nash price envelope as the tick size vanishes. Finally, we empirically validate our theoretical results through numerical simulations.
summary: 论文研究N个策略性做市商与单一非策略代表性交易者之间的做市博弈。在连续报价空间中，传统有限博弈论证失效，非凸不连续收益也排除经典连续存在性结果并增加学习难度；作者仍刻画纯策略纳什均衡（PSNE），证明在资产价值分布的最小假设下至少存在一个PSNE，且均衡买卖价差随资产价值波动率严格扩大。为得到可处理的学习框架，作者离散化价格，并在额外正则条件下证明无内部遗憾学习者的时间平均策略随最小报价单位（tick size）趋于零而逼近连续纳什价格包络，最后用数值模拟验证理论结果。该文属纯理论/均衡分析，偏做市微观结构与学习收敛性，对实战RL/深度学习/Alpha的直接可操作性有限，故评分4。

title: Multiple Stopping and Exercise Boundaries for American Put Options
abstract: This article studies a finite-horizon American put option with up to $m$ exercise rights under the risk-neutral Black--Scholes model, where consecutive exercises must be separated by a prescribed refractory period $δ>0$ and unused rights may expire. For each number of remaining rights, we show that optimal exercise is characterized by a single exercise boundary and that these boundaries are ordered by the number of remaining rights. We prove optimality of the first boundary-hitting time and establish local Lipschitz continuity of the exercise boundaries within each open deadline strip. Away from the deadlines, we derive smooth fit, the associated quasi-variational inequality and free-boundary formulation, an early-exercise-premium representation, recursive Volterra-type boundary equations, and a verification theorem. We also extend the recursive formulation to an independent random termination time, thereby allowing for exogenous termination of the option contract.
summary: 本文研究有限期限美式看跌期权在风险中性Black-Scholes模型下最多含m次行权权的情形，相邻两次行权须间隔规定的耐火期δ>0，未用权利可到期作废。对每个剩余行权次数，证明最优行权由单一exercise boundary刻画，且这些边界按剩余行权次数排序；证明首次触及边界的时刻最优，并在每个开放到期子区间内建立exercise boundaries的局部Lipschitz连续性。远离到期日处，推导smooth fit、相应准变分不等式与自由边界表述、提前行权溢价表示、递归Volterra型边界方程及验证定理；并将递归表述推广至独立随机终止时间，以允许期权合约的外生终止。

title: Dynamics of the Liquidity Profile in Concentrated Liquidity Provision: An SPIDE Approach
abstract: We model the dynamics of the liquidity profile in Uniswap~V3 and other concentrated-liquidity automated market makers with a stochastic partial integro-differential equation (SPIDE). The profile, the aggregate of all provider positions across tick space, evolves under a degenerate Sturm--Liouville operator, which encodes mean-reverting concentration around the market price, coupled with a Hilbert--Schmidt integral operator, which captures nonlocal redistribution driven by provider repositioning. We establish existence and uniqueness of the mild solution in a weighted $L^2$ space built on the Gegenbauer eigensystem, and reduce the SPIDE to a coupled system of linear stochastic differential equations whose low-order modes describe the level, slope, and curvature of the profile. Pairing the SPIDE with a log-price process yields tractable expressions for pool reserves, pool value, and loss-versus-rebalancing under Ornstein--Uhlenbeck-type and Black--Scholes-type noise. A finite-rank calibration in a fixed reference frame, applied to three Uniswap pools, gives interpretable estimates and lowers active-band forecast error relative to a martingale benchmark on the two pools compatible with the stationary specification. On the third pool, out-of-sample diagnostics are consistent with nonstationarity, which motivates price-aware and time-varying extensions.
summary: 该论文用随机偏积分微分方程（SPIDE）建模Uniswap V3等集中流动性AMM的流动性分布动态：分布在同质化Sturm-Liouville算子（刻画围绕市场价格的均值回复式集中）与Hilbert-Schmidt积分算子（刻画提供者重新定位引起的非局部再分配）下演化；在基于Gegenbauer特征系的加权L2空间中证明mild解的存在唯一性，并将SPIDE约化为低阶模态（水平、斜率、曲率）的线性SDE耦合系统；结合对数价格过程，在OU型与Black-Scholes型噪声下给出池储备、池价值及LVR的解析表达式；对三个Uniswap池做固定参考系下的有限秩校准，估计可解释，并在两个兼容池上相对鞅基准降低了活跃区间预测误差。属AMM流动性建模的理论为主工作，含有限实证校准，但对直接实战交易信号/Alpha贡献有限。

title: Uncertainty and Explainability in Deep Rough Volatility: A Neural Information-Theoretic Posterior Approach
abstract:
Deep learning has substantially accelerated the calibration of complex stochastic-volatility models, but neural point calibration alone does not capture the uncertainty remaining after an implied-volatility (IV) surface has been observed. We develop a simulation-based inference framework for rough Heston (rHeston) calibration that learns the posterior distribution of the model parameters conditional on an IV surface. Using neural ratio estimation, we obtain calibrated posterior samples that can be propagated through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers for path-dependent exotic options. The resulting posterior-predictive distributions combine residual parameter uncertainty with conditional surrogate uncertainty and yield uncertainty-aware price intervals.
  We further introduce Hellinger-SHAP, an information-theoretic explainability method for posterior inference. Rather than attributing a single parameter point estimate, it applies local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional measuring contraction from the prior to the posterior. This identifies maturity--moneyness regions associated with posterior information gain for individual rHeston parameters. In a simulation study, posterior-predictive intervals provide calibrated or conservative coverage across forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims, while point plug-in prices can be materially unreliable for selected contract regimes. Together, the UQ and XAI analyses provide a transparent framework for uncertainty-aware neural calibration and downstream exotic pricing under the specified prior-predictive model.
summary: 该论文提出基于模拟的推断框架，用神经比率估计学习粗糙Heston模型在给定隐含波动率曲面下的参数后验分布，并通过异方差神经代理定价器传播后验样本，得到结合参数不确定性与代理不确定性的后验预测价格区间；同时提出Hellinger-SHAP信息论可解释方法，定位对单个rHeston参数后验信息增益贡献最大的到期-行权价区域。属于衍生品定价与模型校准理论工作，对Alpha/RL类实战交易直接价值有限。

title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
abstract: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
summary: Quant-Arena 是一个面向真实 A 股市场数据的端到端量化研究基准与公开排行榜：模型需自主构建特征与选股代码，仅在 2022–2023 年获得反馈，并冻结一个策略在封存的 2024 年评估；评估器模拟现金账户，施加交易约束与成本（含基于模拟订单簿估计的市场冲击），评分以已实现超额收益为主，辅以信号质量与特征多样性。作者评测九个前沿模型，GPT-6 Astra 得分最高，但 2024 年无任何模型跑赢等权市场。该工作直接检验 LLM 智能体在真实交易约束下的策略研发闭环能力，对实战中的特征工程、过拟合控制、交易成本与市场冲击建模具有较强参考价值，但其结果为负（无模型跑赢市场），且评测期较短、仅限 A 股，实战可直接复用性有限，故给 7 分。

title: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
abstract: Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on the tokenized message stream of eight large-cap US equities learns an internal representation of the market and its dynamics. In particular, order-flow imbalance, a central driver of short-horizon price moves, is decodable at $R^2 \approx 0.59$, far above controls and baselines. This representation extends to unseen stocks, suggesting that these models learn general representations rather than ticker-specific patterns. The model also generalizes across metrics beyond order-flow imbalance: results hold across traded volume and volatility. Additionally, the representation is causally steerable: pushing the state along a feature's axis shifts the model's next-message beliefs as that feature implies, monotonically in dose, consistent with the emergence of a world model.
summary: 该研究探究自回归状态空间基础模型（Mamba-3，8.2M参数，在8只美股大盘股的token化LOB消息流上自回归训练）的内部机制，发现模型习得了市场及其动态的内部表征：订单流不平衡（order-flow imbalance，短周期价格变动的核心驱动）可从隐状态解码，R²≈0.59，显著高于对照与基线；该表征可迁移至未见股票，说明学到通用表征而非特定股票模式，并在成交量、波动率等指标上同样成立；且表征可因果引导（causal steering）。对实战有一定价值：为用此类生成模型做微观结构信号提取、订单流预测与可控市场模拟提供了可解释性证据，但缺少端到端交易回测、成本与延迟分析，落地仍需验证。

title: Hybrid Deep Learning Frameworks for Financial Forecasting, Trading Decisions and Portfolio Allocation
abstract: … build trading systems that are both profitable and robust. This thesis develops a set of deep learning … The attention-based construction of the state space is quantitatively compared with …
summary: 该论文构建混合深度学习框架，用于金融预测、交易决策与组合配置。核心包括：基于注意力的状态空间构建，并与其他方法进行定量比较；开发一套深度学习组件以搭建兼具盈利性与鲁棒性的交易系统。属于Deep Learning+RL/交易决策方向，具备一定实战参考价值，但摘要信息有限，组合配置与状态空间对比的实盘落地性待验证。

title: Automate strategy finding with llm in quant investment
abstract: … LLM-enhanced agents demonstrate adaptive behavior. StockAgent exemplifies this approach with LLM-powered agents … successfully extends LLM capabilities to quantitative trading, …
summary: 该论文将LLM作为增强型智能体引入量化投资，提出StockAgent式框架，利用LLM驱动的智能体自适应地完成策略发现与交易决策，把LLM能力扩展到量化交易流程中。核心价值在于提供一种可自动化的策略生成/筛选范式，并强调智能体在市场环境中的自适应行为；但摘要未披露具体回测收益、风险控制、交易成本与实盘约束等关键细节，实战可复现性与稳健性证据有限，故给予中等偏上评分。

title: Lineage-Aware Search Control for LLM-Based Evolutionary Factor Mining
abstract: Formulaic alpha factor mining searches for symbolic expressions that transform market data into predictive signals. Recent LLM-based evolutionary factor mining methods use large language models as semantic variation operators. Under the conventional LLM-EA paradigm, stochastic variation and fitness-based selection can leave the search weakly directed and concentrated around a narrow set of structurally similar factors. We argue that these limitations arise because current methods mainly organize search at the individual and population levels, leaving lineage-level control underused. A lineage connects successive factor variants through evolutionary descent. We propose LineageEvo, which uses lineage in two coupled forms of search control: (1) lineage-conditioned LLM variation, which distills Lineage-Scoped Search Experience into operator-specific priors and fuses them with global operator priors, providing persistent, lineage-relevant guidance for LLM generation; and (2) lineage-stratified search allocation, which balances factor quality against lineage concentration by distributing the search budget across lineages during evolutionary search. Together, these mechanisms make semantic variation more direction aware and prevent branches from dominating the evolution, thereby promoting the discovery of predictive and diverse factors. We evaluate LineageEvo on CSI 500 and S&P 500 in terms of factor predictiveness, portfolio performance, search efficiency, and lineage- and expression-level diversity. LineageEvo achieves the strongest predictive performance on both markets, while LSPS produces a more balanced lineage distribution and a structurally broader factor pool. The results support lineage as a useful intermediate unit for controlling LLM-based evolutionary factor search.
summary: 该论文提出LineageEvo，在基于LLM的进化因子挖掘中引入谱系级搜索控制：(1) 谱系条件化LLM变异——将谱系范围内的搜索经验蒸馏为算子特定先验，并与全局算子先验融合，为LLM生成提供持续的谱系相关引导；(2) 谱系分层搜索分配——在进化搜索中按谱系分配搜索预算，平衡因子质量与谱系集中度。属于LLM+进化算法的alpha因子挖掘方法，偏工程实现和搜索策略优化，非纯理论，但缺乏实盘回测和交易成本等实战验证，对量化实战有中等参考价值。

title: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
abstract: Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets listed on Polymarket between January 2023 and May 2026, and only information available at listing (the market's title and description, named resolution source, and contract metadata), we predict lifetime trading volume and whether settlement is later disputed. Contract information predicts trading volume well (out-of-sample $R^2 = 0.747$ for log volume), and most of the signal is interpretable: market topic provides the largest gain ($+0.289$ $R^2$ over a $0.220$ contract-feature baseline), wording and resolution-rule design add smaller but measurable improvements ($+0.027$ combined), and neural text models add little beyond the interpretable features. This performance does not survive a period of platform change coinciding with a shift in listing formats: accuracy in predicting whether a market reaches \$1,000 falls from AUC $0.940$ under same-period evaluation to $0.577$ when training on past quarters and testing on later ones. The loss concentrates in markets whose question forms were absent from training (76.9% of test markets; on familiar forms the model still reaches $0.778$), and a decomposition attributes more of it to a changed relationship between contract characteristics and demand than to an outdated mapping from text to features. Dispute predictors are more stable but less precise: launch-time features rank dispute risk far better than chance (AUC $0.78$), yet at a 0.31% base rate precision is too low for case-by-case prediction (average precision $0.012$), so the scores suit ranking groups of markets rather than forecasting individual disputes.
summary: 该论文利用Polymarket上802,863个已结算市场的上市时信息（标题、描述、指定结算源、合约元数据）预测市场生命周期交易量与结算争议风险。合约信息对log交易量预测的样本外R²达0.747，其中市场主题贡献最大（较0.220基线提升0.289），措辞与结算规则设计小幅提升0.027，神经文本模型增益有限。关键实战警示：平台格式变更期后，模型预测市场是否达到1000美元交易量的AUC从同期评估的0.940跌至跨期评估的0.577，性能损失集中于训练中未出现过的问句形式（占测试市场76.9%），熟悉形式上仍达0.778。对实战交易价值中等偏上：提供了可操作的上市期筛选信号（主题>措辞/规则>神经模型）与重要的分布漂移/时效性警示，但局限于预测市场平台、缺乏直接Alpha或执行层面细节，故评6分。

title: DSINC beyond Heston: the 3/2 and other non-affine stochastic-volatility models
abstract: This paper extends the damped-sinc (DSINC) method for American options beyond the affine Heston class to general one-factor stochastic-volatility models. We show that the collapse identity, which reduces the early-exercise integral to a single spectral integral, remains valid for these models. Damping between zero and one is admissible whenever the discounted spot is a nonnegative local martingale. An Itô transformation of the volatility factorizes the conditional characteristic function and identifies a natural coordinate for approximating the exercise boundary. The 3/2 model admits closed-form joint transforms in terms of Kummer functions, while uncorrelated SABR admits a Bessel representation. When a practical closed-form transform is unavailable, the required volatility integral is computed directly by solving one backward equation per frequency, without a grid in the log-price. Through a known change of volatility coordinate, this approach also accommodates correlated SABR. Tests on the 3/2, SABR, GARCH and lognormal-volatility models show agreement with fine finite-difference benchmarks to within one basis point of the strike. Computational cost is comparable to or lower than that of our finite-difference implementation, except for the slower Hankel implementation of uncorrelated SABR.
summary: 该论文将 damped-sinc (DSINC) 方法从仿射 Heston 类推广到一般单因子随机波动率模型（含 3/2、SABR、GARCH、对数正态波动率），证明 collapse identity（将提前行权积分化为单一谱积分）在这些模型下仍成立；通过对波动率因子做 Itô 变换分解条件特征函数并给出近似行权边界的自然坐标，3/2 模型得到 Kummer 函数闭式联合变换，无相关 SABR 得到 Bessel 表示，无闭式变换时按频率逐个求解一个反向方程直接计算波动率积分（无需对数价格网格），并借助已知坐标变换处理相关 SABR。数值上与精细有限差分基准在行权价 1 个基点内一致，计算成本与现有方法相当或更低。对实战（美式期权定价/对冲、非仿射随机波动率校准）有一定工程价值，但非 Alpha/RL/深度学习方向，故给中性偏实战分。
