title: Agentic AI-driven portfolio optimization: a hybrid approach for optimized stock selection and deep learning in algorithmic trading
abstract: … By considering the advancements of Agentic AI and deep learning based approaches, … quantitative trading strategies across different time intervals in the American market. Quantitative …
summary: 该论文提出一种混合投资组合优化框架，结合Agentic AI进行股票筛选，并使用深度学习驱动算法交易，在美国市场不同时间区间上评估量化策略。核心贡献在于将智能体式选股与深度学习交易信号相结合，但摘要未披露具体模型结构、回测收益、风险指标或交易成本等实战关键信息，因此对实战交易有中等参考价值，需进一步阅读全文验证其可复现性与实际表现。

title: Dynamic Programming for Value-at-Risk Markov Decision Processes in Continuous Spaces
abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) is a widely adopted quantile-based risk measure in practice, yet incorporating VaR objectives into Markov decision processes (VaR MDPs) remains a longstanding challenge. Recent work has derived dynamic programming equations for VaR MDPs in finite state and action spaces but left the case of more general spaces unresolved. This paper establishes, for the first time, the validity of these equations in continuous spaces, for both finite- and infinite-horizon settings. Such cases naturally arise in many real-world dynamic decision-making problems. As an application, we study an optimal execution problem with a VaR objective and demonstrate that our framework enables the characterization of optimal dynamic strategies, resolving an open question in the field.
summary: 该论文首次证明了在连续状态/动作空间以及有限和无限时域下，VaR马尔可夫决策过程的动态规划方程的有效性，解决了此前仅在有限空间有结果的空白。应用部分研究了带VaR目标的最优执行问题，能够刻画最优动态策略，回答了该领域的开放问题。属于风险敏感强化学习的理论推进，为实战中VaR约束下的动态决策（如最优执行）提供理论依据，但缺乏可直接落地的算法与实证，偏理论。

title: Distributions or Quantiles? A Convex Variational Theory of Worst-Case Risk
abstract: Worst-case risk evaluation is central to finance and operations research, yet existing analytical results remain fragmented and largely confined to ambiguity sets with specific structures. Using spectral risk measures as the underlying class, we develop a convex variational theory that unifies these analyses and extends them to richer ambiguity models. The theory rests on a representation principle: use the quantile or distribution formulation that preserves convexity of the full ambiguity set. In both representations, the resulting optimality conditions provide a systematic route to identify the worst-case law and determine its risk value. This approach recovers classical central-moment bounds and yields closed-form or semi-closed-form solutions for practically motivated models involving Wasserstein ambiguity with tail stress, two-sided expected shortfall (ES) bands, asymmetric partial moments, geometric-moment bounds, and exponential- or Gaussian-reference Kullback--Leibler (KL) neighborhoods. Beyond these analytical results, the same theory yields projection-based algorithms with fixed-grid convergence under the stated assumptions. In a high-dimensional portfolio application, we establish an exact projection identity for mean-anchored joint KL ambiguity under a Gaussian reference. The resulting standardized worst-case ES coefficient applies to every portfolio, reducing robust portfolio selection to an exact second-order cone program after a single calibration.
summary: 该论文以谱风险度量为基础，建立凸变分理论，统一最坏情况风险分析。核心思想是选择能保持全模糊集凸性的分位数或分布表述，并由此给出最优性条件以识别最坏情况分布和风险值。理论可恢复经典中心矩界，并对Wasserstein模糊集（含尾部压力）、双侧ES带、非对称部分矩、几何矩界及指数/高斯参考KL邻域给出闭式或半闭式解；同时提供固定网格收敛的投影算法，并在高维组合算例中验证。偏理论，实战直接落地价值有限，但对最坏情况风险建模与鲁棒组合优化有参考意义。

title: A game-theoretic analysis of the market microstructure in decentralized exchanges with concentrated liquidity
abstract: We study strategic liquidity provision in decentralized exchanges with concentrated liquidity as a mean-field game. Liquidity providers choose the width of their price range and when to rebalance it, pay a transaction cost at each rebalancing, and share the fees collected at each tick in proportion to their liquidity, so that each provider's income depends on the state of the population. We formulate the problem as a controlled continuous-time Markov chain on a finite state space. In an averaged version of the game, in which a rebalanced position is re-centered at a draw from the long-run law of the price, a mean-field equilibrium exists. Because each provider's share of the fees falls as competing liquidity is added, the equilibrium liquidity profile is unique. For the exact dynamics, with rebalancing at the range boundary and fast execution, we obtain closed forms for the optimal width, the value function and the stationary law of a position, together with a critical volatility above which provision does not pay. Free entry holds a pool strictly below this threshold, at a margin set by the rebalancing cost. The critical volatility is computed from the fee tier, traded volume, active-tick liquidity and price alone, with no fitted parameter. On two and a half years of hourly data from five WETH/USDC pools on Ethereum and Base, it tracks realized volatility. On the Ethereum $0.3\%$ pool the ratio of realized to critical volatility is less than one, and optimal value $w^*$ exists. On the standard Uniswap fee tiers the critical volatility coincides with the on-chain implied volatility of the pool.
summary: 本文以平均场博弈框架研究集中流动性DEX中LP的策略性做市：流动性提供者选择价格区间宽度与再平衡时机，每次再平衡支付交易成本，并按流动性比例分享各tick手续费收入，因此个体收益取决于整体状态。作者将问题建模为有限状态空间上的受控连续时间马尔可夫链，证明在“再平衡后按价格长期分布的抽样重新居中”的平均化版本中存在平均场均衡，且因竞争流动性增加会稀释手续费份额，均衡流动性分布唯一。对精确动态（在区间边界再平衡且执行迅速），给出最优宽度、价值函数与仓位平稳分布的闭式解，并得到“高于某一临界波动率则提供流动性不划算”的阈值；自由进入使池子严格低于该阈值，边际由再平衡成本决定。临界波动率由费率档、交易量等计算得出。该文属理论建模，给出可校准的最优区间宽度与临界波动率判据，对LP做市与DEX流动性策略设计有间接参考价值，但无实证回测或可直接部署的alpha/RL方法，故实战评分中等偏低。

title: Arithmetic Models for Commodity Futures, Vanilla, and Calendar Spread Options
abstract:
We develop an arithmetic multi-factor stochastic volatility model for commodity futures and options. The arithmetic specification yields a low-dimensional Markovian representation of the futures curve and semi-closed-form pricing formulas for vanilla and basket options, including calendar spread options. These properties make the model suitable for large-scale empirical estimation.
  We estimate the model using an unscented Kalman filter on a panel of WTI crude oil futures, vanilla options, and calendar spread options spanning 2013-2024. We find that three stochastic volatility factors are needed to capture both the level and slope of the volatility term structure, and that hedges based on these factors remove almost all of the daily risk of a portfolio of vanilla options. Calendar spread options provide information about the dependence structure of futures prices that is not captured by futures and vanilla options alone. A model estimated without calendar spread options systematically overprices them by overstating the decorrelation between adjacent futures contracts. Including these options in the estimation brings the model's decorrelation close to the observed decorrelation, which removes the overpricing and improves their hedges, at only a small loss of accuracy in the pricing and hedging of vanilla options. Finally, we show that the arithmetic model fits futures and vanilla options better than its geometric counterpart and hedges the vanilla options slightly better.
summary: 本文构建了面向商品期货、普通期权和日历价差期权的算术多因子随机波动率模型，通过算术设定获得期货曲线的低维马尔可夫表示以及普通期权和篮子期权（含日历价差期权）的半闭式定价公式，便于大规模实证估计。作者使用无迹卡尔曼滤波，对2013—2024年WTI原油期货、普通期权和日历价差期权面板进行估计，发现需要三个随机波动率因子才能同时刻画波动率期限结构的水平与斜率，基于这些因子的对冲几乎可以消除普通期权组合的全部日度风险；日历价差期权提供了仅靠期货和普通期权无法捕捉的期货价格依赖结构信息，若估计中剔除日历价差期权，模型会系统性高估其价格，原因是高估了相邻期货合约之间的去相关程度，而纳入这些期权后模型去相关程度更接近观测值。

title: Deep catastrophic-risk-aware reinforcement learning
abstract: Estimating extreme risk in reinforcement learning becomes increasingly difficult as the confidence level increases, since only a small number of observations contribute to empirical estimates of Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). In this paper, we extend an Extreme Value Theory (EVT) approach for CVaR optimization to high-dimensional neural-network policies. Using a peaks-over-threshold representation and method-of-moments estimation, we obtain a differentiable tail-risk objective and show that, conditional on the selected threshold, its finite-sample gradient can be computed directly through automatic differentiation. We first validate the approach in a controlled experiment with a known optimal solution and then investigate its performance in a deep-hedging problem with rare extreme market movements. Our results show similar hedging behavior for EVT- and empirical-CVaR-trained policies under normal conditions, while EVT-trained policies exhibit lower hedging losses under the extreme-scenario evaluation across the training sample sizes considered. These results suggest that EVT can provide a practical alternative for training neural policies when the observations relevant to extreme risk are scarce.
summary: 该论文将极值理论(EVT)与CVaR优化结合，扩展到高维神经网络策略，利用超阈值表示和矩估计得到可微的尾部风险目标，并通过自动微分计算有限样本梯度。在已知最优解的受控实验中验证后，应用于含罕见极端市场变动的深度对冲问题：正常条件下EVT与经验CVaR训练的策略对冲行为相似，但在极端情景评估下EVT策略对冲损失更低。该工作对实战交易中的尾部风险控制、极端行情对冲和风险感知RL策略训练有直接参考价值，但缺乏真实市场多资产回测与交易成本分析，故评为7分。

title: LOB-Impact Benchmark: Emergent Market Impact in Generative Limit Order Book Models
abstract: Realistic market impact is essential for generative limit order book (LOB) models to serve as world models for trading agents. If a simulator misprices this mechanism, agents learn policies that are optimal in the simulator but wrong in the real market. Existing metrics assess generated streams purely through distributional comparison with historical data, leaving counterfactual response to an agent's own orders largely unexplored. Here, we show that market impact emerges naturally in neural LOB generators trained solely for next-token prediction. We inject execution-style metaorders into the generated message flow of five autoregressive models across five NASDAQ stocks and measure the response using estimators from the empirical impact literature, validated on baselines whose physics is known in advance. Our benchmark evaluates any message-level generator in three phases: free generation (reading order-flow persistence against price diffusivity); metaorder injection (yielding the impact law's exponent and amplitude); and a post-execution window (measuring relaxation). In addition, comparing each visible injection to a blind, simulator-only control isolates the model's learned response from standard book mechanics. For every model on every stock, we measure how the impact responds as a function of cumulative metaorder participation. Interestingly, we observe emergent impact in generative models of market data, with exponents in the range of 0.63 to 1.21, slightly above the traditional 0.5 of the square-root law of impact. In the family of models tested, we are so far unable to observe impact decay during relaxation. We tentatively attribute this to the still-short context windows of the models. We release the benchmark as open source to validate future generative models for market data.
summary: 该论文提出LOB-Impact Benchmark，用于评估生成式限价订单簿（LOB）模型的市场冲击真实性。核心发现：仅用下一词预测训练的神经LOB生成器会自然涌现市场冲击。方法上，向五个自回归模型在五只NASDAQ股票生成的订单流中注入执行型metaorder，并用经验冲击文献的估计量测量响应，且在已知物理性质的基线上验证。基准分三阶段评估任意消息级生成器：自由生成（考察订单流持续性与价格扩散性）、metaorder注入（得出冲击律的指数与幅度）、执行后窗口（测度松弛）。并通过将可见注入与仅模拟器的盲对照比较，分离模型学到的响应。对实战交易（RL交易智能体、仿真环境保真度、冲击成本建模）有较高参考价值，但偏基准/评估方法而非直接alpha策略，故给7分。

title: Arbitrage-Aware Probabilistic Multi-Step Forecasting of Implied Volatility Surfaces: Joint Generation of Surface-Return Trajectories Using Latent Diffusion
abstract: Implied volatility surfaces summarise the option market and are central to many financial applications. Probabilistic forecasting of their future evolution requires modelling two-dimensional geometry, temporal dependence, and predictive uncertainty while preserving economic admissibility. We propose a conditional latent diffusion framework for generating joint 30-step trajectories of implied volatility surfaces and underlying returns. An arbitrage-aware autoencoder learns a surface representation, while diffusion captures the evolution. Evaluated on SPX surfaces, the framework generates realistic probabilistic multi-step scenarios. Its predictive mean also outperforms persistence beyond the shortest horizons.
summary: 该论文提出一种条件潜在扩散框架，用于联合生成隐含波动率曲面与标的收益的30步轨迹。其采用考虑套利约束的自编码器学习曲面表示，并用扩散模型刻画演化过程。在SPX曲面上评估，能生成逼真的概率多步情景，且预测均值在最短期限之外优于持续性基准。对实战交易（尤其期权做市、情景生成与风险对冲）有较强参考价值，但缺少直接策略回测与交易成本分析。

title: Market Regime-Based Multi-Asset Portfolio Optimization Using Nested Clustered Optimization for Tactical Asset Allocation
abstract: We propose a regime-aware tactical asset allocation (TAA) framework integrating market regime detection with Nested Clustered Optimization (NCO) for multi-asset portfolio construction. The central hypothesis is that incorporating market regime information into the NCO pipeline, specifically at the stages of covariance estimation, hierarchical clustering, and weight optimization, yields portfolios with improved risk-adjusted performance and reduced downside risk relative to regime-agnostic baselines. Market regimes (Bullish, Sideways/Neutral, Bearish) are detected using a Gaussian Hidden Markov Model (HMM) fitted exclusively on information available up to each decision point, thereby preventing look-ahead bias. Regime-conditional covariance matrices and clustering structures parameterize NCO at each rebalancing event. An adaptive rebalancing rule, triggered by regime transitions or material changes in optimal weights, replaces fixed-calendar rebalancing. The framework is evaluated on a heterogeneous monthly multi-asset universe comprising Indonesian government bonds (SBN), the LQ45 equity index, gold (IDR-denominated), foreign exchange (CNY/IDR), and Bitcoin/IDR (BTC). Out-of-sample performance is assessed via rolling walk-forward backtesting. Benchmarks include equal-weight (1/N), buy-and-hold, standard NCO without regime awareness, minimum variance, hierarchical risk parity (HRP), and a rule-based regime strategy. Performance metrics include cumulative return, annualized Sharpe ratio, Sortino ratio, maximum drawdown, Calmar ratio, turnover, and net-of-cost returns. Statistical significance is assessed using the Jobson-Korkie test. The empirical analysis indicates that the proposed regime-aware TAA framework successfully limits tail risk, achieving a maximum drawdown of 4.44% and demonstrating the utility of HMM-based regime detection in multi-asset risk management.
summary: 该论文提出一种基于市场状态感知的战术资产配置（TAA）框架，将高斯隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）检测的市场状态（牛市、震荡/中性、熊市）与嵌套聚类优化（NCO）结合，在协方差估计、层次聚类和权重优化阶段引入状态信息，采用由状态转换或权重显著变化触发的自适应再平衡规则替代固定日历再平衡。在印尼国债（SBN）、LQ45股指、印尼盾计价黄金、CNY/IDR外汇及BTC/IDR的月度多资产组合上做样本外评估，核心假设是状态感知NCO相较状态无关基线可提升风险调整收益并降低下行风险。该研究有明确的样本外验证和避免前视偏差的工程细节，具备一定实战参考价值，但资产池偏小众（印尼市场）、月度频率偏低、依赖HMM状态识别的稳定性，且未涉及强化学习或深度学习等Alpha挖掘方法，故给予中等偏上评分。

title: Rachev-Ratio Portfolio Optimization with TimeGAN Scenarios: Replacement versus Supplementation
abstract: This study evaluates the reliability and investment consequences of scenarios from a specified time-series generative adversarial network (TimeGAN) in Rachev-ratio portfolio allocation. Using 12 exchange-traded funds, we compare historical, replacement and hybrid policies across five training seeds with delayed execution and transaction costs. Synthetic probability mass varies independently of draw count under a fixed training protocol; optimal generator fidelity is not assumed. Generated scenarios understate volatility and tail losses and distort dependence. Limited longer-training diagnostics improve reconstruction loss without improving cross-asset correlation accuracy. Higher-mass hybrids earn larger average net returns in some configurations, but all conditional generated-versus-historical return intervals include zero at the reference block length. Full-period TimeGAN means exceed resampling controls, while direct paired return, Sharpe and realized-tail-ratio intervals include zero. Replacement raises turnover and is sensitive to the modified objective's denominator floor; changing that floor does not uniformly improve realized downside risk. Exploratory generation-error associations do not identify a causal investment-performance channel. The results illustrate financial model risk from the interaction of imperfect scenarios and a tail-sensitive allocation criterion, supporting joint evaluation of fidelity, numerical behavior and realized outcomes within the tested implementation.
summary: 该研究在Rachev比率组合优化框架下，评估TimeGAN生成情景对实际投资配置的可靠性与影响。使用12只ETF，比较历史、替代（replacement）与混合（hybrid）三种策略，跨5个训练种子，并考虑延迟执行与交易成本。核心发现：在固定训练协议下，合成情景概率质量与抽样次数无关；生成情景低估波动率与尾部损失、扭曲相依结构；延长训练虽改善重构损失但不提升跨资产相关性精度；高混合权重策略在某些配置下平均净收益更高，但所有条件生成与历史收益区间在参考块长度下均含零；全期TimeGAN均值超过重采样对照，但配对收益、Sharpe与已实现尾部比率区间含零；替代策略提高换手率且对修正目标的分母下限敏感，调整下限并不能一致改善已实现下行风险。该论文对实战交易有中等参考价值：揭示了生成情景用于组合优化的真实缺陷（尾部低估、相关性失真、换手上升），提示不能盲目以合成数据替换历史数据，但缺乏可直接落地的稳定Alpha或显著超额收益证据，故评5分。

title: Dynamic Programming for Value-at-risk Markov Decision Processes in Continuous Spaces
abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) is a widely adopted quantile-based risk measure in practice, yet incorporating VaR objectives into Markov decision processes (VaR MDPs) remains a longstanding challenge. Recent work has derived dynamic programming equations for VaR MDPs in finite state and action spaces but left the case of more general spaces unresolved. This paper establishes, for the first time, the validity of these equations in continuous spaces, for both finite- and infinite-horizon settings. Such cases naturally arise in many real-world dynamic decision-making problems. As an application, we study an optimal execution problem with a VaR objective and demonstrate that our framework enables the characterization of optimal dynamic strategies, resolving an open question in the field.
summary: 本文首次证明，在连续状态与动作空间、有限与无限时间范围内，VaR MDP 的动态规划方程均成立，填补了此前仅限有限空间的理论空白。作为应用，研究了一个带 VaR 目标的最优执行问题，刻画了最优动态策略，解决了该领域一个开放问题。属于风险约束下动态决策的理论突破，对实战交易（尤其最优执行与 VaR 约束策略）有间接指导价值，但偏理论、无直接 RL/深度学习或 alpha 实证，评分 5。

title: Speculative Imbalance Positions by Non-Physical Traders: Impacts on Electricity System Balancing in Great Britain
abstract: The electricity system in Great Britain (GB) allows participants to deliberately produce or consume a different volume to their traded position and has incentivised this practice with a single imbalance price since 2015. In particular, non-physical traders (NPTs) often take an open position to imbalance without any intention to produce or consume power. However, new government proposals could restrict this practice due to concerns over supply-demand balancing feasibility and costs. This article presents the first empirical analysis of speculative imbalance positioning (SIP) by NPTs in the GB electricity system through its effects on imbalance volumes, balancing costs, the imbalance price, and associated settlement costs over the period 2021-2024. Our research uses party-level imbalance data in each settlement period to run counterfactual simulations of the electricity balancing mechanism without the aggregate NPT imbalance. Our results indicate that SIP by NPTs reduced the total net balancing volume required by 3.1-3.9 TWh (16-20%), reduced system imbalance standard deviation by 48-65 MWh (13-17%), reduced balancing costs by £347-396m (5.9-6.7%), and reduced supplier imbalance costs by £193-325m (65-75%) over the analysis period. These results suggest that consumer bills would have been higher without SIP by NPTs, since the extra costs would likely have been passed on to consumers through levies, although the potential for effects in the wholesale (primarily late-stage intraday) markets complicates this picture.
summary: 该论文对英国电力系统2021-2024年非物理交易者(NPT)的投机性不平衡头寸(SIP)进行首个实证分析，利用各结算周期主体级不平衡数据，对不含NPT总不平衡量的电力平衡机制进行反事实模拟。结果显示：SIP使所需总净平衡电量减少3.1-3.9 TWh(16-20%)，系统不平衡标准差降低48-65 MWh(13-17%)，平衡成本降低3.47-3.96亿英镑(5.9-6.7%)，并降低供应商不平衡成本。属电力市场微观结构与监管政策实证研究，非RL/深度学习/alpha类策略，对股票/期货实战交易直接价值有限，但可作为跨市场不平衡定价与套利机制研究的参考。

title: Dynamic portfolio selection under range value-at-risk with logarithmic returns
abstract:
This paper studies continuous-time portfolio selection under Range Value-at-Risk (RVaR), with both portfolio performance and risk evaluated in terms of logarithmic returns. We formulate a mean--RVaR problem in a continuous-time financial market and reduce the dynamic optimization to a static quantile problem. Using quantile representation, Lagrangian optimization, and convexification, we characterize the optimal terminal wealth through the convex envelope of an RVaR-specific transformed weighting function.
  The RVaR-specific convex envelope exhibits two distinct geometric configurations. Under Scenario~1, the terminal wealth has a VaR-type structure: the minimum-RVaR payoff is digital-option-like, whereas for $0<λ<1$ it consists of two growth-optimal regions separated by a constant-payoff region. Under Scenario~2, the convex envelope is determined either by a supporting line connecting an interior contact point to the endpoint or by a common supporting line with two interior contact points, leading to a richer multi-region payoff structure. We further show that the RVaR solutions reduce to their VaR and Expected Shortfall (ES) counterparts as $β\downarrowα$ and $α=0$, respectively. Under constant investment opportunities, we also derive closed-form wealth processes and replicating portfolio strategies.
  Numerical results show that the effects of $(α,β,λ)$ on risky-asset exposure are nonlinear and generally non-monotone. In particular, when $α>0$, pure minimum-RVaR optimization may assign zero terminal wealth in sufficiently bad states because the extreme quantile region $[0,α)$ is excluded from the RVaR criterion. These results clarify how interval-based quantile risk control shapes state-dependent portfolio payoffs and connects RVaR with its VaR and ES limiting cases.
summary: 本文研究连续时间下以对数收益衡量组合表现与风险的Range Value-at-Risk(RVaR)动态组合选择。将均值-RVaR问题转化为静态分位数问题，利用分位数表示、拉格朗日优化与凸化，通过RVaR特定的变换权重函数的凸包刻画最优终端财富。凸包呈两种几何形态：情形1下终端财富具VaR型结构，最小RVaR收益类似数字期权，0<λ<1时由两个增长最优区域夹一恒定收益区域；情形2下凸包由连接内点与端点的支撑线或具有两个内点的公共支撑线决定，收益结构更丰富。并证明RVaR解在β↓α与α=0时分别退化为VaR与预期短缺(ES)解。属纯理论定价/优化论文，缺乏实证、回测与可直接落地的交易信号，实战价值有限。

title: Disentangling Liquidity-Constrained from Strategic Default: A Deep Learning Approach
abstract: I use a deep neural network (DNN) on a proprietary panel of commercial mortgages spanning 1998--2021 to separate liquidity-constrained default from strategic default -- two competing, observationally similar explanations for delinquency that are difficult to disentangle with standard parametric models. Conditional on delinquency, property income (net operating income, or NOI) is a more important determinant of the default rate than leverage (loan-to-value, or LTV), despite LTV's status as the workhorse variable in the commercial mortgage default literature. I recover borrower motive from otherwise observationally equivalent delinquency states through a joint analysis of default rates across NOI and LTV buckets, and show that the resulting thresholds are stable across the 2008 financial crisis and the 2020--2021 COVID-19 shock to commercial real estate. Because commercial borrowers are firms rather than households, and because responsibility for a missed payment is diffused across an organization rather than borne by a single decision-maker, the moral and reputational frictions that discourage strategic default in the residential setting are attenuated -- making commercial mortgages a setting in which strategic behavior should be comparatively easier to detect, and comparatively costly to ignore for investors, servicers, and regulators.
summary: 该论文用深度神经网络（DNN）分析1998—2021年商业抵押贷款专有面板数据，区分流动性约束型违约与策略性违约这两种观察上相似、传统参数模型难以分离的违约动机。核心发现：在已发生拖欠的条件下，物业净营业收入（NOI）对违约率的决定作用强于杠杆率（LTV），尽管LTV是商业抵押贷款违约文献中的主力变量；作者通过跨NOI与LTV分组的联合违约率分析，从原本观察等价的拖欠状态中识别借款人动机，并证明所得阈值在2008年金融危机和2020—2021年商业地产COVID-19冲击下均保持稳定。由于商业借款人是企业而非家庭、逾期付款责任分散于组织而非单一决策者，抑制策略性违约的道德与声誉摩擦在商业场景中被削弱。对实战交易价值有限：主题属信用风险/违约建模，非价格预测或Alpha信号，DNN仅作分类工具、无交易策略或回测，阈值稳定性对商业地产信用风控有一定参考，但对二级市场量化交易直接应用性弱。

title: Conformal Kelly: When Marginal Coverage Transfers and the Economics Do Not
abstract: We size portfolio positions from conformal prediction intervals, reading the interval half-width as the scale in a capped fractional-Kelly rule (Conformal Kelly), and evaluate the rule under a pre-registered protocol. The development record is an autonomous LLM-agent search over roughly 200 configurations on a single six-year window (2016-2021) of eight US-listed ETFs. All later data was sealed before the search, and two final configurations, nine comparison books and the mapping from outcomes to conclusions were registered before unsealing. On the sealed 2022-2024 window, realized coverage was 0.745 against a 0.750 target, but the two configurations' annualised net log growth was 8.5% and 7.0% (28.5% and 25.8% in development), below an unlevered equal-weight book (9.5%), the leveraged passive books (15.6-16.8%) and a registered hindsight four-equity book (10.8%, at a 46% drawdown); both ranked last of eleven entries on Sharpe and Calmar. A post-hoc split, outside the registered protocol, shows the passing coverage averaging 0.592 in 2022 and 0.842 afterwards, with the entire loss in the under-covered year. The split does not show that under-coverage caused the loss: the leverage cap bound on every 2022 trading day, so narrow intervals could not enlarge the book, and a long-equity book in an equity bear market is the simpler account. But the registered acceptance test passed a sixteen-point conditional failure, which motivates, without establishing, conditional coverage as an endpoint for rules that read interval width as a scale. On the development window, a slow per-asset conformal quantile out-grew every locally adaptive alternative tested, but only under a binding leverage cap, and block-bootstrap intervals include zero for 11 of the 13 contrasts we could re-derive.
summary: 该论文将共形预测区间半宽作为带封顶分数凯利规则的尺度（Conformal Kelly），在预注册协议下评估。开发记录为LLM智能体在2016-2021六年窗口、8只美股ETF上约200种配置的自主搜索；解锁前注册两套最终配置、九个对比组合及结论映射。在封存的2022-2024窗口，实测覆盖率为0.745（目标0.750），但两套配置年化净对数增长为8.5%和7.0%（开发期为28.5%和25.8%），低于无杠杆等权组合（9.5%）、杠杆被动组合（15.6-16.8%）及事后四股票组合（10.8%，回撤46%）；在Sharpe和Calmar上均排名十一项中末位。注册协议外的事后拆分显示，2022年覆盖率为0.592、之后为0.842，全部损失集中在覆盖不足的年份，但该拆分未证明覆盖不足导致损失。结论：边际覆盖可迁移，经济收益不可迁移，对实战交易价值有限。

title: Intraday Trading Across Financial Markets: A Systematic Review of Behavioral, Technical, Quantitative, and AI-Based Trading Strategies
abstract: … trading frameworks. Similarly, the rapid emergence of cryptocurrency markets, high-frequency trading, reinforcement learning, … largely isolated from quantitative trading research, with …
summary: 该论文是一篇关于日内交易策略的系统综述，涵盖行为、技术、量化与AI四类框架，并提及加密货币市场、高频交易与强化学习等新兴方向，但摘要显示这些领域与量化交易研究仍较为割裂。作为综述，它更适合作为研究地图与文献索引，而非可直接落地的策略或Alpha来源，实战价值有限。

title: Predicting Next-Trading-Session Stock Movements from Arabic Corporate Announcements: A Hybrid Transformer-Boosted Ensemble.
abstract: … Early approaches to stock prediction from news and textual … [7] proposed an event-driven stock prediction model that first … More recently, Transformers [3] and pre-trained language …
summary: 该论文利用阿拉伯语企业公告预测下一交易日的股票走势，采用混合Transformer与提升式集成（Boosted Ensemble）方法。摘要回顾了事件驱动预测模型、Transformer及预训练语言模型等早期方法，属于文本驱动股票预测的应用研究，但未见可验证的实盘Alpha、RL或深度量化策略细节，对实战交易价值有限。

title: Regime-Aware Interpretable Ranking for Sector Rotation
abstract: Sector rotation is a common decision in benchmark-relative portfolio management, where portfolio managers rank sectors for overweight and underweight positions. We formulate this task as ranking sector actions by expected future risk-adjusted active performance, measured with forward sector-benchmark Sharpe ratios. Such rankings should preserve temporal information, express model outputs through economically familiar signal characteristics, account for changes in signal relevance across macroeconomic environments, and capture dependencies among sectors. We propose RegimeRank, an interpretable sector-ranking model that represents fundamental and technical signals through expert-defined temporal characteristics, conditions them on learned macro factors via cross-attention, and models cross-sector dependencies through self-attention. Expected-gradient attributions identify the contributions of individual signal-transformation pairs, while macroeconomic and cross-sector attention maps provide diagnostics of the learned conditioning and relational structure. We evaluate RegimeRank on weekly S&P 500 data from 2002 to 2024 under combinatorial purged cross-validation, where it outperforms representative ranking and machine-learning baselines across multiple ranking metrics. Ablation studies support the contributions of latent macro states, regime conditioning, and cross-sector modelling, while attribution and attention analyses illustrate the temporal characteristics, macro states, and sector relationships underlying its rankings.
summary: 该论文将板块轮动建模为按预期未来风险调整后主动表现（前向板块-基准Sharpe比率）对板块进行排序的任务，提出可解释的RegimeRank模型：用专家定义的时间特征表示基本面与技术信号，通过交叉注意力以学习到的宏观因子为条件，并通过自注意力建模跨板块依赖；用期望梯度归因识别各信号-变换对的贡献，用宏观与跨板块注意力图提供诊断。基于2002-2024年标普500周度数据，在组合净化交叉验证下优于基准。对实战交易价值高：直接面向组合经理的板块超配/低配排序决策，融合宏观regime切换与跨板块联动，且具备可解释性便于归因与风控。

title: Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Market Making on Prediction-Market Order Books
abstract: A market maker provides liquidity by quoting prices to buy and sell an asset, earning the spread while managing inventory risk. We study market makers trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning on prediction markets, specifically Polymarket, whose thin order books pose distinct challenges. Three challenges underpin this research: adverse selection may cause a policy trained on real data to stop quoting; the consequences of a quote can arrive many steps after the action; and prediction-market L2 data does not identify individual orders needed for simulation. We address these challenges by reconstructing order-level LOBSTER-format data from Polymarket and training agents in JaxMARL-HFT on 417 real markets. We enrich the baseline market maker's observation space with the book and recent flow, redesign its actions and inventory controls, and propose a cooperative multi-agent decomposition into a quoter and a risk manager trained using recurrent Independent Proximal Policy Optimisation (IPPO) with RNN policies. We investigate reward shaping, particularly reward blending and post-fill markout, to mitigate credit-assignment difficulties between the agents. Our redesigned single-agent market maker quotes more frequently and incurs smaller held-out losses than the retrained JaxMARL-HFT baseline, although the contributions of jointly changed observations, actions and risk constraints are not separately identified. Decomposition alone performs poorly; careful reward design substantially improves the desk relative to the unshaped split and yields our best result. Models are evaluated on realised end-of-episode portfolio value on held-out markets. None establishes positive average portfolio value in periodic held-out evaluation, and each configuration was trained with one seed. The environment, data and protocol lay a foundation for makers that quote many linked markets at once.
summary: 该论文研究在预测市场（Polymarket）订单簿上做市，使用多智能体强化学习。针对三大挑战——逆向选择导致策略停止报价、报价后果延迟多步（信用分配）、预测市场L2数据缺乏个体订单标识——作者从Polymarket重建L2为LOBSTER格式的订单级数据，在JaxMARL-HFT上对417个真实市场训练智能体。方法上丰富了做市商观测空间（订单簿与近期订单流），重新设计动作与库存控制，并提出将做市商分解为报价者与风控者的协作多智能体结构，用带RNN策略的循环IPPO训练。研究reward shaping（奖励混合与成交后markout）以缓解智能体间信用分配问题。该工作依托真实市场数据与可复现的高频仿真环境，方法具较强实战参考价值，但实验以仿真为主、未报告真实资金交易结果，故给7分。

title: SHADE: Shrinkage via Halted Alpha-stable Denoising for Heavy-Tailed Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
abstract: Time-series observations are particularly susceptible to noise, and many real-world series have low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) together with heavy-tailed and time-varying disturbances. When Gaussian diffusion models are used for forecasting, reversing all the way to the zero-noise endpoint may yield an overly narrow and overconfident predictive distribution. We propose SHADE, an alpha-stable Lévy diffusion forecaster that reads out at a nonzero depth so that the residual stable kernel acts as distribution-level shrinkage. By decomposing halting risk into smoothing bias and estimation error, we develop a scale-calibrated halt for estimating the optimal shrinkage $τ^*$ and a context-amortized halt that requires no explicit noise labels. Gains concentrate in the extreme heavy-tailed regime $α\leq1.3$: Across synthetic noise settings, median CRPS improves by 21.7\%, while the NLL falls significantly; Cryptocurrency and foreign-exchange data provide further evidence of improved tail calibration in real-data implement. On near-light-tailed or high-SNR data, the model reverts to Gaussian diffusion or full denoising. SHADE maintains overall forecast error comparable to strong baselines while providing more honest tail uncertainty for heavy-tailed series.
summary: SHADE提出一种α稳定Lévy扩散预测模型，通过在非零噪声深度读取预测，使残余稳定核充当分布级收缩，解决高斯扩散模型在重尾、低信噪比时间序列上过度自信、分布过窄的问题。方法将停止风险分解为平滑偏差与估计误差，设计尺度校准停止准则估计最优收缩τ*，并提出无需显式噪声标签的上下文摊销停止策略。收益集中在极端重尾区间（α≤1.3）：合成数据上CRPS中位数改善21.7%，NLL显著下降；加密货币与外汇真实数据进一步验证尾部校准改善；在近轻尾或高信噪比数据上模型自动退化为高斯扩散或全去噪，整体预测误差与强基线相当。对实战交易有价值：直接针对加密/外汇等高波动重尾市场的尾部风险预测与不确定性校准，具备可落地的真实数据验证，但需注意其收益依赖重尾条件且整体误差未超越基线，故非满分。

title: Amortized Neural Filtering for Calibrated Posteriors in Statistical Arbitrage
abstract: Statistical arbitrage trades on an estimate of the state of a residual spread, and conventional practice discards the uncertainty of that estimate. We keep the uncertainty and use it in the trading decision. A Neural Filter Estimator (NFE) is trained on simulated paths of a mean-reverting process whose innovation law is selected by testing candidates against real residuals; once trained, it returns the posterior over the latent state of every spread in a cross-section in one forward pass. Three results follow. On simulated paths with known truth, every practical estimator, ours included, falls in one narrow band of accuracy well below an estimator given full information, so the posterior gains no accuracy over a point estimate; its contribution is a correct account of its own uncertainty. On Korean equities, net of costs, the conventional point estimate forecasts about a thousand basis points per holding period more than it realizes, and the amortized methods cut that gap by a factor of roughly two to eight. Sizing positions from the posterior on the same learned factors as the end-to-end Attention Factor Model matches the Sharpe ratio of those factors under the base rule within the period's noise, at no more risk.
summary: 该论文研究统计套利中残差价差潜在状态的后验估计与交易决策。提出神经滤波估计器(NFE)，用候选创新分布对真实残差检验后模拟均值回归路径训练，一次前向传播即输出横截面各价差潜在状态的后验。三点结论：(1) 在已知真值的模拟路径上，包括本文方法在内的所有实用估计器精度都落在远低于全信息估计器的窄带内，后验并不比点估计更准，其价值在于正确刻画自身不确定性；(2) 在韩国股票上扣除成本后，传统点估计的预测比实现高出约1000个基点/持有期，摊销方法将该差距缩小约2至8倍；(3) 用同一学习因子(与端到端Attention Factor Model相同)上的后验进行仓位 sizing，其Sharpe比率在基准规则下与这些因子相匹配。对实战有价值：提供了不确定性感知的仓位管理与可落地的摊销推断，但主要增益在风险校准而非超额收益，故给7分。

title: Arbitrage-Free Implied Volatility Surface Reconstruction via Additive Martingales
abstract: This work focuses on reconstructing a continuous implied volatility (IV) surface from a small number of option quotes, a fundamental task for option pricing and risk management. We propose Additive Martingale (AddMart), a few-shot IV surface reconstruction framework that satisfies static no-arbitrage conditions by construction. Rather than predicting IVs directly, AddMart maps sparse quotes to non-negative increment densities of an exponential additive martingale, from which valid risk-neutral marginals and IVs are recovered. By incorporating the no-arbitrage structure directly into its architecture, rather than enforcing it through regularization in the learning objective, AddMart produces IV surfaces that satisfy static no-arbitrage conditions throughout the domain. Extensive experiments on ten real-option datasets demonstrate that AddMart achieves competitive reconstruction accuracy with no material static arbitrage violations, while directly enabling the estimation of VaR, CVaR, and crash probabilities.
summary: 该论文提出AddMart，一种少样本隐含波动率（IV）曲面重建框架，通过将稀疏期权报价映射到指数加性鞅的非负增量密度，从架构上保证静态无套利条件，而非依赖正则化约束。在十个真实期权数据集上实现有竞争力的重建精度且无实质性静态套利违规，并可直接估计VaR、CVaR和崩盘概率。对实战交易有较高价值：无套利IV曲面是期权做市、定价与风险管理的核心，且直接输出VaR/CVaR/崩盘概率对风控实用；但属于金融工程/期权领域而非RL/深度学习Alpha方向，故给7分。

title: Conflicting History in Foundation Model Return Forecasts
abstract: Older observations can help a forecaster learn a predictive relationship while becoming misleading when that relationship changes. We study this tension using paired return histories that differ in older observations but share recent returns and the conditional distribution of the next return. Across five foundation-model forecasting procedures and three simulated processes, each evaluated on 1,024 independent replications, conflicting history reduces the probability of improving on zero in all 30 higher-signal comparisons. This loss of usefulness occurs despite successful signal recovery under stable conditions. A separate exploratory comparison on 56 assets finds that shortening inputs from 256 to 64 returns increases mean absolute error for every model by 1.77-4.58 basis points; neither length improves observed overall error over zero. The evidence distinguishes the ability to extract a signal from the ability to withstand conflicting history, while showing why context sensitivity alone does not justify discarding older data.
summary: 该论文研究基础模型收益预测中'冲突历史'问题：配对收益历史在旧观测上不同但近期收益与下一期收益条件分布相同，在5种基础模型预测流程、3种模拟过程、各1024次独立重复下，全部30个高信号比较中冲突历史都降低了'优于零预测'的概率，尽管在稳定条件下信号可被成功恢复。另在56个资产上的探索性比较显示，将输入从256个收益缩短至64个，使每个模型的MAE增加1.77-4.58个基点，且两种长度下的整体误差均未优于零预测。核心启示：能提取信号不等于能抵御冲突历史，仅凭上下文敏感性不足以证明丢弃旧数据合理。对实战交易有中等参考价值，提示长窗口历史在关系漂移时会误导，需重视数据窗口选择与漂移检测，但缺少真实盈利回测证据。

title: Probabilistic Limit Order Book Forecasting with Conditional Diffusion Models
abstract: Modeling limit order book (LOB) dynamics is central to market forecasting and execution-strategy evaluation. While diffusion models achieve strong empirical performance, existing LOB snapshot models typically lack a learned recurrent encoder and formal statistical guarantees. We introduce LOBGrad, a conditional DDPM framework for probabilistic LOB forecasting that combines an autoregressive RNN encoder with a diffusion-based generator. In particular, we establish an excess-risk oracle inequality for the one-step DDPM noise-prediction objective under exponential mixing and regularity assumptions. We further show that, under contractive dynamics, the dependence on the conditioning-window length can be reduced to a dependence on the latent-state dimension. Experiments on BTC/USDT, GOOGL, and META show that LOBGrad improves on its encoder-free diffusion ablation across all reported queue metrics and obtains competitive results against other baselines. It also reproduces the key stylized facts of LOB microstructure, and yields reasonably calibrated queue-based predictive intervals. A stylized downstream task illustrates the potential value of the generated forecasts.
summary: 本文提出LOBGrad，一种结合自回归RNN编码器与DDPM生成器的条件扩散模型，用于限价订单簿（LOB）的概率预测，并在指数混合与正则性假设下给出了一步DDPM噪声预测目标的超额风险oracle不等式，进一步证明在收缩动态下条件窗口长度的依赖可降为潜在状态维度的依赖。在BTC/USDT、GOOGL、META上，模型在所有报告的队列指标上优于无编码器的扩散消融版本，并与其他基线具有竞争力，同时复现了LOB微观结构的关键典型事实，给出校准合理的队列预测区间；还通过一个示例性下游任务展示了生成预测的潜在价值。对实战交易有一定参考价值（概率预测、区间校准、微观结构拟合），但缺乏直接交易策略/收益回测，理论保证依赖较强假设，故评分6。

title: More Mentions, Less Information? Diagnosing Identity and Alignment in Reddit Embeddings for Volatility Forecasting
abstract: Since the 2021 GameStop short squeeze, r/WallStreetBets (WSB) has been associated with episodes of extreme volatility, and its text is increasingly used to forecast volatility. A model using only large language model (LLM) embeddings of WSB posts attains an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.13 for log realized variance. That number shows predictive power, but it does not reveal where the information comes from or how much the text adds beyond a firm's own volatility history. We answer these questions with a diagnostic protocol that nests embeddings on a heterogeneous autoregressive (HAR) benchmark, compares them with text-free firm-identity controls, shuffles the day-to-text pairing within firm-years to test day-specific alignment, and checks whether gains persist across periods and coverage groups. We apply the protocol to frozen LLM embeddings in a panel of 202,145 mentioned stock-days, using retrospective rolling out-of-sample tests over 2015-2022. The results indicate that most of the standalone fit reflects firm or firm-year information: on firms seen in training, a text-free firm baseline reaches $R^2 = 0.32$, shuffling preserves 89-92% of the standalone fit, and masking ticker strings reduces standalone $R^2$ to -0.005. Adding embeddings to HAR reduces equal-date MSE by 1.22% (95% CI [0.94, 1.49]). This small but statistically significant gain survives firm controls and ticker masking, but is largely eliminated by alignment shuffling. The gain is concentrated in 2015-2019 and is not distinguishable from zero in 2020-2022. Expanding coverage by 48% through off-hours and weekend posts adds stock-days with no reliable positive increment. More mentions therefore do not imply more incremental forecasting information.
summary: 论文诊断Reddit（r/WallStreetBets）LLM嵌入对波动率预测的真实信息含量。核心发现：仅用文本嵌入对对数实现方差取得0.13的样本外R²，但把嵌入嵌套进HAR基准、加入无文本的公司/公司-年身份控制、并在公司-年内打乱“日-文本”配对后，大部分独立拟合来自公司身份而非日期特定文本信息——训练中见过的公司上无文本公司基线达R²=0.32，打乱后仍保留89-92%的独立拟合，掩盖ticker字符串后增益进一步变化。方法为202,145个被提及股票-日面板上的回顾性滚动样本外测试（2015-2022）。对实战交易的价值：提醒不要把社交媒体嵌入的“预测力”误当作可交易信号，需用无文本基线和打乱检验做严格归因；对事件驱动/波动率择时策略属中等实用（评分6）。

title: Bias correcting transaction cost models for characteristic function based estimators
abstract: Effective transaction cost is a necessary step for devising any competing financial trading strategy in the absence of quote data. Classically, Roll's model estimated the transaction cost using the first order autocovariance of the difference between daily transaction prices, while Hasbrouck's Bayesian approach used iterative posterior simulation. However, Roll's model fails when the first order autocovariance becomes positive, while Hasbrouck's estimator is computationally intensive, especially when many securities are involved. We develop empirical characteristic function methods with a first order bias correcting for spread estimation, and establish the asymptotic distribution of the corrected estimator under suitable conditions. Our numerical experiments illustrate the bias-variance tradeoff of characteristic-function methods compared to Roll's model, and their computational advantage over Hasbrouck's model.
summary: 该论文提出用经验特征函数方法估计有效交易成本（价差），并对一阶偏差进行校正，给出了校正估计量的渐近分布。相比Roll模型（一阶自协方差为正时失效），新方法更稳健；相比Hasbrouck贝叶斯方法（迭代后验模拟，计算量大），新方法计算更快，适合多证券场景。数值实验展示了偏差-方差权衡和计算优势。实战价值中等：交易成本估计是策略回测与执行的关键输入，方法在无报价数据时实用且计算高效，但属于成本建模而非alpha预测/强化学习/深度学习，偏统计方法层面。

title: The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions
abstract: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and recovery, with documented exceptions. The discipline held for all four agents. Agents kept 97.5% of gross loss within declared stops, and typical losses closed at declared levels. Declared risk remained stable after losses and broadly stable across calm and volatile months. Twenty-three of 24 runs respected the position limit; logs identify the exception's size and duration. The same live data produced different results across assigned strategies. The trade-log tests can be rerun from the published trade snapshot; regime tests also require the published Bitcoin prices and regime labels. Section 3.5 specifies the stop-breach tolerance. These trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge. Our study provides an evaluation toolkit to help traders distinguish rule-following from luck before committing capital. For anyone considering allocating capital to agents to trade, discipline should be the entry test, not the only test.
summary: 研究测试了四个AI交易智能体是否遵守各自策略与风控规则，覆盖2026年2月12日至8月27日共2,627个已平仓头寸；多数为基于实时价格的模拟盘（含0.09%往返手续费），18%为Hyperliquid真实订单，每个智能体最多5个持仓。整体在扣除费用后净盈利，四个智能体的规则遵守度均较高（包括亏损的那个），盈利与否取决于胜率相对盈亏平衡胜率的匹配程度；机构式默认控制在一轮29%市场回撤及修复中限制住了亏损，97.5%的总亏损保持在既定止损范围内，风险敞口在亏损后保持稳定。该文属实证/工程评估类，对实战有参考价值但并非RL/深度学习/Alpha信号类研究，故给中位分5分。

title: Topological Compression of Prediction Market Belief States for Event Forecasting
abstract: Topological Data Analysis (TDA) and Persistent Homology (PH) have been utilized in numerous fields$-$from protein modeling to financial analysis$-$to understand the underlying structure of data. In this paper, we incorporate TDA and PH into forecasting models over a prediction market universe to determine whether the belief state of such markets forms an underlying structure whose shape can provide predictive insight. We conclude that single-parameter PH is able to improve predictive ability and calibrated accuracy of linear forecasting models, while two-parameter multipersistence produces similar benefits for nonlinear models.
summary: 本文研究将拓扑数据分析(TDA)与持久同调(PH)引入预测市场的事件预测模型：单参数PH可提升线性预测模型的预测力与校准精度，双参数多持久(multipersistence)对非线性模型有类似增益。结论属方法层面的实证发现，有潜在交易应用价值，但偏学术、未见明确策略回测或实盘验证，故评为中等。

title: Teacher Supervision, Fixed Representations and Calibration: Exact Risk Calculations for Candidate-Scoring Decision Models
abstract: Candidate-scoring decision models return a probability distribution over a presented set of answers. Public documentation of one such system, Jev, and of an open counterpart, JevAny, describes three training ingredients that determine what these probabilities estimate: soft targets from larger models, a frozen pretrained backbone and temperature calibration. We analyze each ingredient in Gaussian surrogates where the finite-sample risk can be computed exactly. A student trained on teacher targets inherits the teacher's bias, which more student data does not remove and agreement with the teacher does not reveal. A fixed representation lowers the risk only below an explicit sample-size threshold. In a probit model the exact recalibration map is a temperature scaling, which removes all excess risk only when the teacher's coefficient has the correct direction and otherwise leaves a residual that calibration diagnostics do not detect. Under Luce's choice axiom, candidate scores are coherent across refinements of an event if and only if they aggregate by log-sum-exp. On 231,521 credit card complaints from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, where the decision is whether a complaint ends in monetary relief, a student trained on a logistic teacher's probabilities ends at the teacher's decision cost while a student trained on outcomes goes 8% below it, a 30B model read zero-shot remains worse than the teacher after recalibration, and that model departs from the coherence condition by 17.5 decibans. Pretrained representations reduce the labeled data required and calibration corrects the scale of the probabilities, but neither corrects a biased teacher, so the probabilities have to be checked against realized outcomes.
summary: 论文研究候选评分决策模型(如Jev/JevAny)的三类训练要素：软标签蒸馏、冻结预训练骨干、温度校准，在高斯替代模型下精确计算有限样本风险。主要结论：学生继承教师偏差且增加数据无法消除；固定表示仅在低于显式样本阈值时降低风险；probit模型中精确重校准为温度缩放，仅当教师系数方向正确时消除超额风险，否则残留风险且校准诊断无法检测；在Luce选择公理下，候选分数需按log-sum-exp聚合才具一致性。实证用CFPB 231,521条信用卡投诉数据。属于理论+校准分析，与实战交易(RL/深度学习/Alpha挖掘)关联弱，故给4分。

title: Probability-Weighting Functions for Normal Tempered-Stable Laws: Orthogonal Channels and Information-Theoretic Indices
abstract: A probability-weighting function (PWF) maps objective probabilities into decision weights. We construct PWFs from changes in the distribution of returns rather than from a parametric family: with prior and posterior return distributions $F_{prior}$ and $F_{post}$, the PWF is $w(p) = F_{post}(F_{prior}^{-1}(p))$. Both distributions are normal tempered-stable (NTS), and the posterior differs from the prior along one of three channels, each isolated with the variance held fixed: scale, skewness and tail thickness. Around a symmetric benchmark with excess kurtosis 3, a 40% change in scale moves cumulative probabilities by up to 7 to 8 percentage points, a skewness of $\pm 0.5$ by 2 percentage points, and a change of $\pm 0.3$ in the tail index by about 2 percentage points. The three channels leave distinct signatures: the deviation $w(p) - p$ changes sign once, twice and three times, respectively. Three information-theoretic indices (a Fisher-normalized logit shift, a signed Jensen-Shannon divergence and a log-odds elasticity) summarize the distortions and avoid the endpoint singularity of the classical ratio $(w(p)-p)/[p(1-p)]$. Applied to NTS parameters calibrated to S&P 500 ETF daily returns over 2015-2025, the same channels produce distortions of 2 to 7 percentage points. Code that reproduces every figure and number in the paper is provided.
summary: 本文提出用先验与后验收益分布构造概率权重函数（PWF）：w(p)=F_post(F_prior^{-1}(p))，两分布均为normal tempered-stable（NTS），并在方差固定下沿尺度、偏度、尾部厚度三个正交渠道隔离后验变化。以超额峰度3的对称基准为例，尺度变化40%使累积概率移动7-8个百分点，偏度±0.5约2个百分点，尾部指数±0.3约2个百分点；三渠道对w(p)-p的符号变化次数分别为1、2、3次，形成可区分特征。作者还提出三个信息论指标（Fisher归一化logit位移、有符号Jensen-Shannon散度、对数几率弹性）以规避经典比率(w(p)-p)/[p(1-p)]的端点奇异性，并应用于标定至S&P 500 ETF日频数据的NTS参数。该文属行为决策/概率加权理论研究，对实盘alpha、强化学习或深度学习交易无直接可执行信号，仅提供风险偏好建模与分布扭曲度量的间接参考，故实战价值中等偏低。

title: Conditional Weight of Evidence for Gradient-Boosted Credit Models: Estimation, Additivity and Its Relation to Adverse Action Reasons
abstract: Traditional weight of evidence assigns a credit characteristic a value based on its association with default across a population. Credit analysis also requires an assessment of that characteristic in the context of an individual applicant's record. We study conditional weight of evidence for this purpose. It measures the change in default log odds from observing a characteristic after the remaining credit information is known. Its sign identifies whether the characteristic adds adverse or favorable information for that applicant, and its magnitude measures the strength of that information. The same characteristic value can therefore receive different assessments for applicants with different payment histories or other credit attributes. We develop estimators using gradient-boosted trees and evaluate their accuracy in a bureau-style simulation. Regressions of the full model's predicted probabilities recover conditional evidence more accurately than separate models fitted to default outcomes, provided the full model is accurate. They also recover a deliberately constructed file-age effect whose direction varies with utilization and is often missed by marginal weight of evidence. Local class-frequency estimates improve on marginal weight of evidence but remain inaccurate for some weak effects. An application to FICO HELOC data illustrates estimation when the population evidence is unknown. Conditional weight of evidence provides an applicant-specific interpretation of the information in a credit characteristic; its population summary, a conditional information value, splits the joint information in the record across blocks when averaged over orderings. Neither is an adverse action reason, which explains the fitted score difference between the applicant and chosen passing records.
summary: 该论文研究梯度提升信用模型的「条件证据权重」（Conditional Weight of Evidence），通过梯度提升树估计在已知其余信用信息后，单个特征对违约对数几率变化的贡献；其符号与大小分别表示对个体申请人有利/不利的信息强度，同一特征值可因还款历史不同而得到不同评估。该研究属于信用风险建模与可解释性/监管合规（不利行动理由）方向，与量化交易中的RL/深度学习/Alpha挖掘关系较弱，实战价值有限，更偏方法论与风控解释性研究。

title: Optimal Trading Filters and the Value of Predictive Signals
abstract: The value of a forecast depends on its accuracy, but also on its actionability. In trading, an investor must translate return forecasts into positions while accounting for trading costs and the lingering impact of earlier trades. We solve the stationary quadratic trading problem with transient price impact using tools from prediction theory: Wiener-Hopf factorization gives the optimal policy as the composition of a conditional forecast and an explicit causal linear filter. We recover the Gârleanu-Pedersen aim-portfolio under exponential resilience and derive fractional trading filters under power-law impact decay, requiring memory beyond finite-dimensional LQR control. At fixed positive risk penalty, signals of equal instantaneous predictive strength have equal frictionless Markowitz value. With trading costs, net attainable value is determined by the mean square of the friction-weighted conditional forecast. Under power-law impact with exposure bleeding, we find an intermediate optimal mean-reversion rate for Ornstein-Uhlenbeck signals.
summary: 本文从预测理论视角求解带瞬态价格冲击的平稳二次型交易问题，用Wiener-Hopf分解将最优策略表示为条件预测与显式因果线性滤波器的复合：指数弹性下可恢复Gârleanu-Pedersen的aim-portfolio，幂律冲击衰减下则导出分数型交易滤波器，需要超出有限维LQR控制的记忆结构。研究表明，在固定正风险惩罚下，瞬时预测强度相同的信号具有相同的无摩擦Markowitz价值；存在交易成本时，净可实现价值由摩擦加权条件预测的均方决定；在带暴露衰减的幂律冲击下，Ornstein-Uhlenbeck信号存在中间最优均值回归速率。本文为纯理论工作，对理解交易成本下的信号价值与滤波器设计有启发，但缺少实证与可直接落地的策略，实战价值有限。

title: Combinatorial Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
abstract: We develop a framework to identify and quantify arbitrage across logically related prediction-market contracts. We prove that prices outside the convex hull of admissible payoff vectors admit arbitrage and identify optimal arbitrage portfolios through integer programming. Using venue metadata and semantic analysis of resolution criteria, we recover 1.9 million logical relations and compile them into constraint systems covering more than 255,000 contracts. We replay full-depth Polymarket order books to simulate an arbitrageur executing these portfolios against resting orders. Among settled portfolios, guaranteed profit after spreads and fees equals 2.2% of committed capital, while profit at resolution reaches 3.2%. We find that arbitrage opportunities persist longer and attract less observed participation where relation discovery and execution are more costly.
summary: 该论文构建了一个跨逻辑相关预测市场合约的套利识别与量化框架：证明价格落在可行收益向量凸包之外即存在套利，并用整数规划求解最优套利组合；利用场所元数据和结算规则的语义分析恢复190万条逻辑关系，构建覆盖超25.5万合约的约束系统；回放Polymarket全深度订单簿模拟套利者执行，扣除买卖价差和费用后，已结算组合的保证利润为投入资本的2.2%，到期结算利润达3.2%；并发现关系发现与执行成本越高，套利机会持续越久、参与越少。该研究基于真实订单簿与费用结构，属于可直接落地的市场微观结构与统计套利实战工作，但对RL/深度学习/Alpha因子贡献有限，故评8分。

title: OrderFlowDiT: Transport-Regularized Diffusion Transformer for Probabilistic Limit-Order Supply Forecasting
abstract: We study the conditional distribution of limit-order volume submitted over the next five minutes, given the current order book and recent order flow. The task requires capturing price placement, total volume, and predictive uncertainty jointly. Coordinate-wise diffusion losses do not explicitly account for price displacement, while normalizing fields to unit mass removes information about total volume. Agreement on selected summary statistics also does not establish fidelity to the joint field distribution. We introduce OrderFlowDiT, a conditional Diffusion Transformer for unnormalized bid and ask volume-at-price fields, trained with an unbalanced optimal-transport (UOT) auxiliary loss. We also develop a full-field evaluation framework that combines a transport cost sensitive to price placement and total volume with proper scoring rules and calibration diagnostics. In the primary comparison on 1950 validation conditions across 30 U.S. equities, adding UOT reduces full-field transport cost by 45.8% and the transport energy score by 26.1% relative to training with mean squared error alone. Both measures improve for every stock. These findings support incorporating price geometry and volume into generative modeling, with field accuracy and predictive uncertainty evaluated together.
summary: 本文提出 OrderFlowDiT，一种条件扩散 Transformer，用于在给定当前订单簿与近期订单流的情况下，对下一五分钟内提交的限价单量进行概率预测。核心创新包括：(1) 直接对未归一化的买卖量-价场建模，通过不平衡最优传输(UOT)辅助损失显式考虑价格位移与总量；(2) 建立全场评估框架，结合对价格位置与总量敏感的传输成本、proper scoring rules 与校准诊断。在30只美股、1950个验证条件下，加入UOT较仅用MSE训练将全场传输成本降低45.8%、传输能量分数降低26.1%，且每只股票均改善。对实战量化交易具有较高参考价值（订单流预测、执行与做市信号），但尚属预测建模层面、未直接给出交易策略回测，故给7分。

title: Market Efficiency in a Changing Asset Population: Mobility, Entry, and Survival over Cryptocurrency's Full History
abstract: Weak-form efficiency implies symmetry restrictions on the Markov chain governing movement across the cryptocurrency capitalisation distribution. We test them on the full listed population: 8,970 assets, 690 weekly cross-sections, 2013 to 2026, with entry, exit and survival observed rather than inferred. Symmetry is rejected in every era, but the asymmetry falls by seventy percent, and what converged is entry-driven compositional churn rather than coins' own valuations. The bottom decile earns 27.5% per week on paper and nothing among assets that trade, on capacity of $293,000. Compensation for neglect exists precisely where trading does not.
summary: 论文检验弱式有效市场下的对称性约束：在2013–2026年8,970种加密货币、690个周度截面上，用真实观测的进入、退出与存活状态构建市值分布的马尔可夫链。结果：各时期对称性均被拒绝，但不对称程度下降70%，收敛主要来自进入驱动的成分更替，而非币价自身；最低十分位账面周收益27.5%，但在真正可交易的资产中收益为零，容量仅29.3万美元——'被忽视的补偿'恰好存在于无法交易之处。对实战的启示：底部十分位的高收益是幸存/不可交易偏差造成的假象，容量极小，不可直接作为可交易Alpha；论文提供了对低价币策略、流动性筛选与回测偏差控制的重要警示，但缺乏可落地的执行信号或模型。

title: Reading the News Without Hindsight: NoLBERT Topics and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns
abstract: Language models that read financial news are usually trained on text from the same years used to test them, so a backtest can reward hindsight. We build news topics from NoLBERT, an encoder pretrained only on text published between 1976 and 1995, adapted into a sentence encoder by contrastive fine-tuning on passages of the same article, with no labels or returns. We compare it with LDA, MiniLM and FinBERT readers on 1.26 million articles from 2012 to 2024, convert each reader's topics into attention shocks and stock exposures, and forecast the returns of the 1,000 largest US stocks with eight models at three rebalancing frequencies. Models are fitted on 2013-2019, choices are made on 2020-2021, and 2022-2024 is held out. The experiment with the best validation score loses money at every frequency. Measuring attention shocks against the past 63 trading days instead of 5 raises the test rank IC of every reader. NoLBERT gives the most stable topics and forecasts about as well as LDA. An equal-weight combination of all readers and models earns a monthly net Sharpe ratio of 1.12, significant against zero before adjusting for the search but not against a price-only benchmark.
summary: 该论文用仅在1976-1995年文本上预训练的NoLBERT构建新闻主题，避免回测中的后视偏差，并与LDA、MiniLM、FinBERT在126万篇2012-2024年文章上对比；将主题转为注意力冲击与股票暴露，对1000只最大美股在三种调仓频率下用八个模型预测收益，训练2013-2019、验证2020-2021、测试2022-2024。最优验证模型在各频率均亏损；以过去63个交易日而非5日衡量注意力冲击可提升所有读者的测试秩IC；NoLBERT主题最稳定，预测力与LDA相当；全体读者与模型等权组合月净Sharpe 1.12，未调搜索前显著异于零，但相对纯价格基准不显著。对实战有一定参考价值，但作者自证的优势有限、净alpha不敌价格基准。

title: A novel deep reinforcement learning framework with task-incremental continual forecasting for trading systems
abstract: … for automated trading systems capable of adapting to evolving market conditions. Although Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) has shown promising performance in financial trading, …

title: Cross-product Modelling in Continuous Intraday Electricity Markets via Hawkes Processes
abstract: As renewable energy integration accelerates, intraday continuous (IDC) electricity markets have become essential for short-term balancing. However, the simultaneous trading of overlapping contracts with varying granularities creates complex, hidden liquidity dependencies that are critical to market stability but remain poorly understood. This paper proposes a multivariate State-Dependent Hawkes Process (SDHP) to model cross-product liquidity dynamics between Quarter-Hourly and Hourly IDC contracts. To determine how cross-product effects vary under different market conditions, we classify the trading sessions into two distinct regimes: 'Normal' and 'Stressed', based on a composite metric of the bid-ask spread, mid-price volatility and queue imbalance. The model is calibrated on the first month of each quarter of 2024 using level 3 limit order book (LOB) data from the Dutch EPEX SPOT IDC market. We find that order flow is overwhelmingly self-driven, with roughly 95\% of orders arriving in reaction to earlier orders in both regimes. Cross-excitation runs mainly from the Quarter-Hourly to the Hourly contract, but this leadership weakens under stress: the ratio of cumulative cross-excitation falls from 2.8 to 1.5, so the two contracts influence each other almost equally. Stress also makes the Quarter-Hourly to Hourly channel much faster, cutting its mean lag from 6.05 to 0.93 seconds. The strong seasonal variation found in calm periods largely disappears under stress, where all four months converge to the same structure.
summary: 该论文提出多变量状态依赖Hawkes过程（SDHP），建模荷兰EPEX SPOT日内连续（IDC）市场中15分钟与小时级合约间的跨产品流动性动态。基于2024年各季度首月的L3限价订单簿数据，将交易时段按买卖价差、中间价波动与队列失衡复合指标划分为'常态'与'压力'两种状态。发现订单流约95%为自激发，跨激发主要由15分钟合约传向小时合约，且该领导关系在压力状态下减弱。属于市场微观结构实证建模，对高频/流动性建模有一定参考，但未涉及RL/深度学习或直接alpha策略，实战价值中等。

title: Basis-Only Funding Is Not Dividend Fair: Settlement Design in Crypto Equity Perpetuals
abstract: Crypto venues increasingly list perpetual futures on equities and other real-world assets (RWAs), which trade continuously yet reference dividend-paying stocks: a long equity perpetual marked to the ex-dividend cash price bears the ex-dividend drop without receiving the dividend. We ask whether the premium-index funding architecture these venues run -- funding set from the contemporaneous basis $e_t=P_t-S_t$ rather than a carry target -- can replicate shareholder cash flows for traders entering and exiting at arbitrary times. It cannot. Funding serves two roles that coincide for non-dividend crypto assets but split apart for equities: basis control and settlement. We give the fair-funding identity, cast timing fairness as an optimal-stopping condition, and characterize when the basis is a sufficient statistic for the fair target. The decisive obstruction is measure-theoretic: a predictable dividend is an atom, and no absolutely continuous funding path can replicate an atom over holding intervals even in the weak limit, so fairness must match the atom with an atom -- an event credit. Exchange-native data confirm this: at each covered ex-date one venue posts a discrete funding atom equal to $-D/(\mathrm{Mark}-D)$ while a standard premium-index venue posts none, transferring the dividend across venues -- from native funding alone, with no external spot.
summary: 该论文研究加密交易所推出的股票永续合约（RWAs）的结算设计问题。核心论点是：当前基于基差（basis，e_t=P_t-S_t）的连续资金费率架构无法在任意进出时点为交易者复现股东的现金流（股息）。资金费率承担两个角色——基差控制与结算——对无股息加密资产二者重合，但对股票类资产发生分离。作者给出公允资金费率恒等式，将时点公允性表述为最优停止条件，并刻画基差何时是公允目标的充分统计量。决定性的障碍是测度论的：可预测的股息是一个原子（atom），任何绝对连续的资金费率路径即便在弱极限下也无法在持有区间内复现一个原子，故公允性必须用原子匹配原子——即事件信用（event credit）。交易所原生数据证实：每个覆盖的除息日，某交易所都会发布一个离散的资金费率原子。该论文属理论与机制设计分析，对实战交易（RL/深度学习/Alpha）的直接价值有限，但对理解股票永续合约的定价偏差、资金费率套利与结构性风险有参考意义。

title: Agentic AI in Automated Markets
abstract:
Automated markets increasingly host autonomous, learning trading agents and are powered by formulaic automated market makers (AMMs). We study how heterogeneous agent behavior shapes stress, risk-adjusted performance, liquidity, and volatility in these types of markets. Three behavioral archetypes are modeled as agentic reinforcement learning (RL) systems: a rational arbitrageur, a manipulator, and a retail herd-follower. Each archetype is defined by its reward function within a common, asset-agnostic exposure-control environment, and each is trained with a value-based Deep Q-Network (DQN) and with REINFORCE using a learned baseline.
  A pilot on hourly cryptocurrency data (AAVE, ETC, SUI) motivates the hypotheses. Herd-followers produce the most frequent but shortest stress episodes, manipulators the fewest but most persistent, and rational agents the most stable rolling Sharpe ratios despite higher return volatility. SHAP attributions tie these patterns to drawdown and cross-asset signals, short-term volatility and position state, and momentum, respectively. The results motivate behavior-specific regulation rather than uniform limits on volatility or turnover.
summary: 该论文在小时级加密货币数据（AAVE、ETC、SUI）上，用强化学习（DQN与REINFORCE）建模三类异质agent——理性套利者、操纵者、散户羊群跟随者——在统一资产无关的敞口控制环境中，研究其行为如何影响压力、风险调整后表现、流动性与波动率。初步结果显示：羊群跟随者产生最频繁但最短的压力事件，操纵者最少但最持久，理性agent滚动夏普比率最稳定（尽管收益波动更高）；SHAP归因分别将模式关联到回撤与跨资产信号、短期波动与持仓状态、动量。结论主张按行为类型差异化监管，而非统一限制波动率或换手率。对实战交易价值中等：提供了agent行为压力画像与风险归因思路，但缺乏可交易alpha与回测收益证据，样本仅三个币种，属初步研究。

title: From Alpha to Execution: Trading Horizons, Regimes, and Schedules under Concave Impact and Hurst Scaling
abstract:
Classical execution models assume linear impact, diffusive prices, and an exogenous horizon. We study execution under concave power-law impact and Hurst-scaled price fluctuations, and make two contributions.
  First, we choose the execution horizon by maximizing the Sharpe ratio of the trade's realized P&L. Price moves during the execution window are part of that P&L, so executing more slowly reduces its variance, and because impact is concave it can also lower cost per share. Urgency comes only from alpha realized while the order is being worked. The problem is governed by the signs of two quantities: (i) the duration elasticity of impact $a$, which under a structural prior equals the impact-persistence gap $β- H$ and can take either sign; and (ii) the net urgency $ν$, the rate of alpha realization net of exposure relief. When $ν$ keeps its sign over the window, an interior optimum exists, to leading order in $T/t_f$, only when both are positive; otherwise the order should be worked at the fastest or slowest admissible pace. In the interior regime the first-order condition involves no impact coefficient, order size or volume, and the objective is flat: for a large-cap example, the window within 1% of maximal Sharpe spans more than an order of magnitude.
  Second, given the window, we derive the schedule shape by convex programming under an envelope cost. For any increasing per-share cost of delay $w(t)$, the KKT solution is $φ\propto (λ- w(t))_+^{1/β}$. For a Hurst-scaled envelope $w \propto t^H$, the normalized schedule depends only on $(β, H)$, has a closed form via the incomplete beta function, is front-loaded, and tapers smoothly to zero, saving 10-17% of envelope cost relative to a constant-rate (TWAP) schedule of equal duration. Whether it uses the whole window depends on a single dimensionless robustness level, for which we give a calibration.
summary: 本文在凹性幂律冲击与Hurst标度价格波动下研究执行问题，核心贡献是：通过最大化交易实现盈亏的Sharpe比率来选择执行期限。由于执行窗口内的价格变动计入盈亏，放慢执行可降低方差，且凹性冲击还能降低每股成本；紧迫性仅来自订单执行期间实现的alpha。问题由两个量的符号决定：(i) 冲击的期限弹性a（在结构先验下等于冲击-持续性缺口β−H，可正可负）；(ii) 净紧迫性ν，即alpha实现速率扣除敞口释放。当ν在窗口内保持符号时，仅当两者均为正才存在内点最优（按T/t_f领先阶）；否则应以最快或最慢可行节奏执行。内点区间的一阶条件不含冲击系数、订单规模或成交量，且目标函数平坦。偏纯理论推导，对实战执行的直接可操作价值有限，但期限选择与冲击-持续性缺口的直觉对执行算法设计有一定参考意义。

title: Market Impact Estimation via Causal Foundation Models
abstract: When a trader executes a large order, the relevant question is not \emph{what will the price be?} but \emph{what would the price have been had I not traded?} Market impact is thus a causal quantity, yet classical models (Almgren--Chriss, propagators) regress price on flow, which is biased whenever informed flow moves prices through information as well as trading. We present a proof-of-concept \emph{Causal Market Simulator}: a continuous-time causal prior-data fitted network (PFN) trained on a synthetic market prior in which a hidden informational flow confounds the flow--price relation by construction, with confounding strength an exact per-episode knob. On this prior, the naive estimator's bias follows a closed form we confirm empirically (up to 68\% overestimation), while the PFN tracks the unbiased true-parameter oracle at high confounding. Its \emph{do-ablated twin}, the same model with the intervention inputs removed, collapses onto the pre-window mean. Zero-shot, the model responds at the ground-truth scale to metaorders in an ABIDES limit-order book ($+0.38$ pre-onset standard deviations against seed-replay counterfactuals), and its intervention response replicates on about 2,300 detected flow bursts in BTC/ETH/SOL perpetuals and 3,800 on Nasdaq equities, evidence consistent with, though not proof of, causal transfer. Off-prior the response degrades gracefully, and split-conformal recalibration repairs interval calibration. Transfer hinges on encoding the metaorder as added flow rather than a clamped price level, not on more training. A recurrent state-space variant closes the remaining shape gap: its impact accrues over execution duration where the transformer's stays flat, raising the correlation with measured metaorder impact from $+0.68$ to between $+0.92$ and $+0.96$, at the cost of weaker on-prior deconfounding that traces to the training recipe rather than to recurrence.
summary: 该论文将市场冲击建模为因果量（反事实：若不交易价格会如何），提出基于合成市场先验的连续时间因果PFN概念验证模拟器。该先验中隐藏信息流按构造混淆了订单流-价格关系，且混淆强度为每回合可调参数。在此先验上，朴素估计器的偏差有闭式解（经验证实高估达68%），而PFN在高混淆下追踪无偏的真实参数oracle；移除干预输入的do-消融孪生模型坍缩到窗口前均值。零样本下，模型在ABIDES限价订单簿中对metaorder的响应达到真实尺度（相对种子重放反事实+0.38个发作前标准差）。对实战交易：提供了因果校正市场冲击估计的思路和可调混淆的仿真基准，对执行算法/交易成本分析有参考价值，但仍是合成先验上的概念验证，未在真实数据上验证，直接落地信号有限，故评6分。

title: RICE-Alpha: Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs for LLM-Agent Stock Forecasting
abstract: Equity-relevant news evolves through temporally dependent corporate events, making historical information useful only when event continuity, information availability, and transition reliability are modeled. Existing LLM-based financial agents incorporate historical evidence, yet they provide limited support for preserving issuer-specific chronology under point-in-time constraints and for identifying when historical transitions contribute information beyond the current forecast. We present RICE-Alpha (Reliability-Informed Correction with Event Graphs), a point-in-time stock-scoring framework that separates a history-aware multi-view Base Alpha from a reliability-calibrated residual correction derived from historical event continuation. A Multi-Tier Memory Layer grounds news interpretation in temporally eligible issuer-specific history, while a Typed Event Agent constructs event states whose successor relations are formed within issuers and pooled across firms only after valid local pairing. Matured transitions are calibrated by their empirical reliability, and the resulting graph signal is residualized against the Base Alpha and technical view to obtain the RICE Delta. On daily Nasdaq-100 and Hang Seng Index panels from 2024 to 2026, RICE-Alpha achieves the strongest results among the evaluated LLM-based agents and momentum across four predictive and four portfolio-level metrics. Its ICIR more than doubles that of the strongest baseline, while net Sharpe ratios reach 1.656 and 1.725 in the U.S. and Hong Kong, respectively. U.S. ablations further show significant reductions in IC and RankIC after Holm adjustment when major components are removed. These results indicate that historical event continuation adds incremental information when it is temporally grounded, reliability-calibrated, and introduced as a residual correction to a multi-view forecast.
summary: RICE-Alpha 是一个 point-in-time 股票评分框架，将历史感知的多视角 Base Alpha 与基于历史事件延续性的可靠性校准残差修正分开。多层记忆层将新闻解读锚定在时间上合规的发行人特定历史中；Typed Event Agent 构建事件状态，其后继关系先在发行人体内形成、再在有效局部配对后跨公司池化。成熟转移按经验可靠性校准，得到的图信号对 Base Alpha 和技术视角做残差化以获得 RICE Delta。摘要提及在 Nasdaq 日频数据上评估（内容截断）。
