abstract: … Recent studies have begun to validate the Transformer's potential in finance. For instance, Transformer-based models have been shown to outperform LSTMs in stock prediction [5], and …
summary: 该论文研究用Transformer网络增强多因子选股，并与传统机器学习模型进行对比分析。摘要提到已有研究开始验证Transformer在金融领域的潜力，例如基于Transformer的模型在股票预测中优于LSTM。核心贡献是评估Transformer在多因子选股场景的有效性，属于深度学习选股的应用型研究而非纯理论，但摘要信息有限，缺少回测、交易成本、风险调整收益等实战关键维度，因此对实战交易价值评为中等。

title: From Algorithms to Agents: A Survey of LLM-Based Trading Systems
abstract: … agents, but the literature is fragmented across markets, architectures, and evaluation practices. This survey traces the path from quantitative trading to LLM agents… rerun agents shrink or …
summary: 该综述梳理了从量化交易到LLM智能体的演进路径，指出相关文献在市场、架构与评估实践上较为碎片化。核心内容围绕LLM交易智能体的架构与评测展开，提到重跑智能体（rerun agents）在表现上会出现缩水等现象，反映现有评估的不稳定性。整体偏综述与理论梳理，缺乏可直接落地的RL/深度学习/Alpha策略细节，实战价值中等偏低。

title: FOMO: FLEX Options and Market Outcomes
abstract: FLEX options are customized exchange-traded contracts allowing participants to choose nonstandard strikes, expirations, exercise styles, and settlement terms while retaining central clearing. We investigate whether single-name FLEX activity leaves measurable footprints in regular listed-option markets and underlying equities. Using a linked dataset of FLEX consolidations, daily open-interest files, listed-option chains, equity returns, and corporate actions over 250 trading days (March 2025-March 2026) across 41 underlyings and 53 event dates, we document three primary empirical findings: (1) Matched-control difference-in-differences estimates reveal a robust post-event increase in listed-option open interest (beta = 0.3061, p = 0.0042, Benjamini-Hochberg p = 0.0168). (2) FLEX activity is strongly selected into high implied-volatility (IV) environments, concentrated in mid-price underlyings (date-fixed-effect ATM IV premium beta = 0.1235, p = 0.0030). (3) Event-day IV-minus-realized-volatility spreads predict execution-stressed short-straddle returns (beta = 0.0366, p = 0.0100). Short-lived equity return effects (CAR_0 difference of -0.85%, p = 0.0442) do not persist over 1-to-5-day horizons. Overall, FLEX activity serves primarily as an observable marker of institutional volatility demand and open-interest positioning rather than a directional stock-return predictor.
summary: 论文研究FLEX期权（可定制行权价、到期日、行权方式与结算条款的交易所清算合约）活动是否在普通上市期权与标的正股中留下可测足迹。基于2025年3月至2026年3月250个交易日、41个标的、53个事件日的关联数据集，发现：(1) 匹配对照DID显示事件后上市期权未平仓量显著上升（beta=0.3061, p=0.0042, BH p=0.0168）；(2) FLEX活动强烈选择高隐含波动率(IV)环境，集中于中价标的（日期固定效应ATM IV溢价 beta=0.1235, p=0.0030）；(3) 事件日IV减已实现波动率价差可预测执行压力下的short-straddle收益（beta=0.0366, p=0.0100）；短暂股票收益效应（CAR_0差-0.85%, p=0.0442）在1-5日内不持续。对实战而言，提供FLEX作为IV环境与期权持仓变化的观测信号，但缺乏可直接部署的强alpha/RL策略，属半实证、信号价值有限。

title: The Financing of Debt Relief: Intermediary Liquidity and the Value of Borrower Information
abstract: I study how intermediary liquidity affects mortgage resolution using 1.9 million Ginnie Mae buyout options from 2019 to 2022. When funding markets froze in 2020, nonbank issuers repurchased far fewer delinquent loans than depositories servicing loans in the same pools and, within the same issuer and month, shifted repurchases away from large balances, the loans that require the most cash. About $19 billion of repurchases were delayed, and most were completed later. A model of rationing by value per dollar of cash explains this pattern and shows that borrower information is most valuable when funding is intermediate.
summary: 本文利用2019-2022年190万份Ginnie Mae买断期权，研究中间机构流动性如何影响抵押贷款处置。2020年融资市场冻结时，非银行发行人回购的违约贷款远少于同一资金池中存款类服务商，且在同一发行人和月份内，将回购从大额余额（最需现金的贷款）转移开。约190亿美元回购被延迟，多数后来完成。一个按每美元现金价值配给模型解释了该模式，并表明借款人信息在融资处于中间水平时最有价值。

title: Research on Deep Learning-Based Quantitative Trading Models
abstract: … This paper examines the role of quantitative trading in finance and the potential applications of deep learning. Quantitative trading automates investment strategies using mathematical …
summary: 该论文为综述性研究，探讨量化交易在金融中的作用及深度学习的潜在应用，指出量化交易利用数学模型自动化投资策略。摘要未涉及具体模型架构、强化学习、因子挖掘或回测实证，缺乏可落地的策略细节与实盘验证，实战价值有限，属于理论/综述层面。

title: The Impact of Sentiment Integration on Algorithmic Trading Performance: A Systematic Review of Multi-Modal Machine Learning Architectures
abstract: … algorithmic trading strategies (Population), compared to baseline models utilizing only structured financial data (Comparison), on risk-adjusted performance and predictive accuracy (…
summary: 该论文是一篇系统性综述，考察将情绪信号（如新闻、社交媒体等非结构化文本）整合进多模态机器学习架构后，对算法交易策略的风险调整后收益与预测准确率的影响，并与仅使用结构化金融数据的基线模型进行对比。核心在于归纳多模态（结构化数据+情绪文本）机器学习在算法交易中的架构与实证效果，而非提出新的可交易Alpha或强化学习策略。对实战的价值主要是提供情绪因子与多模态融合方法的证据梳理，可作为构建情绪增强型策略的参考，但缺乏可直接落地的模型细节与回测验证，属于偏理论/综述性质，实战价值中等偏下。

title: Where Backtests and Live Trading Part Ways: Six Defects from One Intraday System
abstract: Backtests of intraday strategies can drift away from what the live system actually does; in our case, the drift never showed in summary statistics. We report six defects found while running one intraday US equity system live and comparing its live days with their backtest replay. Three came from data: a default feed that carried a small fraction of real opening volume, historical prices adjusted for dividends that live orders never see, and data the live system downloaded but the backtest never did. Two came from code: a sizing step that exceeded a limit the live account enforces, and UTC timestamps read as New York time. One came from configuration: settings that were switched on but never reached the code that places orders. For each we give the symptom, the size of the error, the cause and the test or control that now guards against it. All six sat where two paths that should agree had drifted apart. We close with a ten-point checklist. We make no claim about whether the system is profitable.
summary: 本文报告了一个实盘运行的美国股票日内系统与回测重放对比中发现的六类缺陷，这些缺陷未在汇总统计中显现。三类来自数据：默认数据源只携带真实开盘成交量的一小部分、历史价格按股息调整而实盘订单从不如此、实盘系统下载但回测从未使用的数据。两类来自代码：仓位规模步骤超出实盘账户限制、将UTC时间戳误读为纽约时间。一类来自配置：设置已开启但从未到达下单代码。每个缺陷均给出症状、误差大小、原因及当前防护措施。所有缺陷都出现在本应一致的两条路径发生偏离之处。文末附十点检查清单。作者未声称系统是否盈利。

title: MLP-Initialized Reinforcement Learning for Exit Timing in SPX Short-Straddle Portfolios
abstract: This paper studies exit timing for SPX short-straddle portfolios using a two-stage supervised and reinforcement-learning framework. Historical episodes first generate ex-post optimal hold/exit labels for training a multilayer perceptron (MLP) using only contemporaneously available state variables at deployment. The trained MLP then initializes reinforcement-learning actors that are fine-tuned with a risk-aware trading reward. Out-of-sample evaluation over 2024-2026 shows that the supervised MLP substantially outperforms passive holding and representative fixed-time and profit-and-loss-based exit rules. Across seven independent seeds, MLP-initialized Actor-Critic averages 37.54% cumulative return and a Sharpe ratio of 1.705, compared with 35.01% and 1.651 for the supervised MLP. Actor-Critic trained from scratch averages only 0.18% return. These findings show that oracle-guided supervised learning provides a stable foundation for reward-based policy fine-tuning in a sparse and path-dependent option-exit problem.
summary: 本文研究SPX空头跨式组合的退出时机，采用两阶段监督学习与强化学习框架。首先从历史片段生成事后最优持有/退出标签，仅使用部署时同期可用的状态变量训练多层感知机（MLP）。训练后的MLP初始化强化学习actor，并用风险感知的交易奖励微调。2024-2026年样本外评估显示，监督MLP显著优于被动持有及代表性的固定时间、盈亏类退出规则。在七个独立随机种子下，MLP初始化的Actor-Critic平均累计收益37.54%，夏普比率1.705；监督MLP为35.01%和1.651；从头训练的Actor-Critic平均仅0.18%收益。结果表明， oracle引导的监督学习为稀疏且路径依赖的期权退出问题中的奖励策略微调提供了稳定基础。

title: StochLOB: Heavy-Tailed Score Matching for Robust Limit Order Book Trend Prediction
abstract: Score-based diffusion methods usually perturb data with Brownian Gaussian noise, corresponding to a light-tailed forward stochastic differential equation (SDE). For market time series this SDE can be a poor abstraction: limit order book (LOB) order flow is heavy-tailed, bursty, and occasionally jump-like. We study STOCHLOB, a training-only score-matching framework that changes the forward diffusion corruption law while leaving the deployed predictor deterministic. Instead of Brownian-only Gaussian corruption, the noising process uses two non-Gaussian SDE-inspired alternatives: jump-Lévy noise through a compound-Poisson variance mixture, and clipped $α$-stable noise through a positive-stable Gaussian scale mixture. These corruptions inject finite jumps and heavy-tailed residuals into training without requiring reverse-time diffusion sampling at inference. The resulting score target has a useful interpretation: its radial factor $h_t(r)$ is the posterior expected corruption precision, so large residuals are weighted according to the latent corruption scale that most plausibly generated them. On chronologically held-out Coinbase LOB data, the proposed variants remain competitive on uncorrupted BTC and altcoin test horizons and improve several realized tail-window stress diagnostics. An exploratory Feishu A-share transfer study further tests whether the probability outputs remain usable under transaction costs and trading-rule constraints. Code and configuration files are available at https://github.com/ArshiAbolghasemi/Penny.
summary: 该论文提出STOCHLOB，一种仅训练阶段使用的score-matching框架，将前向扩散的噪声从布朗高斯改为两种非高斯SDE启发替代：复合泊松方差混合的跳跃-Lévy噪声，以及正稳定高斯尺度混合的截断α稳定噪声。这些腐蚀在训练中注入有限跳跃和重尾残差，但推理时部署的预测器仍是确定性的，无需反向扩散采样。score目标具有可解释性：径向因子h_t(r)为后验期望腐蚀精度，大残差根据最可能生成它的潜在腐蚀尺度加权。在Coinbase LOB时间顺序留出数据上，所提变体保持竞争力。对实战交易有价值，因其直接针对LOB重尾、爆发和跳跃特性改进趋势预测，且推理高效，但摘要未给出完整性能指标，故评分7。

title: Extending the Oracle Approximating Shrinkage to General Distributions
abstract: The Oracle Approximating Shrinkage (OAS) estimator provides a closed-form, data-driven shrinkage intensity for regularizing sample covariance matrices toward a scaled identity target, but its derivation assumes Gaussian data. In practice, financial returns, neural signals, and many other high-dimensional datasets exhibit heavy tails and non-zero kurtosis, violating this assumption. We extend OAS to any distribution with finite fourth moments by incorporating a correction term $α$ built from the fourth-order joint cumulants of the data. The correction vanishes under Gaussianity, recovering the OAS formula as a special case; it admits a consistent $O(np)$ sample estimator and satisfies $ρ\in [0, 1]$ exactly for both the population cumulant and its sample analogue. Simulations and an equity-returns study confirm that the correction closes the gap between OAS and the Ledoit-Wolf estimator under non-Gaussian data, with OAS-Extended performing comparably across all tested settings. The contribution is a principled correction for OAS practitioners facing heavy-tailed data; structurally, it is distinct from prior work extending Ledoit-Wolf to elliptical distributions, which optimizes against a fixed oracle target and yields a different closed-form formula.
summary: 该论文将Oracle Approximating Shrinkage (OAS)协方差估计器从高斯假设推广到任何具有有限四阶矩的分布，通过引入基于四阶联合累积量的修正项α，使收缩强度ρ在总体和样本版本中均严格落在[0,1]内，并在高斯下退化为原OAS公式。模拟和股票收益实证表明，该修正缩小了OAS与Ledoit-Wolf估计器在非高斯数据下的差距，且OAS-Extended在所有测试场景中表现相当。对实战量化交易而言，协方差矩阵正则化是组合优化、风险管理和统计套利的基础环节，该扩展直接针对金融收益的厚尾与非零峰度问题，提供了闭式、数据驱动的改进，具有中等偏上的实用价值，但并非直接的alpha或深度学习策略创新。

title: How Much Screening Buys a Second? Speed, Selection, and the Maker's Spread
abstract: We study the spread a liquidity provider needs to break even against counterparties that can exploit a stale quote, and we place two defenses on a single scale: repricing sooner and screening informed flow. A break-even condition pins down the exact screening rate at which a slower maker matches a faster unscreened venue: the selection that buys back the extra staleness. The result requires only an integrable price innovation and therefore holds under jumps, atoms, and infinite variance. Predictable drift is a centering problem: it widens a spot-centered quote, but its cost vanishes once the quote is recentered on the expected reference. In four USDC-WETH pools benchmarked against Binance ETH-USDT from June to August 2026, the one-second benchmark innovation is sharply non-Gaussian: 73% of seconds show no price change. Cutting cadence from twelve seconds to one sheds 84.5% of the expected shock, so a twelve-second maker must screen at least 84.5% of informed flow to match a one-second venue, far above the 71.1% that a Gaussian model implies. In trending markets, the stale pool is picked off at execution: with-trend fills obtain an effective spread 11.1 bps lower than against-trend fills, with the same sign in all four pools.
summary: 该论文研究流动性提供者面对可利用过期报价的对手方时，需要多少点差才能盈亏平衡，并将两种防御措施（更快重新报价与筛选知情流）置于同一尺度。盈亏平衡条件给出了使较慢做市商匹配较快无筛选场所所需的精确筛选率：即买回额外过时性所需的选择性。结果仅要求可积价格创新，因此适用于跳跃、原子和无限方差。可预测漂移是一个中心化问题：它扩大以即期为中心的报价，但一旦报价重新以预期参考为中心，其成本消失。在2026年6月至8月四个USDC-WETH池对标币安ETH-USDT的基准中，一秒基准创新显著非高斯：73%的秒内无价格变化。将节奏从十二秒降至一秒可减少84.5%的预期冲击，因此十二秒做市商必须筛选至少84.5%的知情流才能匹配一秒场所，远高于高斯模型所暗示的71.1%。在趋势市场中，过时池在执行时被收割：顺趋势成交的有效点差比逆趋势低11.1个基点。该研究对实战交易有价值，因为它提供了做市商在延迟与筛选之间的定量权衡，并强调了非高斯秒级价格动态及趋势市场中的逆向选择成本。

title: When Does "Post-Call" Begin? An Availability Contract for Earnings-Call NLP Benchmarks
abstract: Corporate financial disclosures often unfold over time, with announcements, prepared remarks, and discussion spanning multiple high-frequency return intervals. Financial NLP benchmarks can therefore suffer from a within-event timing mismatch when the prediction target begins before the textual or audio input used by a model could be complete. Chronological train--test splits do not prevent this mismatch, because it occurs inside individual events rather than across samples. We introduce an Availability Contract, which requires a benchmark to state the input boundary, evidence for input availability, the outcome start, and the claims supported by that evidence. We apply this framework to 552 earnings calls from 24 firms. For each call, we hold the return endpoint fixed and compare the previous close, a documentary call-start proxy, and a completion proxy based on reconstructed audio end plus a stipulated processing allowance. At this baseline, moving from the call-start proxy to the completion proxy flips return signs for 9.4% of calls. Holding completion-clock cutpoints fixed, 28.3% change quintile. In an independent release-session analysis of a public earnings-call volatility benchmark, shifting before-market target windows forward by one trading session raises three-day mean squared error by 18.1-21.4% across four frozen prediction streams, while their point rankings remain unchanged. Together, the results show that labels and losses can depend materially on the declared outcome clock even when model rankings appear stable. The Availability Contract makes this assumption explicit and ties post-input claims to the available timing evidence.
summary: 本文提出“可用性契约”框架，评估财报电话会议NLP基准中的事件内时序错配问题。基于24家公司552次电话会议，将预测目标收益起点从会议开始代理改为完成代理（重建音频结束加处理余量）后，9.4%的会议收益符号翻转；固定完成时钟切点，28.3%的会议五分位变化。该研究揭示时序错配可严重扭曲财务NLP基准结果，对量化交易中因子构建与事件驱动策略的信号时序对齐有方法论警示，但未直接提出可交易的Alpha模型或强化学习策略。

title: V-SHARE: Provable Convergence Guarantees for Advantage-based Algorithms
abstract: In reinforcement learning, advantage-based value-learning methods, unlike standard Q-learning, share information across actions by decomposing the action-value function into a state-dependent value component and action-specific advantages. While this mechanism has proven effective in both tabular and deep reinforcement learning, its theoretical understanding remains incomplete. We introduce V-SHARE, an advantage-based value-learning algorithm that combines cross-action value sharing with an importance-weighted Bellman-residual correction. To our knowledge, we provide the first complete theoretical characterization of an advantage-based algorithm, including both asymptotic convergence and non-asymptotic finite-sample guarantees. We identify a regime in which V-SHARE mitigates the rare-action bottleneck of asynchronous Q-learning and uncover a contraction--variance tradeoff between stronger deterministic contraction and increased importance-weighting noise. Motivated by this tradeoff, we develop decreasing residual-preconditioning schedules that combine faster early contraction with lower asymptotic noise. We further develop a two-timescale analysis that removes the single-timescale residual-weight threshold while preserving convergence guarantees. Experiments on discrete Markov decision processes (MDPs) and deep reinforcement-learning benchmarks corroborate our results.
summary: 该论文提出V-SHARE，一种基于优势的价值学习算法，通过跨动作价值共享与重要性加权贝尔曼残差修正相结合。作者首次给出了优势类算法的完整理论刻画，包括渐近收敛和非渐近有限样本保证，识别了V-SHARE缓解异步Q-learning稀有动作瓶颈的机制，并揭示了更强确定性收缩与重要性加权噪声增加之间的收缩-方差权衡。基于此权衡，开发了递减残差预条件调度以兼顾早期快速收缩与低渐近噪声，并进行了双时间尺度分析。整体偏重理论收敛性证明，对实战交易策略的直接指导有限，但若应用于金融RL中的动作空间优化、稀有事件处理及Q学习改进，具有一定间接参考价值。

title: Pricing American Commodity Options Under the Schwartz Two-Factor Model Using the Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) Method
abstract: This project investigates the valuation of American commodity options using the Schwartz two-factor model. We employ the double-sweep Alternating Direction Explicit (ADE) method, an unconditionally stable (for diffusion) finite difference scheme that provides the efficiency of explicit marching with the stability typically reserved for implicit methods, and compare it with the single-sweep alternating variant of Saul'yev. We derive the governing partial differential equation (PDE) and transform the semi-infinite domain into a rectangular computational domain. Furthermore, we apply Fichera theory to determine boundary conditions at the limits of the spot price. Finally, we implement the solver in C++, validating the results first against the closed-form solution of the PDE and Monte Carlo as a European option, then apply the American early exercise constraint and benchmark against Longstaff-Schwartz Monte Carlo to analyze numerical accuracy and convergence. The framework is then extended, following feedback from a commodities trader to exercise on futures prices and use seasonal parameters.
summary: 本文研究在Schwartz双因子模型下为美式商品期权定价，采用双扫描交替方向显式（ADE）有限差分法，并与Saul'yev单扫描交替变体进行比较。推导了控制偏微分方程，将半无限域变换为矩形计算域，应用Fichera理论确定现货价格边界条件。在C++中实现求解器，先以欧式期权对比解析解和蒙特卡洛，再施加美式提前行权约束并与Longstaff-Schwartz蒙特卡洛基准对比分析精度与收敛性。该框架随后根据商品交易员反馈扩展为以期价行权并使用季节性参数。文章属于纯数值定价方法研究，未涉及强化学习、深度学习或alpha策略，对实战交易直接价值有限。

title: Research on quantitative investment strategies based on deep learning
abstract: … with four trading strategies (Long Call, Short Call, Long Put, Short Put) where deep learning … mirror the impact of its accuracy on quantitative trading strategies in a straightforward way. …
summary: 该研究探讨基于深度学习的量化投资策略，涉及四种期权交易策略（买入看涨期权、卖出看涨期权、买入看跌期权、卖出看跌期权），并分析深度学习预测准确性对量化交易策略的直接影响。

title: Momentum, Commentary Tone, and Earnings Surprise in LLM Financial Forecasts
abstract: Which inputs drive a language model's financial forecast? We construct synthetic earnings announcements that independently reverse 20-day momentum, non-informational commentary tone, and whether fixed actual EPS beats a manipulated consensus. Six instruction/chat checkpoint conversions from four families (0.49-7.61B base parameters) receive 2,016 prompts each under a direct-answer Q8_0 protocol. The design includes 24 numerical blocks, six commentary pairs, profits and losses, rising and falling annual EPS, and two surprise sizes. Both A/B answer assignments and U/D cover all 384 primary scenarios per conversion. We estimate matched changes in conditional answer-prefix scores, not calibrated market probabilities. Across these checkpoints, the primary EPS contrast ranges from -0.19 to 86.80 percentage points. The magnitude of the primary signed tone contrast exceeds that of EPS in 5 of six models, and momentum exceeds it in 5. Natural-word numerical diagnostic accuracy ranges from 51.0 to 95.8 percent. Answer-encoding, wording, context, and conversion controls qualify these results. The experiment measures observable input reliance and numerical recognition; it establishes neither an internal reasoning mechanism nor realized return predictability. Public benchmark prompts, recorded scores, and an interactive recorded-results explorer accompany the study.
summary: 论文研究哪些输入驱动语言模型财务预测：用合成财报同时反转20日动量、非信息性评论文本语调、以及实际EPS是否超操纵后的共识预期。六个指令/对话检查点（来自四个模型家族，基参0.49-7.61B）在直接回答Q8_0协议下各接受2,016条提示。设计含24个数值块、6组评论对、盈亏、年度EPS升降和两种超预期幅度。A/B答案分配和上/下覆盖每个转换的全部384个主场景。估计的是条件答案前缀分数的配对变化，而非校准后的市场概率。EPS主对比在-0.19到86.80个百分点之间。六个模型中5个的语调对比幅度超过EPS，动量在5个中超过EPS。自然词数值诊断准确率51.0%-95.8%。结果受答案编码、措辞、上下文和转换控制约束，仅测量可观察的输入依赖与数值识别，未建立市场可交易性。对实战交易仅有间接参考价值，属LLM行为分析而非可直接实施的Alpha或强化学习策略。

title: NEST: Stale-Robust Tokenized-Stock Measurement for a Crypto-Treasury LETF Stack
abstract: Tokenized equities trade while listed markets are closed, so their marks could improve off-hours measurement along layered exposures that link Bitcoin, crypto-treasury stocks, and leveraged ETFs. A token return and the next opening gap, however, share the price move from the previous close to the token mark, so part of their apparent fit is mechanical. We develop NEST, a stale-robust protocol that separates this shared-history fit from conditional measurement value. A shared-history identity and a variance-clock bound show how much fit timing alone can generate. The partial determination index (PDI), the squared partial correlation between token and gap given public controls, measures what remains, and a finite-sample frontier expresses the partial-F decision in PDI units. Product, provenance, timestamp, and execution audits decide whether an informative mark is admissible. For MSTRx, a tracker certificate on MicroStrategy (MSTR), a token-only $R^2$ of 0.916 shrinks to a modest increment once Bitcoin, mark age, and a pre-09:00 MSTR premarket proxy are controlled: the token explains 15.7% of the remaining gap variation (1% frontier 0.031), and 14.0% to 17.0% under stricter clock variants, including one in which every token mark precedes 09:00. A trade-level reconstruction on Gate gives 25.2%; NVDAX and AAPLX clear their frontiers, whereas TSLAX does not. An admitted mark updates, rather than replaces, BTC-unit exposure diagnostics for the BTC-MSTR-LETF chain.
summary: 该论文提出NEST协议，用于在传统市场休市期间利用代币化股票（如MSTRx）的标记改善加密货币-国债股票-杠杆ETF堆栈的测度。核心发现：代币与开盘缺口间的表观拟合（代币单独R²=0.916）很大部分来自共享历史（机械性），控制比特币、标记年龄和盘前代理后，代币仅解释剩余缺口变异的15.7%（1%前沿阈值0.031），在更严格时钟变量下为14.0%-17.0%。论文强调产品、来源、时间戳和执行审计决定信息性标记是否可用，属于计量方法论改进而非直接交易信号生成，对实战有间接参考价值但无直接Alpha。

title: Long-Horizon Investment with Delayed Information in a Mean-Reverting Market
abstract: We study long-term investment in an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion model with exponential utility. We solve the finite-horizon problem explicitly and show that information delay qualitatively alters long-horizon behavior. Under full information, the certainty equivalent generated by mean reversion grows quadratically with the investment horizon. With any fixed positive delay, it grows only linearly, at an asymptotic rate that we compute explicitly. We derive an explicit causal representation of the optimal delayed portfolio and show that projecting the full-information strategy onto delayed information can fail dramatically: the resulting exponential loss becomes infinite for sufficiently long horizons. Numerical examples illustrate the economic impact of information delay.
summary: 本文在Ornstein-Uhlenbeck均值回归扩散模型下，研究带指数效用的长期投资问题，并求解有限期限的显式解。核心发现是：信息延迟会定性改变长期行为——完全信息下，均值回归带来的确定性等价随投资期限二次增长；而任何固定正延迟下，仅线性增长，且可显式计算渐近速率。论文还给出最优延迟组合的显式因果表示，并表明将完全信息策略投影到延迟信息上可能严重失败：期限足够长时指数损失趋于无穷。数值例子展示了信息延迟的经济影响。该文为纯理论/数学金融研究，对实战交易（如强化学习、深度学习、Alpha策略）的直接指导有限，但为理解信息延迟下的长期组合配置提供了理论基准。

title: The end-of-month option in futures contracts and the Gittins index of holding the underlying
abstract: The end-of-month option allows the short in a futures contract to choose when to deliver during a window in which the delivery price is fixed. We characterize optimal delivery through a universal index obtained from the Bank--El Karoui representation theorem. In the semimartingale setting, this is the Gittins index of holding the underlying and collecting its convenience yield, and the futures price is the retirement reward for which the value of this project equals the spot price. This characterization yields price bounds and a criterion for immediate delivery. Dinkelbach's iteration reduces the price computation to a sequence of standard optimal stopping problems, with an explicit contraction bound. We apply the theory to geometric Brownian motion and the Gibson--Schwartz model with stochastic convenience yield. For geometric Brownian motion, we characterize when the futures price equals spot and derive a square-root boundary asymptotic near expiry. For the Gibson--Schwartz model, we establish monotonicity in the yield and characterize the critical yield below which the price equals spot. Numerical results illustrate the price iteration and delivery regions.
summary: 本文研究期货合约的月末期权：期货空头可在交割价格固定的窗口内选择交割时间。作者利用Bank-El Karoui表示定理，将最优交割刻画为一个通用指数；在半鞅框架下，该指数是持有标的并获取便利收益的Gittins指数，期货价格则是对应的退休奖励，使得项目价值等于现货价格。该刻画给出了价格界和立即交割的判定准则。Dinkelbach迭代将价格计算化为一系列标准最优停时问题，并具有显式收缩界。作者将理论应用于几何布朗运动和具有随机便利收益的Gibson-Schwartz模型：对前者刻画了期货价格等于现货的条件，并推导了到期附近的平方根边界渐近；对后者建立了对便利收益的单调性，并刻画了使价格等于现货的临界便利收益。数值结果展示了价格迭代和交割区域。

title: Loss-versus-rebalancing with external proportional transaction costs
abstract: We study liquidity provision in automated market makers when trading in the external market incurs proportional transaction costs. We consider both separately collected fees and fees retained in reserves. The benchmark is a self-financing strategy holding the same total risky inventory and trading at the external bid and ask. Under continuous external prices and pure arbitrage, the pool and benchmark have identical liquidation wealth whenever the pool fee or the external spread is positive. Thus loss-versus-rebalancing relative to this transaction-cost benchmark is zero, even without a pool fee if the external spread is positive. We then construct retained-fee utility-indifference pools that implement admissible decreasing inventory schedules, and geometric mean pools that implement feasible constant no-trade boundaries for portfolio weights. These results offer an investment interpretation of liquidity provision: by choosing the pool design, a liquidity provider can specify a trading strategy whose rebalancing is carried out by arbitrageurs.
summary: 本文研究自动做市商（AMM）在外部市场存在比例交易成本时的流动性提供问题，考虑单独收取费用和费用留存于储备两种模式。以自融资策略为基准（持有相同总风险库存，按外部买卖价交易）。在外部价格连续且纯套利条件下，若池费用或外部价差为正，池与基准的清算财富相同，因此相对于该交易成本基准的损失与再平衡（LVR）为零，即使无池费用但外部价差为正亦然。随后构建留存费用效用无差异池以实现可允许的递减库存路径，以及几何平均池以实现组合权重下可行的恒定无交易边界。结果给出流动性提供的投资解释：通过选择池设计，流动性提供者可指定一种由套利者执行再平衡的交易策略。

title: Entropy Regularization under No-Shorting: Structure Preservation and Convexity in Dynamic Mean-Variance Portfolio Selection
abstract: This paper studies entropy regularization for the discrete-time dynamic mean--variance portfolio problem with no-shorting constraints. In the unconstrained setting, entropy regularization can be introduced without changing the basic quadratic structure of the dynamic program. Under no-shorting, this property is lost: a standard fixed-temperature formulation generally preserves convexity but no longer preserves the homogeneous Bellman structure and the associated piecewise-linear feedback form. We introduce a state-dependent temperature that is matched to the homogeneity of the original mean--variance problem. This restores the piecewise-quadratic value function and the finite-dimensional Bellman recursion. The resulting formulation, however, makes convexity depend on the continuation coefficients generated by the soft recursion. We show that negative continuation coefficients lead to loss of convexity and prove that a common sufficiently small temperature preserves the Bellman structure and convexity over the entire finite horizon. The original no-shorting solution is recovered as the temperature vanishes. We also develop a sample-based implementation for unknown return distributions. Numerical and empirical results illustrate both the structural advantage of the state-dependent temperature and the practical relevance of the convexity-preserving temperature restriction.
summary: 本文研究带禁止卖空约束的离散时间动态均值-方差组合选择问题中的熵正则化。在无约束情形下，熵正则化不改变动态规划的基本二次结构；但在禁止卖空约束下，标准固定温度形式虽通常保持凸性，却不再保持齐次Bellman结构及相关的分段线性反馈形式。作者引入与原始均值-方差问题齐次性匹配的状态依赖温度，恢复了分段二次值函数和有限维Bellman递推。然而该形式使凸性依赖于软递推产生的延续系数，作者证明负延续系数会导致凸性丧失，并证明一个共同的充分小温度可在整个有限时域内保持Bellman结构和凸性。当温度趋于零时，原始禁止卖空解被恢复。文中还开发了收益分布未知时的样本实现方法。

title: AlphaRLM: Aligning Language Models for Literature-Grounded Symbolic Factor Discovery
abstract: Formulaic alpha mining seeks to discover executable expressions that capture predictive market signals in a vast, noisy search space. Recent LLM-based approaches use prompting, iterative search, or seed-factor evolution, leaving direct factor construction through policy learning less explored. To address this, we introduce AlphaRLM, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains LLMs to construct executable symbolic factors from financial literature without input factor expressions. AlphaRLM incorporates Literature-Guided Operator Assembly (LEGO), which conditions factor construction on literature-derived ideas and executable operators, providing semantic priors for exploration. It further aligns the generation policy with market feedback through executable-validity and grouped-return-separation rewards that capture non-monotonic structures across factor quantiles. Extensive experiments on CSI 300, CSI 1000, and S&P 500 show that AlphaRLM outperforms strong factor-mining and LLM-based baselines in annualized excess return. Notably, the 8B model achieves strong cross-market performance, highlighting the promise of literature-conditioned, market-aligned factor generation.
summary: AlphaRLM：通过对齐语言模型实现基于文献的符号因子发现。公式化阿尔法挖掘旨在从庞大且嘈杂的搜索空间中挖掘出能捕捉预测性市场信号的可执行表达式。近期基于大语言模型的方法采用提示、迭代搜索或种子因子进化，而通过策略学习直接构建因子则探索较少。为此，我们提出AlphaRLM，一个强化学习框架，训练大语言模型从金融文献中构建可执行符号因子，无需输入因子表达式。AlphaRLM包含文献引导算子组装（LEGO），以文献衍生思想和可执行算子为条件进行因子构建，为探索提供语义先验。它进一步通过可执行有效性和分组收益分离奖励，将生成策略与市场反馈对齐，捕捉因子分位数间的非单调结构。在沪深300、中证1000和标普500上的大量实验表明，AlphaRLM在年化超额收益上优于强因子挖掘和基于大语言模型的基线。值得注意的是，8B模型展现出强大的跨市场性能，凸显了基于文献条件、市场对齐的因子生成前景。

title: Data-Driven Dynamic Portfolio Selection with Vine Copula Simulation and Reinforcement Learning
abstract: We develop a data-driven approach to dynamic portfolio selection that combines vine-copula simulation with reinforcement learning. The investor has constant relative risk aversion and maximises expected terminal utility with a running penalty on the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of one-period losses. We estimate a conditional vine model from historical returns and use it to generate joint scenarios for CVaR evaluation and conditional paths for training a recurrent portfolio policy. Under uniform local derivative bounds, we propagate edgewise pair-copula parameter errors through the conditional transforms to obtain power-law stability bounds in Hellinger distance and total variation. In a finite-horizon investment model, we combine these estimates with a marginal and structural approximation budget to bound policy values, optimal values and the true-market loss of policies selected under a fitted model, with separate simulation and numerical optimisation terms. On a seven-asset panel comprising US and Chinese equities and gold, the selected ensemble of ten trained policies achieves a compound annual growth rate of 34.13% and a Sharpe ratio of 2.31 over 22 complete monthly holding periods, exceeding the corresponding values of six classical and vine-based benchmarks. Combining simulated and historical training data reduces monthly target-to-target turnover by 41.5% relative to training on historical data alone, while maintaining comparable growth.
summary: 本文提出一种数据驱动的动态投资组合选择方法，将藤Copula模拟与强化学习相结合。投资者具有恒定相对风险厌恶，并在单期损失的CVaR运行惩罚下最大化期望终端效用。从历史收益估计条件藤模型，生成联合情景用于CVaR评估，并生成条件路径用于训练循环投资组合策略。在一致局部导数界下，将边对Copula参数误差通过条件变换传播，得到Hellinger距离和全变差中的幂律稳定性界。在有限期投资模型中，结合边际和结构近似预算，约束策略价值、最优值以及拟合模型下所选策略的真实市场损失，并分离模拟和数值优化项。在一个包含美国和中国股票及黄金的七资产面板上，选出的十个训练策略的集成在22个完整月度持有期内实现34.13%的复合年增长率和2.31的夏普比率。

title: From Economic Explanation to Performance Improvement in Machine-Learning Portfolios
abstract: To extend conventional model-level feature importance to economically meaningful portfolio outcomes and decisions, we propose a local first-order attribution-propagation framework that maps allocation-function feature exposures to local sensitivities of sequential portfolio performance metrics. We relate the propagated attributions to Shapley values defined directly for portfolio objectives and derive statistical inference for Sharpe-ratio attributions. The resulting attribution-guided feature-exposure intervention enables post-training adaptation, translating portfolio-metric explanations into out-of-sample decisions without retraining the underlying allocation model. We further introduce temporal stabilisation and cross-model averaging as complementary regularisation mechanisms. Empirically, the interventions yield statistically significant improvements in net Sharpe ratios across different model classes.
summary: 该论文提出了一种局部一阶归因传播框架，将配置函数的特征暴露映射到序列投资组合绩效指标的局部敏感度，从而把传统模型级特征重要性扩展到有经济意义的组合结果和决策。作者将传播的归因与直接针对组合目标定义的Shapley值关联，并推导了夏普比率归因的统计推断。基于归因引导的特征暴露干预支持训练后自适应，无需重新训练底层配置模型即可将组合指标解释转化为样本外决策。论文还引入时间稳定化和跨模型平均作为补充正则化机制。实证表明，这些干预在不同模型类别上均能带来净夏普比率的统计显著提升。

title: CorrFlow: Exact and Permutation-Equivariant Flow Matching on the Correlation Elliptope
abstract: Correlation matrices combine nonlinear positive-definiteness constraints with a simultaneous row-column permutation symmetry. Their generation therefore involves two distinct problems. First, every output must remain on the correlation elliptope, irrespective of how its variables are ordered. Second, the generator must learn the domain-specific distribution occupied by empirical data inside that valid space. Existing financial image generators mix these problems: they learn ordered matrix entries and repair invalid draws afterward. We introduce CorrFlow, which separates them. A generalized Fisher transform maps full-rank correlation matrices bijectively to unconstrained coordinates, guaranteeing valid outputs without projection. A graph flow-matching network learns the empirical distribution in those coordinates and is permutation equivariant: reordering the variables only reorders the output. We compare a conditional CorrGAN reimplementation, image diffusion, and CorrFlow on $80\times80$ Taiwan equity matrices using five seeds per neural method. CorrFlow produces 100% valid draws without repair and obtains feature sliced-Wasserstein distance $.712\pm.141$, versus $4.339\pm.252$ for CorrGAN and $4.610\pm.191$ for image diffusion after their invalid outputs are projected back to the correlation space. It also improves this distance over historical lookup, while lookup retains higher local coverage. These results support the combined construction under the evaluated training budget; they do not establish superiority over fully tuned image models or isolate the contribution of each component.
summary: CorrFlow 是一种用于生成相关矩阵的排列等变流匹配方法。它通过广义 Fisher 变换将满秩相关矩阵双射映射到无约束坐标，保证输出始终位于相关椭圆体上；再用图流匹配网络学习经验分布，并保持排列等变性（变量重排仅导致输出重排）。在 80×80 台湾股票矩阵上，与条件 CorrGAN 复现、图像扩散相比，CorrFlow 无需修复即产生 100% 有效样本，特征切片 Wasserstein 距离为 0.712±0.141，显著优于对比方法的 4.339±0.252。该方法对金融相关矩阵生成、投资组合优化和风险建模等量化交易实战具有较高价值。

title: Exact Phase-Type Point Processes for Certified Measurement and Prediction of Event Streams
abstract: Temporal point processes are used both to measure market mechanisms, for example how fast prices absorb news and how much of the reaction is the market responding to itself, and to predict the next event. We show that one algebraic object, the phase-type (Erlang-chain) state space, serves both purposes with exact likelihoods. For measurement, we build a multiscale phase-type Hawkes process whose parameters all enter linearly. Its log-likelihood is concave, and we compute the global maximum together with a Fenchel duality-gap certificate. A Markov embedding gives the response to an exogenous shock, echoes included, in closed form, and this response is stable if and only if the spectral radius of the branching matrix is below one. Applied to six markets around 670 scheduled macroeconomic releases (2022-2026) with a built-in placebo test, the model shows that the direct reaction to CPI, payrolls, PPI and the FOMC statement is absorbed in about a second, while the market's own echoes stretch half of the response to 16-137 s. For prediction, we introduce EPT-X, a neural point process that adds a history-dependent mixture-of-Erlang renewal channel to a linear Hawkes backbone. Its intensity and compensator remain in closed form, its states follow an affine recursion that trains with a parallel scan, and it can start from the certified fit of the measurement model. EPT-X has the best test likelihood on all five LOBSTER order-book streams and on Retweet and Taobao, and is level with the best published model on StackOverflow. We also find that the EasyTPP implementation of IntensityFree clamps short inter-event times before scoring, and that the gaps of the EasyTPP Amazon data are uniform on two fixed intervals.
summary: 该论文提出使用相位型（Erlang链）状态空间统一建模与预测事件流。测量方面，构建多尺度相位型Hawkes过程，参数线性、对数似然凹，可计算全局最优及Fenchel对偶间隙证书；通过马尔可夫嵌入给出外生冲击的闭式响应，稳定性取决于分支矩阵谱半径小于1。应用于六个市场、约670次预定宏观发布（2022-2026）并含安慰剂检验，发现CPI、非农、PPI和FOMC声明的直接反应约1秒被吸收，市场自身回声将反应拖长至16-137秒。预测方面，提出EPT-X神经点过程，在线性Hawkes主干上加入历史依赖的Erlang更新混合通道，用于预测下一事件。论文兼具市场微观结构测量与事件流预测价值，但预测部分仅为摘要片段，未见完整回测或RL/Alpha实战验证，故给6分。

title: $L_0$ Feature Selection via Monte Carlo Tree Search in High-Dimensional Financial Regression
abstract: Feature selection is a central problem in high-dimensional financial regression, where large numbers of engineered variables and strong correlations among predictors reduce model stability and interpretability. $L_1$ regularization (Lasso) is widely used for sparse regression, but its shrinkage can be restrictive when informative signals are spread across correlated variables. Exact sparse regression avoids this shrinkage but requires solving a combinatorial optimization problem that is computationally difficult and is typically fit to minimize in-sample rather than out-of-sample error. This paper presents a feature selection framework based on Monte Carlo Tree Search with Generalized Nested Rollout Policy Adaptation (GNRPA). Feature selection is formulated as a sequential decision process, and candidate subsets are scored by their out-of-sample validation performance rather than training error. The method also supports a lexicographic objective accounting for subset size and multicollinearity. We study this approach on a contemporaneous explanatory regression task: explaining the weekly return of the NASDAQ-100 index from 1,072 engineered features spanning market, macroeconomic, and factor data. This isolates the value of subset selection under multicollinearity from the separate problem of predictive forecasting. On this task, the proposed method identifies sparse feature subsets with higher out-of-sample explanatory power than an optimized Lasso baseline, reaching an out-of-sample $R^2$ of 0.6961 versus 0.6313 for Lasso. These results suggest that Monte Carlo Tree Search is a practical alternative to convex regularization for sparse explanatory feature selection in financial regression, with potential value for factor attribution and risk decomposition where transparency matters as much as out-of-sample fit.
summary: 本文提出基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与广义嵌套 rollout 策略自适应（GNRPA）的特征选择框架，用于高维金融回归。将特征选择建模为序列决策过程，以样本外验证表现而非训练误差评估候选子集，并支持同时考虑子集大小与多重共线性的字典序目标。在同期解释性回归任务上研究：用 1,072 个工程化特征（涵盖市场、宏观经济等）解释 NASDAQ-100 指数周收益。评估：该方法针对金融特征选择痛点，有实战参考价值但非直接生成 alpha，属于方法论改进，评分 6。

title: Realized Tail-Risk Conditional Autoregressive Expectile Models: Accurate and Stable Forecasting Performance
abstract: A realized tail-risk conditional autoregressive expectile (RTCARE) model is proposed for joint forecasting of value-at-risk (VaR) and expected shortfall (ES). Realized tail measures such as the realized quantile and the realized ES, constructed from intraday high-frequency returns, are incorporated into the dynamics and measurement equations of the conditional expectile, allowing information about lower-tail risk to enter the forecasts. The parameters are estimated by Markov chain Monte Carlo, and we evaluate the resulting VaR-ES forecasts in numerical examples and in an empirical application using U.S. stock-return data. Across the considered tail levels, the RTCARE models deliver competitive and often superior forecasting performance relative to existing alternatives, with stable results across Monte Carlo replications and rolling forecast evaluations.
summary: 提出已实现尾部风险条件自回归期望（RTCARE）模型，联合预测VaR与ES。用日内高频收益构建的已实现分位数、已实现ES等已实现尾部测度，纳入条件期望的动态与测量方程，让下尾风险信息进入预测。参数通过MCMC估计，并用数值示例和美股收益数据实证评估VaR-ES预测。结果显示，在各尾部水平上，RTCARE相对既有方法具有竞争力且常更优，在蒙特卡洛重复与滚动预测中表现稳定。

title: Regime Detection in Latent Factor Models -- A Bayesian Decision-Theoretic Approach
abstract: Regime-switching multi-factor models are widely used in quantitative finance, but filtering does not by itself determine when an agent should act on inferred regime changes. We formulate online regime detection with latent factors and hidden regimes as a Bayesian decision problem balancing false alarms, detection delay, and misclassification. Since posterior regime probabilities are generally non-Markovian, the problem is represented as a measure-valued optimal stopping problem and approximated using particle filtering with Monte Carlo dynamic programming. A single-change-point Heston model provides a benchmark. With observed variance, the problem reduces to a two-dimensional Markov free-boundary problem, while under latent variance decisions are based on the filtered posterior measure. Numerical experiments in Heston and regime-switching Vasicek models show that the latent-information procedure can outperform feasible plug-in rules.
summary: 本文将潜在因子模型中的在线状态检测建模为贝叶斯决策问题，旨在平衡误报、检测延迟和误分类。由于后验状态概率通常非马尔可夫，问题被表述为测度值最优停止问题，并采用粒子滤波与蒙特卡洛动态规划进行近似。以单变点Heston模型为基准，在观测方差下简化为二维马尔可夫自由边界问题，潜在方差下则基于滤波后验测度决策。Heston和状态切换Vasicek模型的数值实验表明，潜在信息方法可优于可行的插件规则。

title: Beyond Time Induction: Structured Conditional Neural Solvers for Parametric Stochastic-Volatility Pricing
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks provide a flexible framework for learning parametric PDE solution families without labeled data, yet preserving accurate derivatives across heterogeneous regimes remains challenging. Structured neural solvers offer compact representations, but restrictive conditional parameterizations can limit adaptation across the solution family. We introduce BeTINN, a structured conditional architecture extending time-induced modulation through multi-directional time-parameter conditioning and a joint residual pathway. We evaluate BeTINN on the Heston stochastic-volatility PDE, a demanding parametric problem with mixed derivatives and economically relevant first- and second-order sensitivities. BeTINN improves joint accuracy across normalized option value and key sensitivity metrics relative to our baselines. Controlled ablations characterize the roles of its architectural components. We further find that validation physics loss is informative but does not fully determine differential fidelity, and that accurate solution values can coexist with localized derivative errors. These results support structured conditional adaptation and motivate derivative-aware evaluation when sensitivities are downstream quantities of interest.
summary: 物理信息神经网络可无标签学习参数化PDE解族，但跨异质区制保持精确导数仍困难；结构化神经求解器虽紧凑，却受条件参数化限制。本文提出BeTINN，一种结构化条件架构，通过多方向时间-参数条件化和联合残差通路扩展时间诱导调制。在Heston随机波动率PDE（含混合导数及经济相关一、二阶敏感度）上评估，BeTINN在归一化期权价值与关键敏感度指标的联合精度上优于基线。消融实验刻画了各架构组件作用。还发现验证物理损失有信息性但不完全决定微分保真度，准确解值可与局部导数误差共存，支持结构化条件适应并推动导数感知评估。

title: Three options are roughly enough - Variance-optimal semi-static hedging in the rough Heston model
abstract: This paper studies semi-static variance-optimal hedging of variance swaps in the rough Heston model under a risk-neutral measure. We combine dynamic trading in the underlying asset with static positions in a finite basket of European options, with the aim of minimizing the variance of the residual hedging error. Exploiting the Markovian lift provided by the forward variance curve, the Fourier representations of the claims and the Laplace transform characterization of the log-price, we derive semi-explicit formulas for the optimal strategies and the hedging error. We then study the optimal claim selection problem, investigating numerically how the choice of static instruments depends on the Hurst index. Under standard parametrization, we discover that "three options are roughly enough", i.e. adding three static vanilla options reduces the hedging error by more than 95% relative to the purely dynamic hedge for all considered roughness regimes H= 0.1, 0.3, 0.5.
summary: 本文在粗糙Heston模型下研究方差互换的半静态方差最优对冲。策略将标的资产的动态交易与有限篮子的欧式期权静态头寸相结合，以最小化残差对冲误差的方差。利用前向方差曲线提供的马尔可夫提升、索赔的傅里叶表示及对数价格的拉普拉斯变换刻画，推导出最优策略和对冲误差的半显式公式。进一步通过数值研究最优索赔选择问题，探讨静态工具选择如何依赖于Hurst指数。在标准参数化下发现“三个期权大致足够”，即对于所有考虑的粗糙度H=0.1,0.3,0.5，加入三个静态香草期权相对于纯动态对冲可将对冲误差降低95%以上。

title: Common Signals, Spurious Cross-Excitation, and Identification in Multivariate Hawkes Processes
abstract: Multivariate Hawkes models are widely used to measure endogenous interactions in event data, but latent common signals can generate apparent excitation even without structural interaction. We characterize the resulting linear projection and construct stable, nonnegative Hawkes processes that share the mean intensity and Bartlett spectrum of common-signal models despite having different excitation mechanisms. This establishes a concrete form of second-order non-identification. We derive integrated third-order cumulants for Hawkes processes with Cox immigration and establish generic local identification of normalized structural parameters in two- and three-dimensional systems. An exact-equivalence Monte Carlo experiment demonstrates how third-order information can distinguish mechanisms with identical second-order structure, while revealing substantial finite-sample limitations under weak signals. For a restricted parametric family, we develop Whittle estimation from binned counts, establish consistency and asymptotic normality under appropriate identification conditions, and construct feasible sandwich standard errors accounting for estimated mean intensities. Simulations assess structural recovery and inference accuracy. An application to cryptocurrency transactions illustrates the sensitivity of inferred excitation to model specification and the limitations of structural interpretation based on spectral fit alone.
summary: 多元Hawkes模型广泛用于衡量事件数据中的内生交互，但潜在共同信号即使没有结构性交互也能产生表观激发。本文刻画了由此产生的线性投影，并构造了稳定的非负Hawkes过程，这些过程与共同信号模型具有相同的均值强度和Bartlett谱，但激发机制不同，从而确立了二阶不可识别性的具体形式。作者推导了带Cox移民的Hawkes过程的积分三阶累积量，并在二维和三维系统中建立了归一化结构参数的通用局部识别。精确等价蒙特卡洛实验表明，三阶信息可以区分具有相同二阶结构的机制，同时揭示了弱信号下显著的有限样本局限。对于受限参数族，作者发展了基于分箱计数的Whittle估计，在适当识别条件下建立了一致性和渐近正态性，并构造了考虑估计均值强度的可行三明治标准误。模拟评估了str（摘要在此处截断）。

title: Ex Ante and Scenario-Conditional Value of Information in Dynamic Portfolio Choice
abstract: Portfolio decisions are often made under uncertainty about expected returns, and investors revise their beliefs as new information arrives. Although richer information generally cannot reduce optimized value ex ante, the trading strategy it induces need not improve on the strategy induced by a less informative information structure in every fixed-drift scenario. We introduce scenario-conditional expected utility and value of information to evaluate strategies selected under the investor's current belief. In a finite-horizon Gaussian portfolio choice model, we compare a fixed-belief investor, a price observer, and an attentive investor who also processes an auxiliary signal under an attention capacity constraint. Ex ante, price learning and auxiliary attention are valuable, and the total value of attention increases with capacity. Scenario-conditionally, learning creates a correction benefit by reducing the initial trading-position gap relative to the full-information strategy, but also a fluctuation cost through belief revisions, so the ex ante ranking can reverse. We derive the current-belief distribution of scenario-conditional value and the associated underperformance probability, defined as the probability of negative scenario-conditional value relative to fixed-belief choice. Over sufficiently short horizons, the scenario-conditional value of learning is negative when belief error is small relative to posterior uncertainty. For a given horizon, sufficiently high attention capacity yields a higher scenario-conditional value than any fixed finite-capacity benchmark across all drift scenarios. We also derive sharp convergence rates to full-information performance under Shannon and Tsallis technologies.
summary: 组合决策常在预期收益不确定下做出，投资者随新信息更新信念。尽管事前信息更丰富不能降低优化价值，但其诱导的交易策略未必在每个固定漂移情景下优于信息较少结构诱导的策略。我们引入情景条件期望效用和信息价值，以评估投资者当前信念下选择的策略。在有限期高斯组合选择模型中，比较固定信念投资者、价格观察者以及受注意力容量约束下还处理辅助信号的专注投资者。事前，价格学习和辅助关注有价值，注意力总价值随容量增加。情景条件下，学习通过缩小与完全信息策略的初始交易头寸差距产生修正收益，但也通过信念修正产生波动成本，因此事前排序可能反转。我们推导出情景条件价值的当前信念分布及相关的表现不佳概率。

title: Tail Instability and Scale Control in Conditional Normalizing Flows for Treasury Yield-Curve Scenarios
abstract: A conditional normalizing flow can produce extreme scenarios even when its point forecasts appear reasonable. We compare two fitted models for daily Treasury yield changes at eleven maturities reconstructed from Federal Reserve curve parameters. Both use an LSTM, an auxiliary location head, and an affine residual flow. On a previously unused 60-date window, the frozen Student-t model generated an absolute standardized coordinate of 34.3 million. A Gaussian-base model with tighter coupling scale control reached 14.72. Each generated 600,000 vectors. The original model's scenario-mean MSE was 33,908.95, while its location-head MSE was 0.3376. The stabilized model's two estimates remained close. Across five development windows, the stabilized maximum was 17.33 among three million vectors. Stability did not imply better prediction: historical simulation had better distributional scores and coverage closer to nominal on the new window. The original flow also had a better log score despite its extreme samples. Frozen-model evaluation is reproducible, but the comparison does not isolate architectural effects or establish a general forecasting advantage.
summary: 条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flow）即使点预测合理，也可能生成极端情景。本文比较两个针对由美联储曲线参数重构的11个期限国债收益率日度变化的拟合模型：均使用LSTM、辅助location head和仿射残差流。在一个此前未使用的60日期窗口上，冻结的Student-t模型产生绝对标准化坐标达34.3百万；采用更紧耦合尺度控制的高斯基模型为14.72。各生成600,000个向量。原模型的情景均值MSE为33,908.95，而location head MSE为0.3376；稳定模型的两个估计接近。在五个开发窗口上，300万向量中稳定模型最大值为17.33。稳定性并不意味更好的预测：历史模拟在新窗口上具有更好的分布评分和更接近名义的覆盖率。尽管有极端样本，原流的对数评分反而更好。冻结模型评估可复现，但该比较未隔离架构效应，也未确立通用预测优势。

title: Early Detection of Pension-Sponsor Distress from Public Filings: A Sponsor Vulnerability Index, Stress-Augmented VaR, and Dynamic Self-Investment Caps
abstract: A defined-benefit pension is only as safe as its sponsor, yet sponsor distress is under-instrumented relative to plan-side modelling. We present a transparent, reproducible early-warning pipeline built entirely on public data. A Sponsor Vulnerability Index (SVI), a gradient-boosted classifier over point-in-time SEC EDGAR balance-sheet fundamentals and two macro series, predicts a filings-based distress state one to two quarters ahead. On 36 U.S. sponsors in five sector groups (1,418 firm-quarters, 2015Q1-2025Q3) it reaches an out-of-fold AUC-ROC of 0.887 and PR-AUC of 0.711 (base rate 11.9%) under leave-one-firm-out cross-validation. A Monte Carlo VaR with a stylized transition-stress overlay shows that climate-type stress is negligible for a diversified plan but adds 20-43% to one-year 95% VaR when 22.5% of assets are held in sponsor securities. A dynamic self-investment cap maps the SVI to a limit that falls from 8% to below 1% in acute distress and recovers with the sponsor, which we illustrate on PG&E's 2019 bankruptcy and Boeing's persistent fragility. We report the method's failure modes alongside its results (book-equity labels that also fire on non-credit events such as spin-offs, positives concentrated in one firm, and stylized stress parameters) and release code, data and results under a concept DOI.
summary: 本文提出一个基于公开数据的养老金发起人困境早期预警流程，包括发起人脆弱性指数（SVI）、压力增强VaR和动态自我投资上限。SVI使用梯度提升分类器，基于SEC EDGAR资产负债表基本面和两个宏观序列，预测未来一至两个季度的困境状态。在36家美国发起人、5个行业组（1418个公司季度，2015Q1-2025Q3）上，留一公司交叉验证得到AUC-ROC 0.887，PR-AUC 0.711（基准率11.9%）。蒙特卡洛VaR与压力转移叠加显示，气候型压力对多元化计划可忽略，但当22.5%资产持有发起人证券时，一年期95% VaR增加20-43%。动态自我投资上限将SVI映射为从8%降至急性困境下低于1%并随发起人恢复的限额，并以PG&E 2019年破产和波音持续脆弱为例说明。论文同时报告了失败模式（如账面权益标签也会在非信用事件上触发）。该研究属于风险管理和养老金发起人信用风险领域，并非直接针对量化交易中的Alpha、强化学习或深度学习交易策略，因此对实战交易的直接价值有限，评分4分。

title: Enhancing credit risk scorecards with transactional-based behavioural features
abstract:
Background: Credit risk modelling is fundamental in financial institutions, typically using credit history, repayment behaviour, income, and outstanding debt to estimate a borrower's probability of default. Although transactional data are sometimes incorporated through aggregated measures such as recency, frequency, and monetary indicators, behavioural information embedded in raw transaction narratives remains largely unexplored due to its unstructured nature. This limits opportunities to extract richer behavioural insights.
  Aim: This research investigates payment narratives from transactional data as an alternative data source for credit risk modelling.
  Setting: The study uses transactional data from a large South African financial institution focused on small and medium enterprises.
  Method: Techniques such as natural language processing and regular expressions are used to transform unstructured transaction descriptions into meaningful, explainable behavioural features by categorising transactions into interpretable spending categories. A novel categorisation algorithm was developed and evaluated for classification accuracy. The extracted features are incorporated into a credit risk scorecard to assess their predictive value.
  Results: The categorisation algorithm demonstrates high classification accuracy. Using these features in the scorecard resulted in a significant increase in Gini compared to a scorecard without them.
  Conclusion: Text-based transactional information can be systematically extracted, categorised, and operationalised to enhance credit risk model performance.
  Contribution: The study develops a novel, integrated, explainable methodology for transforming transactional text into behavioural features, introduces a structured RegEx-based categorisation approach, and demonstrates their predictive value within traditional scorecard frameworks.
summary: 本研究探讨利用交易数据中的支付叙事（非结构化交易描述）作为信用风险建模的替代数据源。背景：信用风险建模通常使用信用历史、还款行为、收入和未偿债务来估计违约概率，交易数据有时通过最近一次、频率、金额等汇总指标纳入，但原始交易叙事中的行为信息因非结构化而未被充分挖掘。目的：研究支付叙事作为信用风险建模的替代数据源。场景：使用南非一家大型金融机构的中小企业交易数据。方法：采用自然语言处理和正则表达式，将非结构化交易描述转化为可解释的行为特征，通过将交易归类为可解释的支出类别，开发并评估了一种新的分类算法。提取的特征被纳入信用评分卡。该论文侧重于信用风险评分卡的特征工程与可解释性，而非交易策略、强化学习、深度学习或alpha信号，对实战交易（如预测市场、生成alpha）的直接价值有限，但行为特征提取方法在另类数据因子构建中或有间接参考意义。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Hawkes-Structured Networks for Market Making
abstract: Market making under realistic order-flow dynamics is challenging due to the clustered, self-exciting nature of order arrivals, which are naturally modeled by non-Markovian Hawkes processes. We propose a model-free reinforcement learning (RL) framework for market making with general Hawkes order-flow dynamics. We first establish non-asymptotic performance bounds that quantify the loss incurred by approximating the infinite-dimensional Hawkes state using a finite collection of exponentially weighted features. Guided by this analysis, we introduce the Hawkes-Structured Network (HSN), a novel neural architecture that encodes historical order flow through a learnable mixture-of-exponentials filter. HSN is trained end-to-end using model-free RL, jointly optimizing the feature representation and quoting policy directly from reward feedback. Experiments on single- and multi-asset market-making problems with mixture-of-exponentials, power-law, and regime-switching kernels demonstrate that HSN outperforms general-purpose neural architectures, achieving higher trading rewards while implicitly recovering the underlying order-flow intensities.
summary: 针对现实订单流中订单到达具有聚集性和自激特性的挑战，论文提出了一种无模型强化学习做市框架，其中订单流动态由非马尔可夫的Hawkes过程自然建模。研究者首先建立了非渐近性能界，量化了使用有限指数加权特征近似无限维Hawkes状态所带来的损失。基于该分析，提出了Hawkes结构网络（HSN）——一种新颖的神经网络架构，通过可学习的指数混合滤波器编码历史订单流。HSN采用无模型强化学习进行端到端训练，直接从奖励反馈中联合优化特征表示和报价策略。在指数混合、幂律和机制切换核的单资产与多资产做市实验中，HSN 性能优于通用神经网络架构，在获得更高交易奖励的同时，隐式地恢复了潜在的订单流强度。

title: The Buffett Effect
abstract: We study whether stock disclosures by recognizable investors generate abnormal market reactions beyond the reactions produced by comparable but non-recognizable managers. We define the Buffett effect as the incremental abnormal return to a disclosed new position that is attributable to the public recognition of the disclosing investor. We construct a recognition index from Wikipedia pageviews and ProQuest news mentions. Using data from 2000 to 2025 we compare market reaction to disclosures of 24 recognizable discretionary funds with disclosures of 24 matched control funds. New-position disclosures by recognizable managers generate a positive disclosure premium over the filing date and the following trading days, and the premium increases with investor recognition. We construct calendar-time portfolios that mechanically copy each group's disclosed purchases and find that copying the most recognized investors earns a significant alpha that persists for months and does not reverse. The evidence is most consistent with an entangled attention-information channel: investor recognition directs scarce investor attention toward selected disclosures, and the information revealed in those disclosures is then capitalized into prices.
summary: 该研究通过维基百科页面浏览量和ProQuest新闻提及构建投资者认知指数，比较24位知名基金经理与24位匹配的普通基金经理的新头寸披露的市场反应。发现知名经理的新头寸披露在披露日及后续交易日产生正向披露溢价，且溢价随投资者认知度增加而增加。构建的日历时间组合机械复制各组披露的购买，发现复制最知名投资者的组合能获得持续数月且不反转的显著阿尔法。证据与'注意力-信息'渠道一致：投资者认知引导稀缺的投资者注意力至所选披露，而披露中揭示的信息驱动了定价。对实战交易有一定参考价值，但依赖公开披露数据且存在滞后性。

title: XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.
summary: 深度强化学习在视觉自动驾驶中潜力巨大，但仿真训练策略部署到现实常严重退化。现有sim-to-real方法通过图像迁移域适应或策略无关域随机化解决，前者需费力获取目标域数据且限于部署域，后者引入无引导扰动可能不反映底层差异导致迁移次优。为此提出XFD，即XAI引导的傅里叶域泛化框架，用于纯仿真sim-to-real强化学习。该框架从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图，转化为策略条件傅里叶域干预。通过扰动外观敏感频谱分量同时保留任务定义空间结构，完全在仿真内构建增强鲁棒性的视觉域。

title: Structured SDEs for Realized GARCH: Continuous-Time Volatility Modelling and Component-Level Analysis
abstract: We propose a structured continuous-time stochastic volatility model for one-day-ahead integrated-variance forecasting. The model introduces a jointly evolving realized-measure state that feeds directly into latent variance dynamics, while correlated Brownian innovations capture return-linked dependence. Parameters are estimated through simulation-based predictive learning, and Monte Carlo simulation forecasts integrated variance. Across 17 equity indices, the proposed model shows strong out-of-sample performance relative to GARCH, GARCH-Itô, Realized GARCH, HAR, and HEAVY benchmarks under QLIKE, MSE, and MAE. Ablation results show that realized-measure feedback provides substantial incremental forecasting value within the proposed framework, while return-linked Brownian dependence contributes more modest complementary gains. The results support incorporating measurement-driven information directly into continuous-time latent volatility dynamics to improve integrated-variance forecasting.
summary: 本文提出一种结构化连续时间随机波动率模型，用于提前一日预测积分方差。模型引入一个与已实现测度联合演化的状态，直接驱动潜在方差动态，同时用相关的布朗运动新息刻画与收益相关的依赖。参数通过基于模拟的预测学习进行估计，并以蒙特卡洛模拟预测积分方差。在17个股指上，该模型在QLIKE、MSE和MAE指标下，相对于GARCH、GARCH-Itô、Realized GARCH、HAR和HEAVY基准均表现出较强的样本外预测能力。消融实验表明，已实现测度反馈在所提框架内提供了显著的增量预测价值，而收益关联的布朗依赖带来的互补收益较为有限。结果支持将测量驱动信息直接纳入连续时间潜在波动率动态，以改进积分方差预测。

title: GROMM: Generative Risk-neutral Option Market Models
abstract: We present a statically and dynamically arbitrage-free European option market model with smooth interpolation between option prices, based on the SANOS framework, and prove that its dynamics admit a unique strong solution. In spirit, it is a stochastic model for local volatility when the latter is used as a representation of a European option price surface, not as a pricing model. We illustrate the strength of our approach on S&P Index Option data from January 2022 to August 2025. We show that the model's initial state fits within bid/ask for more than 95% of relevant market option prices. We then train the model dynamics under $\mathbb{P}$ and $\mathbb{Q}$ and show that the model is indeed free of arbitrage while fitting the dynamics of the market well. We also propose a range of BHW-tests to test for absence of arbitrage.
summary: 我们提出一个在静态和动态上均无套利的欧式期权市场模型，基于SANOS框架对期权价格进行平滑插值，并证明其动态过程存在唯一强解。其核心思想是将局部波动率作为欧式期权价格曲面的表示而非定价模型，从而构建随机模型。我们利用2022年1月至2025年8月的标普指数期权数据验证了方法：模型初始状态能拟合超过95%相关市场期权价格的买卖报价。随后在真实概率测度P和风险中性测度Q下训练模型动态，表明模型既无套利又能良好拟合市场动态。我们还提出了一系列BHW检验来检测无套利性。

title: Designing Independent Variation: A Guided Iteration Methodology for Price Experiments in Short, Correlated Panels
abstract: Estimation error in short, correlated pricing panels is dominated by trajectory dispersion rather than sampling noise, creating an identification shortfall that only independently assigned variation can resolve. We propose a guided iteration methodology to decide how much variation to generate, where, and for how long: a cyclic price-perturbation scheme under a revenue-at-risk budget, framed as variance minimization over design-specific error covariances, analogous to portfolio selection. We establish four key results: (1) a closed-form minimum-variance combination rule; (2) proof that a convex cost of intensity yields an interior, spread-out allocation, whereas under a concave tolerable-volume-loss cost, concentrating intensity into fewer perturbations pays off only with heterogeneous candidates, priced-in fixed costs, or perturbations beyond the cost curve's inflection point; (3) a discounted recursion yielding a data-dependent exit timeline from the experimentation zone; and (4) an application to Dominick's retail data, in which about five designed independent units match the precision of approximately 700 passive equivalents in the anchor category, while a fast proxy across ten categories achieves a median 97% variance reduction relative to passive panels. Sixteen comparisons (eleven pre-specified) support the theory: greedy selection achieves 90-93% of the global optimum across more than fifty exhaustively verifiable instances, and the recursion reaches its predicted 90%-of-steady-state benchmark two cycles early, though a parametric bootstrap indicates that its delta-method interval understates the right-tail risk. Boundary conditions show that regularized covariance estimators extend plug-in noise tolerance from 29% to beyond 50%, submodularity holds up to a clear curvature threshold, and a shared shock imposes a fundamental precision floor.
summary: 该论文针对短且相关性强的定价面板中估计误差主要由轨迹离散而非抽样噪声主导的问题，提出一种引导迭代方法，决定生成多少变异、在何处以及持续多久：在收入风险预算下采用循环价格扰动方案，以设计特定误差协方差上的方差最小化为框架，类比投资组合选择。核心结果包括：(1) 闭式最小方差组合规则；(2) 证明凸强度成本导致内部、分散的分配，而凹的可容忍销量损失成本下，仅在异质候选、已定价固定成本或扰动超过成本曲线拐点时，将强度集中到更少扰动才划算；(3) 折现递推给出数据依赖的实验区退出时间线；(4) 在Dominick's零售数据上的应用，约五个设计独立单元在锚定类别中达到约700个被动等效项的精度，同时跨十个类别的快速代理。对实战交易（如RL/深度学习/Alpha）直接价值有限，属于定价实验设计与计量方法理论，故评5分。

title: Portfolio Decarbonization under Incomplete Carbon and Transition Information
abstract: We study dynamic portfolio decarbonization under incomplete information about firms' carbon intensities and the underlying transition state. The investor maximizes expected utility of terminal wealth net of a penalty on perceived cumulative financed emissions. Asset returns and carbon intensities depend on a stochastic transition factor, while the investor may need to infer the current transition state, its long-run mean and firms' carbon intensities from market observations and periodic noisy disclosures. The optimal strategy combines a Merton-type component with climate-dependent expected-return adjustments, a direct carbon intensity penalty and intertemporal hedging demands associated with stochastic carbon intensities and learning. In a numerical application, incomplete information has limited effects on welfare and target satisfaction when prior beliefs are well specified. By contrast, biased beliefs generate welfare losses in either direction but asymmetric environmental consequences: optimistic and pessimistic beliefs induce opposite portfolio tilts and therefore affect the probability of exceeding the cumulative emissions target differently.
summary: 本文研究在关于公司碳强度和潜在转型状态信息不完全条件下的动态投资组合脱碳问题。投资者在期末财富预期效用最大化目标下，同时面临对感知累计融资排放的惩罚。资产收益和碳强度取决于一个随机转型因子，而投资者可能需要从市场观察和定期发布的噪声披露中推断当前转型状态、其长期均值以及公司碳强度。最优策略结合了默顿型成分、气候依赖的预期收益调整、直接的碳强度惩罚，以及与随机碳强度和学*相关的跨期对冲需求。在数值应用中，当先验信念设定良好时，不完全信息对福利和目标满足程度的影响有限。相比之下，有偏信念在两个方向上都会产生福利损失，但环境后果不对称：乐观和悲观信念导致相反的投资组合倾斜，因此对超过累计排放目标的概率产生不同影响。

title: E-Backtesting Expected Shortfall without Value-at-Risk Forecasts under Time-series Models
abstract: Expected Shortfall (ES) measures the average size of tail losses. Its sequential backtests typically also require a Value-at-Risk (VaR) forecast. We develop two e-backtesting methods using only observed losses and ES forecasts: one for iid losses only and the other for time series under an AR-GARCH conditional VaR structure. Under the stated assumptions, both control false rejections at any stopping time. For the time-series method, validity requires a fixed parameter--quantile pair representing the conditional VaR path and a positive report margin. The time-series statistic takes an infimum over possible parameter and VaR values. We choose the betting process $(λ_t)$ by maximizing an empirical growth rate averaged across candidate parameters. We compute the statistic by continuous VaR profiling on a dense parameter grid. For grid approximations, we prove convergence to the continuous infimum, together with convergence of the probability of false rejection, as the grid is refined over a fixed monitoring period. Lower and upper bounds for the VaR infimum on the parameter grid control the accuracy of the numerical profiling. Simulations, including ES reports that change from over-reporting to under-reporting, and an application to daily NASDAQ losses provide numerical comparisons with VaR--ES e-processes and fixed-sample ES backtests, assessing detection frequencies and the timing of rejections.
summary: 预期损失（ES）度量尾部损失的平均规模，其序贯回测通常需要风险价值（VaR）预测。本文开发了两种仅使用观测损失和ES预测的e-回测方法：一种仅适用于独立同分布损失，另一种适用于AR-GARCH条件VaR结构下的时间序列。在所述假设下，两种方法均能在任意停时控制错误拒绝。对于时间序列方法，有效性要求固定参数-分位数对代表条件VaR路径，且报告边际为正。时间序列统计量在可能的参数和VaR值上取确界。通过最大化候选参数上的经验平均增长率来选择投注过程(λ_t)。在密集参数网格上通过连续VaR剖析计算统计量。对于网格近似，证明了随网格在固定监测期内细化，收敛到连续确界，同时错误拒绝概率收敛。参数网格上VaR确界的上下界控制数值剖析的精度。模拟包括从过度报告变化的ES报告。

title: 4Cast Lab: Open-Source App for Machine Learning & Statistical Analysis
abstract: 4Cast Lab is a free, open-source application for machine learning, econometrics and statistical analysis that runs on the user's own computer, with no installation, no programming and no data leaving the machine. It was developed at the E|M|E|F Lab, Department of Economics, Democritus University of Thrace, for researchers, analysts, instructors and students in any field. Its Forecasting mode trains eight learning algorithms (with three kernels for SVM/SVR), implemented from scratch, under leakage-safe validation for time-ordered data; it selects models by cross-validation, compares the selected model with every alternative and with naive benchmarks through formal tests of predictive accuracy, and documents each run in a methods report and a Python script that the user can export. Its Estimation mode covers the core of applied econometrics, from OLS with robust inference to ARIMA, ARDL, VAR/VECM and GARCH. This paper describes the design, the interface and the workflow of version 4.6.2, reports a validation of 1,234 numerical results against statsmodels, linearmodels, arch, scikit-learn and NIST certified values, illustrates the workflow with three examples, and discusses current limitations.
summary: 4Cast Lab 是一个免费开源、无需安装编程、本地运行数据的机器学习与计量经济学分析应用。其预测模式从零实现八种学习算法（SVM/SVR 含三种核函数），对时序数据采用防泄漏验证，通过交叉验证选模型，并用正式预测精度检验与基准比较，可导出方法报告和 Python 脚本；估计模式涵盖 OLS 稳健推断、ARIMA、ARDL、VAR/VECM、GARCH 等。论文描述 4.6.2 版设计、界面与流程，用 statsmodels、linearmodels、arch、scikit-learn 及 NIST 认证值验证 1234 个数值结果，以三例展示工作流。该工具偏计量与统计建模辅助，缺乏强化学习、深度学习或直接 alpha 信号挖掘，实战交易价值有限。

title: Neural Estimation of Irreversibility in Real and Simulated Limit Order Book Paths
abstract: A path indistinguishable from its own reverse carries no arrow of time, so time irreversibility is a necessary condition for a directed mechanism to be readable from trajectories alone. In finance it has been measured only on scalar series such as returns and volatility. We define the irreversibility rate of a coarse-grained limit order book path as the forward-to-reverse log-density ratio per event, and estimate it from three weeks of Nasdaq market-by-order data with an order-invariant MLP and a temporal convolutional network that receive identical blocks. For NVDA, the order-invariant and order-sensitive estimates are 0.036 and 0.054 nats per event, respectively. Their difference, the ordering increment, is 0.018. A surrogate preserving the coarse one-step transition table recovers 30 percent less irreversibility than the observed paths. The increment is positive for all twelve symbols on every held-out daytime date, and for NVDA in each session window. It changes more than tenfold with the coarse-graining scale. Neither a linear score nor any single feature group reproduces the full fitted rate. A queue-reactive simulator calibrated on the same days matches the market's ordered rate, 0.052 against 0.054, yet its ordering increment is 0.0006 against 0.018, building temporal asymmetry out of block composition instead of block order. We propose the ordering and scale profile of path irreversibility as a benchmark for order book simulators. Code and audit materials are available at https://github.com/hjyeo30/lob-irreversibility.
summary: 该论文定义限价订单簿路径的不可逆性速率（前向与反向每事件对数密度比），用订单不变MLP和时序卷积网络在Nasdaq三周逐单数据上估计。NVDA的订单不变与订单敏感估计分别为0.036和0.054 nats/事件，差异（排序增量）为0.018；粗粒化一步转移表代理比观测路径少恢复30%不可逆性。该增量在十二个标的的所有测试日均为正，且随粗粒化尺度变化超十倍；线性分数或单一特征组无法复现完整拟合率。论文属于市场微观结构实证与表示学习结合，对实战Alpha/RL启发有限，偏理论和方法论。

title: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. A Thompson-sampling bandit acts as the strategist, selecting command tuples from an estimate of the opponent's strategy built from in-game observations rather than opponent identity. In a controlled comparison with a flat PPO baseline trained with the same architecture, budget, curriculum and self-play league, the strategist-executor system wins significantly more often against three of the four strongest opponents on a training map, including the two strongest held-out ones (0.55 to 0.97 and 0.01 to 0.34), with no significant difference against the others.
summary: 深度强化学习智能体在实时策略游戏中表现强劲，但面对训练分布外的对手时可能脆弱。将战略命令选择与学习的单位控制分离，可为不同对手选择不同策略，同时复用同一执行策略。这需要一个能遵循不同命令的执行器，以及评估其遵循程度的可度量标准。我们引入一种受约束的命令条件化PPO策略作为执行器，用于MicroRTS实时策略环境。离散命令指定战略目标和经济、军队组成、军事姿态、工人策略等多步环境行为要求；执行器决定用于实现这些目标的单位级动作。Thompson采样bandit作为战略家，基于从游戏内观察估计的对手策略（而非对手身份）选择命令元组。在与使用相同架构、预算、课程和自博弈联盟训练的扁平PPO基线的受控比较中，战略家-执行器系统获胜。

title: Deep Learning vs. Statistical Models for Multi-Horizon Price Forecasting of Second-Hand Electronics: A Systematic Benchmark
abstract: Forecasting resale prices of used electronics is critical for subscription-based platforms where pricing errors translate directly into risk. Unlike structured financial markets, second-hand electronics exhibit high volatility, sparse listing histories, and non-normal price dynamics - yet no systematic time-series benchmark exists for this domain. This paper presents the first multi-horizon benchmark of statistical and deep learning forecasting models for used electronics price prediction. We use a large-scale dataset of daily price listings from Polish online marketplaces (January 2022 to March 2025, 100+ smartphone and laptop models) and evaluate eleven models across six horizons from 1 to 365 days, covering classical methods (ARIMA, ETS, Theta), recurrent and convolutional networks (LSTM, TCN), and modern deep architectures (N-BEATS, N-HiTS, TFT, PatchTST, Informer). Three complementary evaluation protocols assess trajectory fitness, one-shot endpoint accuracy, and cross-horizon transfer. N-BEATS achieves the lowest MAPE beyond 30 days, reaching 8.51% at 365 days versus 14.94% for the best statistical baseline - a 43% reduction. At short horizons (1-7 days), all models converge near 0.72% MAPE and the naive baseline remains competitive. A single N-BEATS model trained at 365 days generalizes to all shorter horizons, eliminating the need for horizon-specific models. N-BEATS and N-HiTS also demonstrate superior hyperparameter stability.
summary: 本文对二手电子产品多期限价格预测进行了首个系统性基准测试，使用波兰在线市场2022年1月至2025年3月、100多种手机和笔记本型号的每日价格数据，评估了11个模型在1至365天六个期限上的表现。模型涵盖经典统计方法（ARIMA、ETS、Theta）、循环与卷积网络（LSTM、TCN）以及现代深度架构（N-BEATS、N-HiTS、TFT、PatchTST、Informer）。通过轨迹拟合、单次端点精度和跨期限迁移三种评估协议，发现N-BEATS在30天以上期限取得最低MAPE，365天为8.51%，较最佳统计基线14.94%降低43%；短期限（1-7天）所有模型表现趋同。

title: Execution Realism and Reproducibility in LLM-Based Trading Systems: A Systematic Scoping Review and Evidence Audit
abstract: Execution realism remains weakly standardized in research on large-language-model-based trading systems, limiting comparison and reproduction across backtests, simulations, and portfolio benchmarks. This article presents a PRISMA-ScR systematic scoping review with a nested execution-reproducibility evidence audit. Eight reproducible query families returned 796 query-level records; DOI/title deduplication left 687 unique records, 101 reports were sought for retrieval, and 59 full texts were recovered through direct and fallback open-access routes. Fifty-three reports are provisionally eligible for expanded evidence charting, subject to reconciliation of two blind author-validation packets. The charting framework separately evaluates point-in-time controls, temporal splits, held-out evaluation, trading costs and turnover, execution semantics, universe construction, architecture reporting, and artifact availability. Direct-trading, portfolio or alpha-construction, and benchmark studies are retained as distinct descriptive subgroups rather than pooled as a common performance estimand. Search responses, retrieval attempts, file hashes, evidence excerpts, screening decisions, and coding worksheets are archived with the review materials. Final field-level counts are intentionally withheld until author validation is complete.
summary: 该论文是对基于大语言模型的交易系统研究中“执行现实性与可复现性”的系统性范围综述与证据审计，采用PRISMA-ScR方法，检索796条记录、去重后687条、纳入59篇全文，并构建了评估框架（时点控制、时间切分、留出评估、交易成本与换手率、执行语义、股票池构建、架构报告、工件可用性）。它属于方法论/元研究，不提出或回测新的交易策略，也不涉及强化学习、深度学习或阿尔法因子构建。对实战交易的直接价值有限，但可作为评估LLM交易系统回测可信度和执行假设的检查清单，故给5分。

title: Multi-period Mean-Expectile Portfolio Optimization under Wasserstein Ambiguity: Reformulation, Degeneracy and the Role of the Ground Metric
abstract:
Expectiles are the only law-invariant risk measures that are both coherent and elicitable. Unlike Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), however, they do not admit a Rockafellar--Uryasev representation that admits tractable Wasserstein reformulations. We address this difficulty by developing an envelope theorem for worst-case expectiles that characterizes the worst-case expectile over a Wasserstein ambiguity set as the unique root of a worst-case expectation with a two-piece affine integrand. This representation permits direct application of standard Wasserstein duality.
  Using this result, we reformulate a multi-period tri-level mean--expectile portfolio problem as four parametric linear programs with constraints. We establish four structural properties of the proposed model: an endogenously damped price of robustness, a decision-dependent critical radius beyond which the expectile tail component becomes inactive, exact recovery of the nominal model at zero ambiguity, and a characterization of how the Wasserstein ground metric determines whether the limiting portfolio becomes more concentrated or more diversified. Numerical experiments on 90 FTSE constituents over 3,341 out-of-sample trading days show that the expectile model outperforms a CVaR model matched on ambiguity set, radius, ground metric, and trade-off weight in all nine parameter cells---significantly so whenever the radius is non-trivial. The experiments further confirm the predicted degeneracy under the ground metric.
summary: 该论文研究多期均值-期望分位数投资组合优化，在Wasserstein模糊集下，通过包络定理将最坏情况期望分位数表征为两段仿射被积函数的最坏情况期望的唯一根，从而将三层多期问题重构为四个带约束的参数线性规划。理论贡献包括内生阻尼稳健价格、决策依赖的临界半径、零模糊时精确恢复名义模型，以及Wasserstein地面度量对极限组合集中度的影响。数值实验使用90只FTSE成分股、3341个样本外数据。属于纯理论方法论文，对实战交易（强化学习/深度学习/Alpha）的直接价值有限，但为基于分布鲁棒优化的多期组合提供了一定参考。

title: Weighted selection from elliptical distributions: a stochastic representation and an application to portfolio separation
